papers.title: Done Is Not Correct: Measuring Silent Failures and Self-Verification Calibration When LLM Agents Take CAD Actions
papers.abstract: When a large language model (LLM) agent writes parametric CAD code from a natural-language specification, syntactic success decouples from semantic correctness. We release a benchmark and harness that measure this gap directly: 13 specification tasks whose every requirement maps to machine-checkable properties of the produced B-rep, measured by the kernel against published tolerance bands, with reference solutions and the full graded attempt corpus. The exact, self-audited oracle isolates two quantities no prior CAD benchmark reports: the silent-failure rate (a valid, renderable solid, an explicit completion claim, and at least one failed semantic check) and completion-claim calibration. Across four models from four vendors (156 attempts per architecture), single-shot agents claimed completion on 98% of attempts and were silently wrong on 14.1%; a tool-use loop that enforces measure-then-claim cut silent failures to 3.2% and raised claim precision from 64% to 96%, and a four-model ablation attributes the change to the claim contract rather than the feedback. A planner-coder-checker pipeline matched that precision at lower coverage with no success gain. Stated confidence was miscalibrated single-shot (ECE 0.32) and became informative under verification for three of four models. Hardening our own oracle flipped 18 of 519 regraded verdicts from pass to fail and none in reverse; a blind expert audit overturned 3 of the 18 silent failures outside the one ambiguously specified task; and fourfold scaling of every tolerance band leaves the contrast intact.

translation.title: 完成不等于正确：度量 LLM Agent 执行 CAD 操作时的静默失败与自我验证校准
translation.abstract: 当大语言模型（LLM）agent 根据自然语言规格编写参数化 CAD 代码时，语法上的成功与语义上的正确性会脱节。我们发布了一个直接度量这一差距的基准与测试框架：13 个规格任务，其中每项要求都映射到所生成 B-rep 的机器可验证属性，由内核按公开的公差带进行度量，并提供参考解与完整的分级尝试语料。这一精确的、自审计的 oracle 隔离出此前 CAD 基准从未报告的两个量：静默失败率（生成有效可渲染实体、明确声称完成、且至少一项语义检查失败）与完成声称的校准度。在来自四家厂商的四个模型上（每种架构 156 次尝试），单次生成的 agent 在 98% 的尝试中声称完成，其中 14.1% 是静默错误；一个强制“先度量后声称”的工具使用循环将静默失败降至 3.2%，并将声称精度从 64% 提升到 96%，四模型消融实验表明这一变化来自声称契约而非反馈。planner-coder-checker 流水线在更低的覆盖率下达到同等精度，且无成功率提升。单次生成时声称的置信度校准不佳（ECE 0.32），而在验证下四个模型中的三个变得有信息量。加固我们自己的 oracle 使 519 个重新评定的判定中 18 个从通过翻转为失败，且无反向翻转；一次盲测专家审计推翻了 18 个静默失败中位于唯一一个规格模糊任务之外的 3 个；将所有公差带放大四倍后对比依然成立。
translation.brief: 针对 LLM agent 生成 CAD 代码时“声称完成但语义错误”的静默失败问题，构建了基于机器可验证 B-rep 属性的基准，并通过强制“先度量后声称”的工具使用循环降低静默失败并校准完成声称。

papers.title: META-IR: Meta-Introspective Reasoning for Adaptive Safety Alignment in LLM
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) remain vulnerable to jailbreak attacks and harmful-content prompts, particularly under adversarial distribution shifts where static alignment pipelines fail to generalize. Although introspective methods such as STAIR strengthen refusal consistency, they depend on fixed self-evaluation policies that cannot rapidly adapt to evolving manipulation strategies. To overcome these limitations, this paper introduces META-IR, a meta-introspective reasoning framework that enhances safety alignment through meta-learning-driven adaptation. It employs a dual-loop architecture: an inner introspective loop that performs structured risk analysis, self-assessment, and reflective correction via SI-MCTS, and an outer meta-learning loop that optimizes the introspection policy across diverse jailbreak task families to enable rapid generalization to unseen attacks. A dynamic jailbreak simulation module further exposes the model to progressively harder adversarial prompts, enabling continual self-improvement without human supervision. Experiments across multiple models (Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct and Qwen-2-7B-Instruct) and a broad suite of safety, helpfulness, generalization, and introspection metrics demonstrate that META-IR substantially improves adaptation speed, robustness, and reasoning stability compared with all baseline models. These results establish META-IR as an effective pathway toward building LLMs capable of sustained, adaptive safety alignment under dynamic and evolving threat environments.

translation.title: META-IR：面向 LLM 自适应安全对齐的元内省推理
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）仍然容易受到越狱攻击和有害内容提示的影响，尤其是在对抗性分布偏移下，静态对齐流程难以泛化。尽管 STAIR 等内省方法加强了拒绝一致性，但它们依赖固定的自我评估策略，无法快速适应不断演变的操纵策略。为克服这些局限，本文提出 META-IR，一个通过元学习驱动适应来增强安全对齐的元内省推理框架。它采用双循环架构：内循环通过 SI-MCTS 执行结构化风险分析、自我评估与反思修正，外循环作为元学习循环在多样的越狱任务族上优化内省策略，实现对未见攻击的快速泛化。一个动态越狱模拟模块进一步让模型接触难度递增的对抗提示，实现无需人工监督的持续自我改进。在多个模型（Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 和 Qwen-2-7B-Instruct）以及广泛的安全性、有用性、泛化与内省指标上的实验表明，与所有基线相比，META-IR 显著提升了适应速度、鲁棒性和推理稳定性。这些结果确立了 META-IR 作为构建能在动态演变的威胁环境下实现持续、自适应安全对齐的 LLM 的有效路径。
translation.brief: 针对静态安全对齐在动态越狱攻击下难以泛化的问题，提出 META-IR 双循环框架，用 SI-MCTS 内省循环结合元学习外循环自适应优化内省策略。

papers.title: Coordinated Mixed-Precision KV Cache Quantization for Efficient LLM-based Multi-agent Systems
papers.abstract: LLM-based multi-agent systems solve complex tasks through collaboration, but their growing, simultaneously resident key-value (KV) caches create a memory bottleneck. Applying single-model quantization policies independently ignores differences in agents' precision needs, potentially degrading collective reasoning. We introduce Coordinated Mixed-Precision KV Cache Quantization (CoMixKV), which combines online sensitivity estimation with joint agent-layer bit-width allocation under a shared memory budget. To our knowledge, CoMixKV is the first mixed-precision KV-cache quantization framework to jointly allocate precision across simultaneously resident agent caches under such a budget. The estimator derives sensitivity from a local attention-error bound using recent queries, keys, and values, without calibration data, trial quantization, or additional model passes. A shared controller combines these scores with remaining quantizable capacity and byte-level storage costs to minimize total estimated error. Allocations are refreshed as agents start or finish and new observations become available. Selected widths apply only to newly quantized blocks; recent states retain native precision and previously quantized blocks remain unchanged. Across four benchmarks and three LLM backbones at average 2-bit, 3-bit, and 4-bit settings, CoMixKV achieves strong accuracy against the evaluated quantization baselines. At the average 3-bit setting on Gemma-4-31B-it, it achieves 68.35% average accuracy, exceeding the strongest quantized baseline by 0.59%. On Qwen3-32B, it reduces peak KV-cache memory by 32.08% and achieves a 1.38x inference speedup over FullKV.

translation.title: 面向基于 LLM 的多智能体系统的协同混合精度 KV Cache 量化
translation.abstract: 基于 LLM 的多智能体系统通过协作解决复杂任务，但其不断增长且同时驻留的键值（KV）缓存造成了内存瓶颈。对每个模型独立应用单一量化策略忽略了各 agent 精度需求的差异，可能损害集体推理。我们提出 Coordinated Mixed-Precision KV Cache Quantization（CoMixKV），在共享内存预算下结合在线敏感度估计与跨 agent-层的联合位宽分配。据我们所知，CoMixKV 是首个在此类预算下为同时驻留的 agent 缓存联合分配精度的混合精度 KV cache 量化框架。估计器利用近期的 query、key 和 value 从局部注意力误差界导出敏感度，无需校准数据、试量化或额外的模型前向。共享控制器将这些分数与剩余可量化容量及字节级存储成本结合，以最小化总估计误差。当 agent 启动或结束以及新的观测可用时刷新分配。所选位宽仅应用于新量化的块；近期状态保持原生精度，已量化的块保持不变。在四个基准、三个 LLM 骨干、平均 2-bit、3-bit 和 4-bit 设置下，CoMixKV 相对所评估的量化基线取得了很强的准确率。在 Gemma-4-31B-it 上平均 3-bit 设置下，其平均准确率为 68.35%，超过最强量化基线 0.59%。在 Qwen3-32B 上，其将峰值 KV cache 内存降低 32.08%，并相对 FullKV 取得 1.38 倍推理加速。
translation.brief: 针对多智能体系统中同时驻留的 KV cache 内存瓶颈，提出 CoMixKV，在共享内存预算下通过在线敏感度估计与联合 agent-层位宽分配进行混合精度 KV cache 量化。

papers.title: Autonomous Code Review: Hidden-Test Results on GitHub Issues
papers.abstract: Can an autonomous cross-provider review step change whether code written for a real issue passes hidden tests? We report a retrospective benchmark of 12 historical GitHub issues (five C#, five JavaScript, and two Python) from five repositories. Two directed author--reviewer pairs, OpenAI GPT-6.1-Sol and Anthropic Claude Sonnet 5.5, each ran twice per issue, yielding 48 planned workflows. A bounded terminal agent produced an initial patch; a cross-provider model reviewed it; the author model adjudicated findings and could revise the patch. The same hidden evaluator assessed initial and final patches. Forty workflows completed, while eight terminated before a complete evaluator outcome. Four completed workflows passed, and all four already passed before review. No initial-to-final pass/fail transitions occurred among completed workflows.

translation.title: 自主代码评审：GitHub Issues 上的隐藏测试结果
translation.abstract: 一个自主的跨厂商评审环节能否改变针对真实 issue 编写的代码是否通过隐藏测试？我们报告了一个对来自五个仓库的 12 个历史 GitHub issue（五个 C#、五个 JavaScript、两个 Python）的回溯性基准。两个定向的作者—评审者组合 OpenAI GPT-6.1-Sol 和 Anthropic Claude Sonnet 5.5，每个 issue 各运行两次，产生 48 个计划中的工作流。一个受限的终端 agent 产生初始补丁；跨厂商模型对其进行评审；作者模型裁定评审发现并可修订补丁。同一隐藏评估器评估初始与最终补丁。四十个工作流完成，八个在得到完整评估结果前终止。四个完成的工作流通过，且全部在评审前即已通过。完成的工作流中未发生任何从初始到最终的通过/失败转变。
translation.brief: 针对自主跨厂商代码评审能否提升通过隐藏测试率的问题，构建了 12 个真实 GitHub issue 的回溯基准，用作者—评审者双 agent 流程进行实验评估。

papers.title: Enmo Safety: External, Non-invasive, Model-agnostic Oversight for Off-the-Shelf Language Models
papers.abstract: We study a safety harness that improves itself without touching model weights. Enmo Safety wraps a chat model with a deterministic input assessment, trigger-matched safety guidance, spotlighting of untrusted content, and an output guard. A reflector model turns failures into one bounded update per round, and an update is kept only if it lowers harm without raising refusal of benign prompts on a held-out dev split. Every version is snapshotted and every decision ledgered. We evaluate a bare model, the seed harness and the evolved harness on six open benchmarks (HarmBench, AdvBench, JailbreakBench, XSTest, AgentHarm, deepset prompt-injections). On 150 items and on a 290-item holdout, none of the before/after differences on two models was statistically significant. A fourth iteration ran six policy models on a fresh 300-item split: the harness cut the unsafe rate significantly on two models (12.9% to 7.1%, p = 0.035; 10.2% to 3.6%, p = 0.036), not on the other four, and raised agentic-harm labels on two. Whether the rules fired was unrelated to outcome (Fisher p from 0.30 to 1.0), and the helpfulness clauses made agentic harm worse than no harness on obfuscated attacks. A reworded clause and an input-normalisation step form harness v22, at a measured cost in benign tool-task refusal. Each cell is one run, so these estimates do not establish a general safety improvement. Code, harness versions and ledger: https://github.com/rioryugen/enmo_safety

translation.title: Enmo Safety：面向现成语言模型的外部、非侵入、模型无关监督
translation.abstract: 我们研究一种无需触碰模型权重即可自我改进的安全框架（harness）。Enmo Safety 用确定性的输入评估、触发匹配的安全指引、不可信内容的高亮以及输出守卫来包装聊天模型。一个 reflector 模型将失败转化为每轮一次的有界更新，仅当更新在不增加对良性提示的拒绝的前提下降低危害（在留出的开发集上）时才被保留。每个版本都被快照，每个决策都被记录。我们在六个公开基准（HarmBench、AdvBench、JailbreakBench、XSTest、AgentHarm、deepset prompt-injections）上评估裸模型、种子 harness 与演化后的 harness。在 150 条数据与 290 条留出集上，两个模型的前后差异均不具统计显著性。第四次迭代在全新的 300 条数据上运行六个策略模型：harness 在两个模型上显著降低不安全率（12.9% 降至 7.1%，p = 0.035；10.2% 降至 3.6%，p = 0.036），在其余四个上不显著，并在两个模型上增加了 agentic-harm 标签。规则是否触发与结果无关（Fisher p 从 0.30 到 1.0），且有用性条款在混淆攻击下使 agentic 危害比无 harness 更糟。一条改写的条款与一个输入规范化步骤构成 harness v22，其代价是良性工具任务拒绝率的可测上升。每个单元格仅为一次运行，因此这些估计无法确立一般性的安全改进。代码、harness 版本与决策账本：https://github.com/rioryugen/enmo_safety
translation.brief: 针对不改动模型权重即可提升现成 LLM 安全性的问题，提出 Enmo Safety 外部安全框架，通过确定性守卫加 reflector 模型的有界迭代更新实现自我改进。

papers.title: The Infrastructure Divide: Analyzing Community Stance on Data Center Development via Reddit
papers.abstract: The rapid expansion of AI-driven data center construction has outpaced public engagement: an estimated $64 billion in U.S. data center projects were blocked or delayed by local opposition between May 2024 and March 2025, yet the concerns driving this resistance remain poorly characterized. Prior engagement methods such as surveys and hearings are introduced late in the planning process, and no study has systematically mined social media to measure community stance at scale. To address this gap, this study presents an LLM-powered opinion-mining framework and applies it to 798 Reddit posts and 102,328 associated comments spanning a decade. An open-source large language model, guided by a Chain-of-Stance prompting framework and three domain-specific labeling rules, classified stance at 83% of the human inter-reviewer agreement ceiling. Opposition dominated discourse volume rather than disapproval: against posts outnumbered favor posts 2.6:1 and generated 8.5 times more comments, and this gap widened significantly over 86 weeks. Topic modeling of opposition arguments resolved into four reproducible clusters, resource consumption and scarcity (42.8%), contested siting processes and secrecy (34.2%), political opposition to data centers (13%), and political and corporate accountability (8%). Engagement analysis revealed that posts with emotional or provocative political framing attracted the most engagement, while key technical concerns (e.g., water, power) were dispersed across lower-engagement comment threads. These findings give local leaders, developers, and policy makers a quantified, continuously updatable basis for prioritizing concerns and policy levers, supporting a shift from opposition to negotiated, verifiable partnership for data center development.

translation.title: 基础设施鸿沟：基于 Reddit 的数据中心建设社区立场分析
translation.abstract: AI 驱动的数据中心建设快速扩张已超出公众参与的速度：2024 年 5 月至 2025 年 3 月间，估计有 640 亿美元的美国数据中心项目因当地反对而被阻止或推迟，但驱动这种抵制的关切仍未被充分刻画。此前的公众参与方式（如调查和听证会）通常在规划后期才引入，且尚无研究系统性地从社交媒体大规模挖掘社区立场。为填补这一空白，本研究提出了一个基于 LLM 的舆论挖掘框架，并将其应用于跨越十年的 798 条 Reddit 帖子和 102,328 条相关评论。一个开源大语言模型在 Chain-of-Stance 提示框架和三条领域专属标注规则的引导下进行立场分类，达到人类评审者间一致上限的 83%。反对在讨论量而非不赞同率上占主导：反对帖与支持帖数量比为 2.6:1，且产生的评论多 8.5 倍，这一差距在 86 周内显著扩大。对反对论点的话题建模得到四个可复现的聚类：资源消耗与稀缺（42.8%）、有争议的选址流程与保密性（34.2%）、针对数据中心的政治反对（13%）以及对政治和企业问责的诉求（8%）。参与度分析显示，带有情绪化或煽动性政治框架的帖子获得最多互动，而关键技术关切（如水资源、电力）则分散在互动较少的评论串中。这些发现为地方领导人、开发商和政策制定者提供了量化且可持续更新的依据，用于确定优先关切和政策杠杆，推动数据中心开发从对抗走向可协商、可验证的合作伙伴关系。
translation.brief: 针对社区对数据中心建设的立场缺乏大规模刻画的问题，提出基于 LLM 的立场挖掘框架，用 Chain-of-Stance 提示对十年 Reddit 数据进行立场分类与反对论点话题聚类分析。

papers.title: TrialJev: Open-Weight Single Pass Eligibility Scoring for Patient Trial Screening
papers.abstract: Clinical trial screening requires assessing large numbers of patient-trial pairs to prioritize candidates for detailed eligibility review, often under restrictions on sharing patient records. We introduce TrialJev, an open-weight eligibility scorer that uses LoRA-adapted Qwen models and a pointer head to score natural-language answer options in a single forward pass, without autoregressive decoding. Trained on TREC Clinical Trials 2021 and evaluated on 6,975 eligible-or-excluded pairs from 50 unseen TREC 2022 synthetic patients, TrialJev achieves 80.97% (Qwen3.5-27B) and 81.84% (Qwen3.8-27B) accuracy, compared with 79.87% and 79.93% for LLMs fine-tuned on the same data to generate verdicts. In matched batch-1 measurements, verdict generation takes 2.45-2.70 times as long as the one-pass inference of TrialJev at 9B-27B. Under a common development-fitted decision correction, the two 27B TrialJev models reach 80.99% and 81.88% accuracy, compared with 81.28% for the proprietary hosted Jev API; paired confidence intervals include zero. TrialJev runs locally on a single GPU, requiring approximately 178 ms per pair at 27B, without transmitting patient text to an external model API. An A/B-logit ablation shows that avoiding decoding, rather than the pointer head alone, accounts for the measured efficiency advantage. TrialJev is intended for first-pass prioritization of candidate trials, complementing rather than replacing explanatory models and clinical review. Evaluation is limited to synthetic patients and implementation-specific timing, and clinical use has not been validated. Adapters, pointer heads, and model cards are released on Hugging Face.

translation.title: TrialJev：面向患者临床试验筛选的开源权重单遍通过资格评分
translation.abstract: 临床试验筛选需要评估大量患者-试验配对，以便为详细资格审查优先排序候选者，且通常受到患者病历共享限制的约束。我们提出 TrialJev，一个开源权重的资格评分器，它使用 LoRA 适配的 Qwen 模型和指针头，在单次前向传播中对自然语言答案选项进行评分，无需自回归解码。TrialJev 在 TREC Clinical Trials 2021 上训练，并在来自 50 个未见过的 TREC 2022 合成患者的 6,975 个合格或排除配对上评估，达到 80.97%（Qwen3.5-27B）和 81.84%（Qwen3.8-27B）的准确率，而基于相同数据微调以生成判定结论的 LLM 分别为 79.87% 和 79.93%。在匹配的 batch-1 测量中，判定生成的耗时是 TrialJev 在 9B-27B 规模下单遍推理的 2.45-2.70 倍。在共同开发拟合的决策校正下，两个 27B 的 TrialJev 模型达到 80.99% 和 81.88% 的准确率，而专有的托管 Jev API 为 81.28%；配对置信区间包含零。TrialJev 可在单张 GPU 上本地运行，27B 模型每个配对约需 178 毫秒，无需将患者文本传输到外部模型 API。A/B-logit 消融实验表明，效率优势主要来自避免解码，而非指针头本身。TrialJev 旨在用于候选试验的初筛优先排序，是解释性模型和临床审查的补充而非替代。评估仅限于合成患者和特定实现的计时，临床应用尚未验证。适配器、指针头和模型卡已在 Hugging Face 上发布。
translation.brief: 针对临床试验筛选中患者-试验配对评分慢且患者数据不能外传的问题，提出 TrialJev，用 LoRA 适配的 Qwen 模型加指针头在单次前向传播中完成资格评分，避免自回归解码以提升效率并支持本地部署。

papers.title: DeepResearch RewardBench: Evaluating Reward Models for Deep Research Report
papers.abstract: Empowered by Large Language Models (LLMs), deep research systems integrate online information into research reports through multi-step web searching and information synthesis. Evaluating these reports presents a significant challenge due to their long context, high information density, and domain specificity, necessitating the use of AI evaluation as a substitute for prohibitively expensive human assessment. However, few studies have examined the effectiveness of existing reward models or LLMs in understanding and evaluating such research reports. To bridge this gap, we introduce DeepResearch RewardBench, the first benchmark dedicated to evaluating reward modeling for research reports. We collect diverse report candidates from multiple agents or tool-augmented LLMs. These candidates are scored using query-specific golden rubrics, and we ensure data quality and difficulty through a combination of multi-round filtering and human verification. Our benchmark comprises preference datasets formatted as pairs, triplets, and quadruplets to test ranking capabilities across varying levels of difficulty. Extensive experiments demonstrate that while current reward models handle general coherence effectively, their performance significantly degrades when evaluating research reports. Generative LLMs acting as judges demonstrate comprehensive superiority in this domain, with comparative evaluation proving more effective than direct scoring methods. We anticipate that this benchmark will serve as a vital testbed for the evaluation and advancement of research agents.

translation.title: DeepResearch RewardBench：面向深度研究报告的奖励模型评估
translation.abstract: 在大语言模型（LLM）的驱动下，深度研究系统通过多步网页搜索和信息综合将在线信息整合进研究报告。由于这些报告具有长上下文、高信息密度和领域专业性，其评估面临重大挑战，因此需要使用 AI 评估来替代成本过高的人工评估。然而，很少有研究考察现有奖励模型或 LLM 在理解和评估此类研究报告方面的有效性。为填补这一空白，我们提出 DeepResearch RewardBench，这是首个专门评估研究报告奖励建模的基准。我们从多个智能体或工具增强的 LLM 中收集多样化的报告候选，并使用查询特定的黄金评分标准对这些候选进行评分，同时通过多轮过滤和人工验证确保数据质量与难度。该基准包含以配对、三元组和四元组形式组织的偏好数据集，以测试不同难度层级下的排序能力。大量实验表明，尽管现有奖励模型能有效处理一般连贯性，但其在评估研究报告时性能显著下降。作为评判者的生成式 LLM 在该领域表现出全面优势，且比较式评估比直接打分方法更有效。我们期望这一基准能成为研究型智能体评估与进步的重要试验平台。
translation.brief: 针对缺少评估奖励模型评判深度研究报告能力的基准这一问题，构建 DeepResearch RewardBench，用黄金评分标准配合多轮过滤和人工验证收集偏好数据，以配对/三元组/四元组测试排序能力。

papers.title: Edge-Deployable LLMs for Classification and Value-of-Information Ranking of Disaster-Related Tweets
papers.abstract: Humanitarian-aid and disaster relief decisions often rely on noisy, incomplete, and uncertain information from social media. Although substantial research has focused on automating the classification of such data, limited work has examined whether individual posts contain sufficient information to support decisions to act. In this study, we use large language models (LLMs) to (1) classify social media content and (2) assess its Value-of-Information (VoI) in terms of operational actionability. We evaluate seven LLMs for the classification of 77,484 tweets across 10 humanitarian-aid categories and identify the Qwen3 (8B parameters) model as the top-performing classifier, achieving the highest F1 scores in all but one category. In a second task, the classified categories serve as contextual inputs for assessing VoI with respect to responder actionability across six well established metrics for each tweet. We observed that the Gemma 3 (4B parameters) model outperformed the other models on this task, achieving the highest recall across the majority of categories. This work demonstrates that relatively small, edge-deployable LLMs can prioritize actionable information in resource-constrained environments. By integrating VoI assessment, our framework advances the automated elicitation of high-utility knowledge from unstructured social media streams for disaster-response decision-making and highlights a pathway toward tactical edge applications using LLMs that fit on a single 8 GB GPU.

translation.title: 面向灾害相关推文分类与信息价值排序的可边缘部署 LLM
translation.abstract: 人道主义援助和救灾决策往往依赖来自社交媒体的嘈杂、不完整和不确定的信息。尽管大量研究致力于此类数据分类的自动化，但关于单条帖子是否包含足够信息以支持行动决策的研究仍然有限。在本研究中，我们使用大语言模型（LLM）来（1）对社交媒体内容进行分类，以及（2）从操作可行动性角度评估其信息价值。我们评估了七个 LLM 对 77,484 条推文在 10 个人道主义援助类别上的分类，发现 Qwen3（8B 参数）模型表现最佳，除一个类别外在所有类别中均取得最高 F1 分数。在第二个任务中，分类结果作为上下文输入，针对每条推文按六个成熟指标评估其对接灾人员可行动性的信息价值。我们观察到 Gemma 3（4B 参数）模型在该任务上优于其他模型，在大多数类别中取得最高召回率。这项工作表明，相对较小、可边缘部署的 LLM 能够在资源受限环境中对可行动信息进行优先排序。通过集成信息价值评估，我们的框架推动了从非结构化社交媒体流中自动提炼高效用知识以支持灾害响应决策，并展示了使用可运行在单张 8 GB GPU 上的 LLM 进行战术边缘应用的路径。
translation.brief: 针对灾害社交媒体信息是否足以支持行动决策评估不足的问题，用小型可边缘部署的 LLM 完成推文分类和信息价值评估，筛选 Qwen3 与 Gemma 3 分别作为分类与 VoI 排序的最佳模型。

papers.title: AutoEMatic: Runtime-Adaptive Mixed-Precision LLM Inference via Automatic Exponent-Mantissa Refinement
papers.abstract: Existing LLM post-training quantization techniques determine precision before inference begins, yet the precision a model requires varies dynamically across prompts, layers, and inference phases. We present AutoEMatic, a full-stack co-design that adapts the precision of weights, activations, and the KV cache at runtime. A lightweight policy selects each layer's precision at every prefill and decode step from two runtime signals: the entropy of the next-token distribution and the magnitude of each layer's update to its hidden states. This runtime adaptation is made practical by AutoFP, a multi-scale floating-point format that derives 2-, 4-, and 6-bit precisions from a single NVFP4 base format. We realize AutoEMatic on two targets: GPU kernels that execute AutoFP on NVFP4 Tensor Cores, and an accelerator whose vector MAC datapath executes all AutoFP formats natively. Across reasoning and agentic benchmarks, AutoEMatic improves accuracy by up to 21.7% over NVFP4 and matches group-scaled FP6 accuracy on most benchmarks, using 4.9 bits per weight versus 4.5 for NVFP4. On GB300 GPUs, AutoEMatic retains approximately 90-98% of NVFP4 decode throughput across the evaluated configurations. Furthermore, the AutoEMatic accelerator reduces latency by 1.6-2.3x and energy by 7-23% compared to an accelerator with NVFP4-only datapath at iso-accuracy.

translation.title: AutoEMatic：通过自动指数-尾数精化实现运行时自适应混合精度 LLM 推理
translation.abstract: 现有的 LLM 训练后量化技术在推理开始前就确定了精度，但模型所需的精度会随提示、层和推理阶段动态变化。我们提出 AutoEMatic，一个全栈协同设计，可在运行时自适应地调整权重、激活和 KV cache 的精度。一个轻量级策略在每次 prefill 和 decode 步骤中，基于两个运行时信号选择每层的精度：下一 token 分布的熵和每层对其隐藏状态更新的幅度。这一运行时自适应通过 AutoFP 得以实用化，AutoFP 是一种多尺度浮点格式，可从单一的 NVFP4 基础格式派生出 2、4、6 比特精度。我们在两个目标上实现 AutoEMatic：在 NVFP4 Tensor Core 上执行 AutoFP 的 GPU kernel，以及其向量 MAC 数据通路原生执行所有 AutoFP 格式的加速器。在推理和智能体基准上，AutoEMatic 相比 NVFP4 将准确率提升最高达 21.7%，并在多数基准上匹敌分组缩放的 FP6 准确率，每权重比特数为 4.9，而 NVFP4 为 4.5。在 GB300 GPU 上，AutoEMatic 在所评估配置下保持 NVFP4 解码吞吐量的约 90-98%。此外，在等准确率条件下，AutoEMatic 加速器相比仅支持 NVFP4 数据通路的加速器将延迟降低 1.6-2.3 倍，能耗降低 7-23%。
translation.brief: 针对训练后量化精度固定而模型实际精度需求随输入和阶段动态变化的问题，提出 AutoEMatic，利用 token 分布熵和隐藏状态更新幅度在运行时逐层自适应选择精度，并配合 AutoFP 多尺度浮点格式和软硬件协同实现高效推理。

papers.title: AVCORP: Identifying and Resisting Deception via Communication Theory and Theory of Mind
papers.abstract: Today's LLM-based agents are vulnerable to deception by users and other agents. Defending against deception requires Theory of Mind (ToM) reasoning to infer the beliefs and goals of others as well as modeling tactics based on communication theory. To enable training models to detect deception, we adopt the well-known deception game, Avalon. We present a corpus, AVCORP, of 5,000 annotated utterances from 250 games of Avalon. AVCORP includes (1) 37 tactics mapped to a 4x4 behavior matrix, and (2) reasoning traces capturing abductive hypotheses, suspicion levels, and nested ToM beliefs. We train Qwen3-8B on AVCORP and evaluate it on 25 held-out games and 20 games played by humans. On held-out games, our best trained detector outperforms its untrained baseline and frontier models (GPT-5.6 Sol, Gemini 3.1 Pro, DeepSeek-V4-Pro), matching Claude Opus 5.5. On human games, every trained detector exceeds the untrained model in F1 score across all rounds.

translation.title: AVCORP：基于通信理论与心智理论的欺骗识别与抵抗
translation.abstract: 当今基于 LLM 的智能体容易受到用户和其他智能体的欺骗。防御欺骗需要心智理论（ToM）推理来推断他人的信念和目标，以及基于通信理论的策略建模。为使模型能够训练以检测欺骗，我们采用了著名的欺骗游戏 Avalon。我们提出了一个语料库 AVCORP，包含 250 局 Avalon 游戏中的 5,000 条标注话语。AVCORP 包括：（1）映射到 4x4 行为矩阵的 37 种策略；（2）捕获溯因假设、怀疑程度和嵌套 ToM 信念的推理轨迹。我们在 AVCORP 上训练 Qwen3-8B，并在 25 局保留游戏和 20 局真人游戏中进行评估。在保留游戏上，我们训练出的最佳检测器优于未训练基线和前沿模型（GPT-5.6 Sol、Gemini 3.1 Pro、DeepSeek-V4-Pro），与 Claude Opus 5.5 相当。在真人游戏上，所有训练后的检测器在所有轮次中的 F1 分数均超过未训练模型。
translation.brief: 针对 LLM 智能体易被欺骗的问题，通过构建带策略与 ToM 推理轨迹标注的 Avalon 游戏语料库 AVCORP 来训练欺骗检测模型。

papers.title: The Storage View Of KV Cache: Characterizing Cache Behavior Across LLM Workloads
papers.abstract: Modern LLM serving increasingly extends KV caches beyond GPU memory into host DRAM, SSDs, and remote storage, yet these stores remain largely governed by workload-agnostic policies such as LRU and fixed TTLs. We ask what execution context is needed by storage to make retention, reclamation, and placement decisions across heterogeneous workloads. We characterize KV-cache reuse, lifetime, and footprint at block granularity across 11 production and public traces spanning chat, API serving, RAG, coding agents, tool-using agents, and multi-lineage workflows. We examine reuse sources, recurrence timing and frequency, useful lifetimes, and storage consumption. Across workloads, KV state takes two recurring forms. Single-session state is reused within one execution: its footprint grows as sessions deepen and accumulates across concurrent sessions; it can remain useful through long idle periods but loses value at session completion. Multi-session state recurs across sessions of the same workload, outlives individual sessions, and spans hot prefixes and a large infrequent tail. While prior systems often exploit application-, agent-, or workflow-specific knowledge, our results suggest that three generic signals (a workload identifier, a session identifier, and session completion) expose much of the structure needed for KV-storage management. Trace-driven comparisons show that workload-specific recurrence estimates retain up to 22% more within-session hits and reduce dead state by up to 40%; a session completion signal eliminates the fundamental idle-time reclamation tradeoff for single-session state; and session-aware reuse classification identifies shared state 4-700x more selectively than request-level access counts. These results motivate a small cross-layer interface for workload-aware KV storage without application-specific semantics.

translation.title: KV Cache 的存储视角：刻画 LLM 工作负载下的缓存行为
translation.abstract: 现代 LLM 服务日益将 KV cache 扩展到 GPU 显存之外的主机 DRAM、SSD 和远程存储，然而这些存储在很大程度上仍受 LRU 和固定 TTL 等与工作负载无关的策略支配。我们探讨存储需要什么样的执行上下文，才能在异构工作负载下做出保留、回收和放置决策。我们在 11 个涵盖聊天、API 服务、RAG、编程智能体、工具使用智能体和多谱系工作流的生产及公开 trace 上，以块粒度刻画了 KV cache 的复用、生命周期和占用。我们考察了复用来源、复发时机与频率、有效生命周期和存储消耗。在各工作负载中，KV 状态呈现两种常见形式。单会话状态在一次执行内复用：其占用随会话深入而增长，并在并发会话间累积；它可以在长时间空闲期后仍有效，但在会话结束时失去价值。多会话状态在同一工作负载的不同会话间复发，比单个会话更持久，涵盖热前缀和大量低频尾部。虽然已有系统常常利用应用、智能体或工作流特定的知识，但我们的结果表明，三个通用信号（工作负载标识符、会话标识符和会话完成）即可暴露 KV 存储管理所需的大部分结构。基于 trace 的对比显示，工作负载特定的复发估计可多保留最高 22% 的会话内命中并减少最高 40% 的死状态；会话完成信号消除了单会话状态在空闲期回收上的根本权衡；会话感知的复用分类识别共享状态的选择性比请求级访问计数高 4-700 倍。这些结果促使我们设计一个小的跨层接口，实现无需应用特定语义的工作负载感知 KV 存储。
translation.brief: 针对 KV cache 跨层存储管理缺乏工作负载感知的问题，通过对 11 个 trace 的块粒度行为刻画，提出用工作负载标识、会话标识和会话完成三个通用信号指导缓存决策。

papers.title: Ensemble Routing for Prompt-Adaptive Cost-Aware LLM Inference
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly support Web-based services that must balance response quality and inference cost across heterogeneous requests. Conventional routing selects one model per prompt, while fixed ensembles cannot adapt their composition and cost to individual requests. We introduce PISA, a prompt-adaptive, cost-aware single-model router, and PISA-E, its extension to ensemble routing. At the core of both methods, PISA combines soft cluster memberships with model-specific predictors to estimate individual model capabilities. Building on these estimates, PISA-E jointly selects ensemble composition and cardinality under an explicit cost--quality preference that can be adjusted at inference time without retraining. A tractable ensemble-success surrogate and efficient candidate selection enable this extension without ensemble-specific training. Across four LLM routing benchmarks under in-distribution (ID) and out-of-distribution (OOD) conditions, PISA achieves the highest macro-average cost--performance hypervolume among the evaluated single-model routers in both settings. Meanwhile, PISA-E achieves the highest macro-average task performance among the evaluated ensemble approaches when prioritizing response quality, surpassing the strongest competitors by 2.09 and 2.87 percentage points under ID and OOD conditions, respectively. At selected lower-cost operating points, it also exceeds the strongest ensemble competitors' macro-average task performance while reducing average inference cost by approximately 36% and 25%, respectively. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of prompt-adaptive capability estimation for both single-model routing and selective ensembling.

translation.title: 面向提示自适应、成本感知 LLM 推理的集成路由
translation.abstract: 大型语言模型（LLM）日益支撑需要在异构请求之间平衡响应质量与推理成本的 Web 服务。传统路由为每个提示选择单一模型，而固定集成无法根据单个请求调整其组成与成本。我们提出提示自适应、成本感知的单模型路由器 PISA，及其扩展到集成路由的 PISA-E。两种方法的核心都是 PISA 将软聚类隶属度与模型专属预测器相结合来估计各模型能力。基于这些估计，PISA-E 在可推理时调整且无需重训练的显式成本-质量偏好下，联合选择集成的组成与基数。一个可处理的集成成功代理目标和高效的候选选择使这一扩展无需集成专属训练。在四个 LLM 路由基准上的同分布（ID）与分布外（OOD）条件下，PISA 在评估的单模型路由器中均取得最高的宏平均成本-性能超体积。同时，PISA-E 在优先响应质量时，在评估的集成方法中取得最高的宏平均任务性能，在 ID 和 OOD 条件下分别超越最强竞争者 2.09 和 2.87 个百分点。在选定的低成本运行点上，它还超过最强集成竞争者的宏平均任务性能，同时平均推理成本分别降低约 36% 和 25%。这些结果证明了提示自适应能力估计在单模型路由与选择性集成中的有效性。
translation.brief: 针对单模型路由无法适应异构请求质量-成本权衡的问题，提出通过软聚类与模型能力预测进行提示自适应路由，并扩展为可动态选择集成组成与规模的成本感知集成路由 PISA-E。

papers.title: Jais 3: Introducing Arabic-centric Agentic AI
papers.abstract: We present Jais 3, a fleet of six open, Arabic-centric agentic language models ranging from 0.9B to 375B parameters. Jais 3 is built to complete tasks for Arabic speakers, not only to answer questions in plain text: it is trained to plan multi-step tasks, call tools and Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, operate a terminal, search the web, and read, edit, and produce PDF, spreadsheet, and presentation files, while communicating with the user in Arabic. Instead of pretraining from scratch, we adapt each model of the fully open K2 Horizon fleet to Arabic through continual pretraining, followed by supervised fine-tuning (SFT), final token preference optimization (FTPO), and reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR). We combine natural Arabic text with translated, transliterated, and synthetic Arabic, and replay the base model's own training data to keep its reasoning, agentic, and English abilities. Jais 3 covers Modern Standard Arabic and the major regional dialects, follows instructions with Arabic-specific constraints, and inherits the 512K-token context window of K2 Horizon (all models except the 0.9B). To our knowledge, its 375B model is the largest open Arabic-centric language model to date. For evaluation, we revisit how Arabic models are assessed, moving to fully generative evaluation on audited Arabic benchmarks. Across model sizes, Jais 3 matches or outperforms open-weight models of comparable size on Arabic and agentic benchmarks, with particularly strong agentic capabilities and Arabic instruction following, and far fewer hallucinations. We release the weights and the checkpoints from every training stage of all six models, together with samples of the training data, the data recipes and training configurations, the training logs, the audited benchmarks, and the evaluation code.
authors: Sheikh Khalid bin Khalifa Al Nahyan

translation.title: Jais 3：推出以阿拉伯语为中心的智能体 AI
translation.abstract: 我们提出 Jais 3，一套六款开放的、以阿拉伯语为中心的智能体语言模型，参数量从 0.9B 到 375B。Jais 3 旨在为阿拉伯语使用者完成任务，而不仅是以纯文本回答问题：它被训练用于规划多步任务、调用工具和 Model Context Protocol（MCP）服务器、操作终端、搜索网络，以及阅读、编辑和生成 PDF、电子表格和演示文稿文件，同时以阿拉伯语与用户交流。我们没有从零开始预训练，而是通过对完全开放的 K2 Horizon 系列每个模型进行持续预训练来适配阿拉伯语，随后进行监督微调（SFT）、最终 token 偏好优化（FTPO）以及可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）。我们将自然阿拉伯语文本与翻译、转写和合成的阿拉伯语相结合，并回放基础模型自身的训练数据以保持其推理、智能体和英语能力。Jais 3 覆盖现代标准阿拉伯语和主要地区方言，遵循带有阿拉伯语特定约束的指令，并继承 K2 Horizon 的 512K-token 上下文窗口（除 0.9B 外的所有模型）。据我们所知，其 375B 模型是迄今最大的开放阿拉伯语中心语言模型。在评估方面，我们重新审视了阿拉伯语模型的评估方式，转向在经过审核的阿拉伯语基准上进行完全生成式评估。在各模型规模上，Jais 3 在阿拉伯语和智能体基准上与同等规模的开放权重模型相当或更优，尤其具有出色的智能体能力和阿拉伯语指令遵循，且幻觉远少。我们发布所有六个模型的权重及每个训练阶段的检查点，连同训练数据样本、数据配方与训练配置、训练日志、审核过的基准和评估代码。
translation.brief: 针对阿拉伯语用户缺乏开放智能体模型的问题，通过持续预训练加 SFT、FTPO 和 RLVR 将开放 K2 Horizon 模型适配为阿拉伯语中心的多规模智能体模型系列 Jais 3。

papers.title: CoRA-Bench: Evaluating Evidence Preservation by Context Selectors Under Token Budgets
papers.abstract: Context selection can reduce input length during long-input inference but can remove evidence required to answer a query. We introduce CoRA-Bench, a benchmark for evaluating evidence preservation under shared token budgets. We compare head and tail truncation, BM25, dense retrieval, dense retrieval with reranking, LLMLingua-2, and Provence across BABILong, LOONG Financial Spotlight, a custom NoLiMa diagnostic, and LongMemEval. Evidence-preservation results reveal task-dependent tradeoffs: BM25 achieves 0.921 supporting-fact recall on BABILong at 128K, dense retrieval and dense reranking each achieve 0.908 needle recall on NoLiMa at 64K, and dense retrieval achieves 0.993 answer-bearing-turn recall on LongMemEval at 64K. Evidence, token retention, and complementary reader evaluations use the same selected contexts. Reader evaluations use dataset-native answer metrics and three runs on the same questions, with paired bootstrap confidence intervals. At a 32K budget, BM25 achieves 46.20% BABILong answer accuracy and dense retrieval achieves 71.13% LongMemEval accuracy. The results show that method rankings vary across evidence types and between evidence recall and downstream accuracy.

translation.title: CoRA-Bench：在 token 预算下评估上下文选择器的证据保留能力
translation.abstract: 上下文选择可以在长输入推理时缩短输入长度，但可能移除回答查询所需的证据。我们提出 CoRA-Bench，一个在共享 token 预算下评估证据保留的基准。我们在 BABILong、LOONG Financial Spotlight、自建的 NoLiMa 诊断集和 LongMemEval 上比较头尾截断、BM25、稠密检索、带重排序的稠密检索、LLMLingua-2 和 Provence。证据保留结果揭示了任务相关的权衡：BM25 在 128K 的 BABILong 上达到 0.921 的支持事实召回率，稠密检索和稠密重排序在 64K 的 NoLiMa 上分别达到 0.908 的针召回率，稠密检索在 64K 的 LongMemEval 上达到 0.993 的承载答案轮次召回率。证据、token 保留和互补的阅读器评估使用相同的所选上下文。阅读器评估使用数据集原生答案指标，并在相同问题上运行三次，配合配对 bootstrap 置信区间。在 32K 预算下，BM25 在 BABILong 上达到 46.20% 的答案准确率，稠密检索在 LongMemEval 上达到 71.13% 的准确率。结果表明，方法排名随证据类型不同而变化，且证据召回率与下游准确率之间的排名也不一致。
translation.brief: 针对上下文选择可能丢失回答所需证据的问题，构建 CoRA-Bench 基准，在统一 token 预算下系统比较多种选择方法的证据保留与下游准确率。

papers.title: PACE: Keeping the Right Tokens in the KV Cache Is Not Enough for Long-Horizon LLM Agents
papers.abstract: Long-horizon LLM agents accumulate sessions of up to millions of tokens, far more key-value (KV) cache than one GPU holds, so serving systems keep a small budget of tokens and evict the rest. Eviction methods differ in which tokens they keep but share one goal: that the tokens a later step needs are still cached. We show this is not enough. In 100K-token coding sessions on Qwen3-8B with a 2,048-token budget, a planner-guided policy that keeps over 99% of the needed tokens resident still fails late steps increasingly often: its accuracy falls from 93% to 64% as the gap between a definition and its use grows from 2K to 90K tokens, at residency 0.996. The needed tokens are resident but unretrievable: what grows is their rotary-position distance to the query. We present PACE (Planner-Aware Context Engine), a KV-cache engine that couples plan-aware retention, in which the agent's planner tells the cache which context future steps will read, with bounded positions, which renumber kept tokens so their rotary distance to the query stays below 8K at any session length. In a pre-registered evaluation on fresh tasks, PACE passes 97% of hidden unit tests at 100K tokens, against 42% for H2O and 3% for SnapKV under the same budget, and needs both components: either alone reaches 63% (the combination beats each, p < 10^-4). The result holds with length: in 1M- and 2M-token sessions on one 24 GB GPU, with definitions written 0.9M and 1.8M tokens before use, PACE passes 99% and 100% of checks and recalls every session fact, while bounded positions without foresight falls from 33% to 13%; PACE holds under 0.7 GB of KV state where the full cache would need 147-295 GB. Renumbering is exact, costs no measurable perplexity, and adds 9% wall time. On Mistral-7B, whose coding ability caps it at 40% even with nothing evicted, PACE stays at that ceiling while retention alone falls below it.

papers.title: FedLoVA: Value-Only Aggregation for Federated LoRA Fine-Tuning of Large Language Models
papers.abstract: Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) is a popular parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) method for fine-tuning of large language models (LLMs), especially in federated learning, due to its strong performance and communication efficiency. In practice, LoRA is applied to the query and value projections of transformer layers without considering the distinct roles of these components. In this work, we analyze the impact of these projections in federated fine-tuning of LLMs using LoRA and observe that the value projection converges significantly faster than the query projection. Motivated by this finding, we propose FedLoVA, a federated fine-tuning framework that trains LoRA adapters on both query and value projections locally while sharing only the value projection with the server. This approach reduces communication overhead while improving convergence efficiency. Experiments on natural language understanding, multilingual sentiment analysis, and generation tasks show that FedLoVA reduces the communication cost by up to $7.8\times$ compared to existing federated LLM fine-tuning baselines while achieving comparable or better performance. The code is available at: https://github.com/EnsiehKhazaei/FedLoVA.

papers.title: Do large language models rank moral values? A transitivity test of moral competence
papers.abstract: LLMs are increasingly used to support decisions that require moral consideration. While LLMs perform well on morality benchmarks from psychology and philosophy, producing appropriate outputs on these benchmarks (moral performance) does not establish that an LLM weighs competing moral values at stake in a decision (moral competence). We test a minimal, necessary condition for such weighing: that an ordinal ranking can represent LLM moral choices. Such a ranking requires transitivity. To assess transitivity, we presented LLMs with pairwise trade-offs among moral value violations in vignette choice sets and extracted resulting choice probabilities from first-token distributions. Tested against three stochastic transitive choice models, most choice sets admitted weak or unstable orderings. Aggregating an LLM's responses, a common practice in LLM moral evaluation, produced transitive structure that matched no individual choice set. Evaluations of AI morality should establish that choices are structured before asking whether they are aligned.

papers.title: I play of the cello: Evaluating Constructional Bleeding in Multilingual LLMs with CALQUE
papers.abstract: Languages use different morphosyntactic strategies to express the same meaning. Speakers of multiple languages are able to apply strategies from one language to another, either by mistake or intentionally, to produce a literal translation, or calque. Considering that large language models (LLMs) have been shown to generalize crosslingually, despite being predominantly trained on English, we investigate whether they overgeneralize constructional strategies from English to other languages. To test this, we create a dataset of 5583 sentence pairs across seven languages, matching literal translations of strategies from English into other languages, and literal translations of the other languages' strategies into English. We then quantify constructional bleeding by measuring how often strategies from English are assigned a higher probability than native strategies. We find that models often fail to assign higher probabilities to native strategies and tend to prefer English-derived strategies even when evaluating sentences in other languages. Our findings highlight the limitations of the current English-dominant training paradigm.

papers.title: Adversarial Evaluation of Large Language Models for Patient-Friendly Radiology Report Summarization
papers.abstract: Purpose: To develop and validate a scalable adversarial evaluation framework for assessing the robustness of large language models (LLMs) that generate patient-friendly summaries of radiology reports. Methods: We introduced a clinically grounded adversarial framework that uses controlled term substitutions and impression removals across intensity levels. Using a radiologist-validated adversarial dictionary, we generated adversarial variants of CT and MRI reports. Six LLMs summarized original and adversarial impressions using 2 prompt styles, yielding 18,000 evaluation pairs. Robustness was evaluated with an automated LLM-as-a-judge framework scoring factual faithfulness, sensitivity to adversarial edits, certainty fidelity, and hallucination rate. Failure mode analysis quantified vulnerabilities in incorporating clinical modifiers. Agreement with two radiologists was assessed on 105 cases. Results: GPT-5-mini achieved the highest factual faithfulness and certainty fidelity under both adversarial edits. Under term substitution, hallucinations occurred in 28.1-30.1% of GPT-5-mini summaries, compared with 35.3-36.4% for Claude Sonnet 4.5 and 41.4-41.9% for MedGemma. Impression-removal edits were handled more robustly than term substitutions. Even for the highest-scoring summarizer, substitutions of anatomical terms were not reflected in 23.7% of summaries, diagnostic certainty in 22.3%, and descriptor terms (e.g., "substantial") in 21.2%. Judge-radiologist agreement (macro-F1: 0.55-0.56) was comparable to inter-radiologist agreement (0.53). Conclusions: Adversarial evaluation exposes clinically meaningful failure modes, including missed anatomical modifiers, altered diagnostic certainty, and omitted severity descriptors.

papers.title: Restoring General and Improving Domain-Specific Safety in Fine-Tuned LLMs Without Retraining
papers.abstract: Safety-aligned language models are known to suffer degradation in refusal behavior following domain-specific fine-tuning, even when the fine-tuning data is entirely benign. The predominant mitigation strategy, preference optimization on the fine-tuned model, is computationally expensive and requires domain-specific preference data that is often unavailable in practice. We propose SPECTRA, a training-free, weight-level method that restores refusal behavior by transferring the base model's refusal direction into the fine-tuned model's weights via an activation-aware, low-rank update, requiring no gradient-based optimization or domain-specific safety data. The low-rank design restricts the intervention to the subspace most causally active on harmful inputs, leaving benign behavior largely undisturbed by construction. Empirically, SPECTRA substantially improves refusal behavior across a comprehensive safety evaluation, while preserving general coherence, domain-specific knowledge, and producing negligible change in false refusal rates.

translation.title: 无需重训即可恢复微调 LLM 的通用安全性并提升领域特定安全性
translation.abstract: 已知安全对齐的语言模型在领域特定微调后会出现拒绝行为退化，即使微调数据完全无害也是如此。主流的缓解策略——在微调模型上进行偏好优化——计算代价高昂，且需要实践中往往不可得的领域特定偏好数据。我们提出 SPECTRA，一种免训练的权重级方法，通过激活感知的低秩更新将基础模型的拒绝方向迁移到微调模型的权重中，从而恢复拒绝行为，无需基于梯度的优化或领域特定安全数据。低秩设计将干预限制在对有害输入最具因果作用的子空间内，从构造上保证对良性扰动的行为基本不受影响。实证表明，SPECTRA 在全面的安全评估中显著提升拒绝行为，同时保持通用连贯性、领域知识，且误拒率变化可忽略不计。
translation.brief: 解决领域微调导致 LLM 拒绝行为退化的问题，核心方法是通过激活感知的低秩权重更新将基座模型的拒绝方向迁移进微调模型，无需重训或安全数据。

papers.title: Conformal Fair Decoding for Large Language Model Recommenders
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) can generate personalized recommendations without task-specific training, but changing a protected attribute while holding interaction history fixed can alter the semantic content of recommended items. We study fairness control when model weights and full-vocabulary logits are unavailable. We propose Fair- Rec, an item-level decoding framework that uses an offline-calibrated semantic-disparity threshold and controls candidate selection as recommendation lists are generated. A hard variant filters candidates against the threshold; a soft variant trades off candidate likelihood and disparity while adapting a penalty using observed violations. Under an explicit uniform enforceability assumption, we establish a pathwise O(1/T) upper bound on the excess empirical violation rate of the soft decoder. Experiments on MovieLens-1M and Amazon Movies & TV using Qwen3-8B and Llama3.1-8B-Instruct show that the soft variant lowers measured counterfactual disparity relative to zero- =shot recommendation, UP5, and FACTER, while retaining competitive HR@10 and NDCG@10.

translation.title: 面向大型语言模型推荐器的保形公平解码
translation.abstract: 大型语言模型（LLM）无需任务特定训练即可生成个性化推荐，但在交互历史固定的情况下改变受保护属性会改变推荐物品的语义内容。我们研究在模型权重与全词表 logits 不可得时的公平性控制。我们提出 Fair-Rec，一种物品级解码框架，使用离线校准的语义差异阈值，并在生成推荐列表的过程中控制候选选择。硬变体按阈值过滤候选；软变体在候选似然与差异之间权衡，并利用观测到的违规自适应调整惩罚。在显式一致可执行性假设下，我们为软解码器的超额经验违规率建立了逐路径 O(1/T) 上界。在 MovieLens-1M 和 Amazon Movies & TV 上使用 Qwen3-8B 和 Llama3.1-8B-Instruct 的实验表明，软变体相对零样本推荐、UP5 和 FACTER 降低了测得的反事实差异，同时保持有竞争力的 HR@10 和 NDCG@10。
translation.brief: 解决黑盒 LLM 推荐中的反事实公平性问题，核心方法是离线校准语义差异阈值并在解码时逐物品控制候选选择的 Fair-Rec 框架。

papers.title: Continual Instruction Tuning for LLM-ased Management of Continuum Resources
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly explored for resource management across the Cloud-Edge continuum. However, embedding LLMs directly inside latency-sensitive control loops places inference latency, execution jitter, and hallucination risks on the critical path. This study argues for a different use of LLMs: a continually instruction-tuned intent compiler that runs once per management intent or declared context change, above a fast, deterministic tactical controller that handles all low-latency runtime actions. We formulate intent compilation as a continual instruction tuning problem, because management intents arrive sequentially and accumulate while infrastructure and workload contexts drift. Unlike recent LLM-based management frameworks, our design scores the model's outputs by execution, so that catastrophic forgetting can be measured in the executed objective of the underlying controller. On a continuum simulator with a 2B backbone and parameter-efficient adapters, preliminary results show that naive sequential tuning forgets earlier intents in the executed objective, that replay of stored examples nearly prevents this forgetting, and that the tuned compact compiler performs on par with simpler translators while being more robust than a grammar parser to rephrased intents.

translation.title: 面向 LLM 云边连续体资源管理的持续指令微调
translation.abstract: 大型语言模型（LLM）正被越来越多地探索用于云边连续体的资源管理。然而，将 LLM 直接嵌入延迟敏感的控制回路会将推理延迟、执行抖动和幻觉风险置于关键路径上。本研究主张另一种 LLM 用法：一个持续指令微调的意图编译器，在每个管理意图或声明的上下文变更时运行一次，位于处理所有低延迟运行时动作的快速确定性战术控制器之上。由于管理意图按顺序到达并累积，而基础设施与工作负载上下文持续漂移，我们将意图编译形式化为持续指令微调问题。与近期的基于 LLM 的管理框架不同，我们的设计通过执行来评估模型输出，从而可以在底层控制器的执行目标中度量灾难性遗忘。在采用 2B 骨干与参数高效适配器的连续体模拟器上，初步结果显示：朴素的顺序微调会在执行目标中遗忘较早意图；对存储样本的回放几乎可以避免这种遗忘；微调后的紧凑编译器与更简单的翻译器表现相当，且相比语法解析器对意图改写更鲁棒。
translation.brief: 解决云边资源管理中 LLM 推理延迟与灾难性遗忘问题，核心方法是将意图编译形式化为持续指令微调并以执行结果度量遗忘、配合样本回放。

papers.title: Robust Analysis of First-Price Auctions with Large Supply
papers.abstract: This paper performs a robust analysis of welfare (i.e., the price of anarchy) in multi-unit first-price auctions with independent private values and unit-demand bidders. We employ a smoothness framework (see \citealp{ST-13}) to analyze the price of anarchy when supply is large. The main barrier to analysis in this framework is a worst-case bid distribution that establishes a lower bound on the price of anarchy of $1- \frac{1}{e}$. We show that such worst-case distributions cannot arise in equilibrium when agents' values satisfy a mild density lower bound condition. This characterization leads to novel asymptotic lower bounds. In particular, the price of anarchy for $ε$-approximate equilibrium as the number of units goes to infinity is at least $1-Θ\left(ε\log \left(\frac{1}ε\right)\right)$. Our analysis relies on a key structural property of equilibrium bid distributions: for a welfare analysis in any multi-unit first-price auction, it is without loss to analyze (approximate) equilibria with no atoms. In addition to this, we establish continuity and monotonicity properties of Bayes-Nash equilibria. We believe these results are of independent interest.

translation.title: 大供给量一价拍卖的鲁棒性分析
translation.abstract: 本文对具有独立私有估值和单位需求竞拍者的多物品一价拍卖进行福利（即无政府代价）的鲁棒性分析。我们采用平滑性框架（见 \citealp{ST-13}）分析供给量较大时的无政府代价。该框架分析的主要障碍是一种最坏情形出价分布，它给出了无政府代价 $1-\frac{1}{e}$ 的下界。我们证明，当竞拍者估值满足温和的密度下界条件时，这类最坏情形分布不可能在均衡中出现。这一刻画带来了新颖的渐近下界：特别地，当物品数量趋于无穷时，$ε$-近似均衡的无政府代价至少为 $1-Θ\left(ε\log \left(\frac{1}ε\right)\right)$。我们的分析依赖均衡出价分布的一个关键结构性质：在任何多物品一价拍卖的福利分析中，不失一般性可以只分析无原子的（近似）均衡。此外，我们还建立了 Bayes-Nash 均衡的连续性与单调性性质。我们相信这些结果具有独立的学术价值。
translation.brief: 解决多物品一价拍卖在大供给量下无政府代价分析受最坏出价分布限制的问题，核心方法是在密度下界条件下排除最坏分布并证明均衡可取无原子形式的渐近下界分析。

papers.title: Longtail-SWE: High-Quality SWE Tasks for Underrepresented Languages
papers.abstract: Challenging repository-level benchmarks remain limited for many programming language ecosystems, where filtering scarce candidates with ambiguous descriptions or defective tests can discard valuable engineering problems. We introduce Longtail-SWE, a benchmark of 202 issue-resolution tasks across 13 languages with limited coverage in existing repository-level benchmarks: Clojure, Dart, Elixir, Erlang, F#, Haskell, Julia, Kotlin, Lua, OCaml, R, Scala, and Swift. Its construction uses a solver--judge--repairer pipeline: a solver attempts each candidate task, and a judge reviews the task together with the solver's trajectory and test results to guide revisions to tests and task descriptions. These revisions aim to correct tests that reject valid alternative implementations or accept incorrect solutions while retaining challenging tasks and preserving their intended requirements. We evaluate nine model configurations, including frontier models, and analyze task-solving performance, consistency across repeated attempts, and resource usage. We release all benchmark instances, executable environments, complete construction and evaluation tooling, and agent trajectories, together with an additional set of easier tasks to support evaluation of smaller models.

translation.title: Longtail-SWE：面向代表性不足语言的高质量软件工程任务
translation.abstract: 对许多编程语言生态而言，具有挑战性的仓库级基准仍然稀缺，而用模糊描述或缺陷测试过滤稀少候选会丢弃有价值的工程问题。我们提出 Longtail-SWE，一个涵盖 13 种在现有仓库级基准中覆盖有限的语言的 202 个问题解决任务基准：Clojure、Dart、Elixir、Erlang、F#、Haskell、Julia、Kotlin、Lua、OCaml、R、Scala 和 Swift。其构建采用求解器—评审者—修复者流水线：求解器尝试每个候选任务，评审者结合求解器的轨迹和测试结果审查任务，以指导对测试和任务描述的修订。这些修订旨在纠正那些拒绝有效的替代实现或接受错误解法的测试，同时保留有挑战性的任务并维持其预期需求。我们评估了包括前沿模型在内的九种模型配置，并分析任务解决表现、重复尝试的一致性和资源使用。我们发布了所有基准实例、可执行环境、完整的构建与评估工具以及智能体轨迹，并附带一组更简单的任务以支持较小模型的评估。
translation.brief: 解决代表性不足编程语言缺乏高质量仓库级 SWE 基准的问题，核心方法是采用求解器—评审者—修复者流水线构建 13 种语言共 202 个问题解决任务的 Longtail-SWE 基准。

papers.title: Plug-and-Play Verifier for Decoupling Process Reward in Stabilizing Long-Horizon Agentic Reasoning
papers.abstract: Stabilizing long-horizon reasoning requires intelligent agents to sustain useful progress across successive reasoning steps and tool interactions. Such agents are typically trained with reinforcement learning (RL), where actor-critic RL uses a learnable critic network to estimate step advantages, while critic-free methods such as GRPO eliminate critic models and rely mostly on the group variants of sparse outcome-only rewards. Both reward types leave partially useful failed trajectories either implicit or indistinguishable from entirely unproductive ones, and as reasoning horizons grow, it becomes difficult to maintain consistent reasoning trajectories. In this work, we propose a \textit{plug-and-play verifier} framework for stabilizing long-horizon reasoning through explicit verification of intermediate reasoning artifacts. Specifically, the framework decouples process verification through a unified interface that extracts intermediate reasoning artifacts from agent running trajectories, evaluates them using domain-specific verifiers, and aggregates the verification scores as bounded process reward. Then, we combine our dense verified process rewards and the sparse outcome rewards through a two-stage post-training schedule. We showed that with plug-and-play verifiers, we further stabilize the reasoning steps as last-mile self-reflection and self-consistency. Typical evaluation on HotpotQA using Qwen3.5-4B achieves a superior accuracy (60.18\%), outperforming the standard GRPO baseline (57.73\%). Our results suggest that plug-and-play verifiers provide a modular approach to learn more stable and reliable reasoning behaviors over long horizons.

translation.title: 用于解耦过程奖励以稳定长程智能体推理的即插即用验证器
translation.abstract: 稳定长程推理需要智能体在连续的推理步骤和工具交互中保持有效进展。此类智能体通常通过强化学习（RL）训练，其中 actor-critic RL 使用可学习的 critic 网络估计步骤优势，而 GRPO 等无 critic 方法则消除 critic 模型，主要依赖稀疏的仅结果奖励的组变体。两类奖励都将部分有用的失败轨迹隐式化或与完全无用的轨迹混为一谈，随着推理范围的增长，很难维持一致的推理轨迹。在这项工作中，我们提出一个即插即用验证器框架，通过对中间推理产物进行显式验证来稳定长程推理。具体而言，该框架通过统一接口解耦过程验证，从智能体运行轨迹中提取中间推理产物，使用领域特定验证器对其进行评估，并将验证分数聚合为有界过程奖励。随后，我们通过两阶段后训练调度将稠密的已验证过程奖励与稀疏结果奖励相结合。我们表明，借助即插即用验证器，我们可以进一步稳定推理步骤，作为最后一英里的自我反思和自我一致性。在 Qwen3.5-4B 上对 HotpotQA 的典型评估实现了更优的准确率（60.18%），超过标准 GRPO 基线（57.73%）。我们的结果表明，即插即用验证器为在长程范围内学习更稳定可靠的推理行为提供了模块化方法。
translation.brief: 为解决长程智能体推理不稳定问题，提出通过统一接口对中间推理产物进行显式验证并聚合为有界过程奖励、与稀疏结果奖励结合的即插即用验证器框架。

papers.title: Multi-objective drift-aware MLOps agent for model retraining
papers.abstract: Deployed ML models face non-stationary data and delayed labels, yet most retraining strategies rely on fixed schedules or brittle drift thresholds that ignore operational cost. In this setting, retraining is a sequential decision problem rather than a one-time threshold choice. We present DARE (Drift-Aware Retraining Engine), an offline, event-driven retraining framework that separates ingestion, monitoring, policy decisions, training, and logging through explicit schemas and deterministic replay. We compare DARE against practical heuristic retraining baselines, including fixed-interval, threshold-persistence, and action-rate-matched fixed scheduling policies. On Airline, the locked LinUCB policy achieves a higher mean F1 while substantially reducing intervention frequency relative to heuristic and action-rate-matched baselines. Additional runtime-calibrated evaluation shows that these gains persist when measured using the cumulative update wall-clock time. These results suggest that conservative sequential retraining policies can improve performance while reducing unnecessary operational overhead under delayed feedback.

translation.title: 用于模型重训练的多目标漂移感知 MLOps 智能体
translation.abstract: 已部署的 ML 模型面临非平稳数据和标签延迟问题，但大多数重训练策略依赖固定调度或脆弱的漂移阈值，且忽略运营成本。在此场景下，重训练是一个序贯决策问题，而非一次性的阈值选择。我们提出 DARE（Drift-Aware Retraining Engine，漂移感知重训练引擎），这是一个离线、事件驱动的重训练框架，通过显式 schema 和确定性回放将数据接入、监控、策略决策、训练和日志记录分离。我们将 DARE 与实用的启发式重训练基线进行比较，包括固定间隔、阈值持续性和动作速率匹配的固定调度策略。在 Airline 数据集上，锁定的 LinUCB 策略在相对启发式和动作速率匹配基线大幅降低干预频率的同时，取得了更高的平均 F1。额外的运行时校准评估表明，以累计更新的墙上时钟时间衡量时，这些收益依然存在。这些结果表明，保守的序贯重训练策略可以在延迟反馈下提升性能并减少不必要的运营开销。
translation.brief: 为解决部署模型在数据漂移与标签延迟下的重训练时机问题，提出将重训练建模为序贯决策、以事件驱动架构实现分离监控与策略决策的 DARE 漂移感知重训练框架。

papers.title: Repeating Work Can Lower Energy per Successful Goal in LLM Agents
papers.abstract: When a temporary call failure interrupts a tool-using LLM agent, the framework must choose how much completed work to repeat. Repeating less completed work intuitively saves computation, but recovery mechanisms also change subsequent execution and the chance of success. We compare recovery mechanisms by energy per successful goal (EpG), which divides the energy of all task runs (including failed runs) by the number that finish correctly. In controlled vLLM experiments on one node, we measure board energy above idle for eight recovery options on reliably solved multi-turn tasks, with selected comparisons across three model families. For the model tested across all eight options, with the prefix cache retained, starting over has 22 percent lower EpG than continuing after early failures. Under the same cache condition, continuing has 24 percent lower EpG than starting over after late failures. Among all eight recovery options, repeating only the interrupted turn has the lowest observed EpG after early and late tool failures on this model. Holding recovery fixed, retaining the prefix cache reduces prompt tokens needing fresh computation by 86 percent but reduces recovery energy by only 8 percent at contexts up to 7,333 tokens. These measurements and a condition relating recovery energy and success show when repeating work lowers EpG, helping framework developers choose how their agents recover on their intended models and tasks.

translation.title: 重复工作可降低 LLM 智能体每次成功目标的能耗
translation.abstract: 当临时调用失败中断使用工具的 LLM 智能体时，框架必须决定重复多少已完成的工作。重复更少的工作直觉上节省计算，但恢复机制也会改变后续执行和成功概率。我们用每次成功目标能耗（EpG）比较恢复机制，EpG 将所有任务运行的能耗（包括失败运行）除以正确完成的次数。在单节点上的受控 vLLM 实验中，我们在可靠解决的多轮任务上测量了八种恢复选项高于空闲状态的整机能耗，并在三个模型家族间进行了选择性比较。对于在全部八种选项上测试的模型，在保留前缀缓存的情况下，早期失败后从头开始比继续执行低 22% 的 EpG。在相同缓存条件下，后期失败后继续执行比从头开始低 24% 的 EpG。在全部八种恢复选项中，仅重复被中断的轮次在该模型早期和晚期工具失败后观察到的 EpG 最低。在恢复方式固定时，保留前缀缓存将需要重新计算的 prompt token 减少 86%，但在上下文长达 7,333 token 时仅将恢复能耗降低 8%。这些测量以及一个关联恢复能耗与成功率的条件表明何时重复工作可降低 EpG，帮助框架开发者为其智能体在目标模型和任务上选择恢复方式。
translation.brief: 为解决工具调用失败后 LLM 智能体恢复策略的选择问题，提出以每次成功目标能耗（EpG）为指标对八种恢复机制进行受控实验比较的方法。

papers.title: Prove What You Can: Hybrid Neurosymbolic Reasoning for Logical Natural Language Inference
papers.abstract: Logical reasoning over natural language requires both semantic interpretation and deductive search. Large language models (LLMs) can propose plausible intermediate derivations, but they often fail to compose them into a complete proof and overpredict uncertainty. Neurosymbolic methods improve search by translating an entire problem into first-order logic and handing it to a prover, but a single bad clause can make the whole translation nonexecutable. We present Hybrid Reasoning, a three-stage pipeline that decouples proposing a proof, validating its steps, and deciding a label. An LLM proposes a structured proof tree with a raw verdict; a theorem prover validates each derivation locally, keeping only the subset it can prove; and an uncertainty-gated repair attempts to re-derive the label from the premises plus the validated derivations, when the raw verdict is UNCERTAIN. Across four benchmarks (FOLIO, ProofWriter, ProverQA, PrOntoQA) and five contemporary LLMs, Hybrid Reasoning is the top-performing method on the two hardest datasets, improving on the strongest baseline by 5.3 points on FOLIO and 4.9 on ProverQA, and reaches ceiling-level accuracy on the easiest. The repair stage operates at 78-98% precision, producing 326 correct relabellings against 19 regressions.

translation.title: 证明你能证明的：面向逻辑自然语言推理的混合神经符号推理
translation.abstract: 对自然语言进行逻辑推理既需要语义解释也需要演绎搜索。大型语言模型（LLM）可以提出看似合理的中间推导，但往往无法将它们组合成完整证明，并且过度预测不确定性。神经符号方法通过将整个问题翻译成一阶逻辑并交给证明器来改进搜索，但一个坏子句就可能使整个翻译不可执行。我们提出 Hybrid Reasoning，一个将证明提议、步骤验证和标签决策解耦的三阶段流水线。LLM 提出带有初步判定结论的结构化证明树；定理证明器在本地验证每个推导，仅保留它能证明的子集；当初步判定为 UNCERTAIN 时，不确定性门控的修复阶段尝试根据前提加已验证的推导重新推导标签。在四个基准（FOLIO、ProofWriter、ProverQA、PrOntoQA）和五个当代 LLM 上，Hybrid Reasoning 在两个最困难的数据集上表现最佳，在 FOLIO 上比最强基线提升 5.3 分，在 ProverQA 上提升 4.9 分，并在最简单的数据集上达到天花板级准确率。修复阶段的精确率为 78-98%，产生 326 次正确重标注，仅有 19 次回退。
translation.brief: 为解决 LLM 难以组合完整证明且过度预测不确定性的问题，提出由 LLM 提议证明树、定理证明器逐步验证、不确定性门控修复重标注的三阶段混合神经符号推理流水线。

papers.title: Caleta: An Evidence-Oriented Trust Layer for Reproducible Local Large Language Model Inference
papers.abstract: Local large language model (LLM) inference is often described as private, verified, or reproducible without separating the technical claims behind those terms. This paper presents Caleta, an Apache-2.0 process supervisor and evidence layer around llama.cpp rather than a new inference engine. Caleta combines versioned manifests, exact-size and SHA-256 verification, controlled backend construction, a restricted OpenAI-compatible proxy, prompt-free execution records, benchmark reports, and a small conformance suite. Its contribution is the composition of these mechanisms into explicit contracts that distinguish integrity from authenticated provenance and privacy controls from operating-system isolation. We evaluate the implementation through static checks, 22 unit tests, deterministic end-to-end tests on Ubuntu, macOS, and Windows, and a pinned real-model experiment on Windows CPU using Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct Q4_K_M and llama.cpp b11981. The real experiment validates artifact verification, startup, model listing, non-streaming and server-sent-event chat, and conformance. Three independent benchmark invocations produced fifteen successful warm requests with no failures. In this single configuration, median time to first token was 18.066 ms and median decode throughput was 54.394 tokens/s. These descriptive measurements do not establish cross-engine superiority, output quality, energy efficiency, or hardware-general performance. Raw JSON, commands, and environment metadata are published. Remaining challenges include signed manifests, time-of-check/time-of-use replacement, operating-system containment, proxy-overhead measurement, and broader experimental matrices.

papers.title: Update Slope Is Bounded by Prior Calibration: A Structural Bound and Its Contingent Empirical Signature
papers.abstract: Evaluations of LLM forecasters increasingly measure how forecasts improve as richer evidence is supplied. We identify two confounds in this update-slope metric. First, outcome-aware evidence construction substantially inflates measured responsiveness: on the same models and questions, slopes are roughly four times larger than with resolution-blinded evidence ladders. Second, update slope is a change score with a prior-dependent structural ceiling, so raw comparisons can reflect differences in starting calibration rather than updating behavior. The ceiling defines only a feasible region; whether slope and prior calibration are empirically coupled depends on headroom utilization and varies across our Manifold, ForecastBench, and ACLED pools. Despite this variability, conditioning on prior calibration roughly triples the association between intermediate updating and final Brier score under both blinded and outcome-aware construction. Question identity also explains substantially more variance than model identity across the evaluated pools. We recommend building evidence ladders blind to outcomes, conditioning on prior calibration, and reporting headroom-normalized measures alongside raw slopes.

papers.title: Policy Over Purpose: Auditing LLM Content Moderation of Reclaimed Slur Usage
papers.abstract: As Perspective API is deprecated, platforms are turning to large language models for content moderation, encoding policy as natural language that the model must interpret at inference time. Reclaimed slurs test this design directly. The same term can express in-group pride or target the community that reclaimed it, and misreading it silences the speech moderation is meant to protect. We audit four general-purpose LLMs and four moderation-specific systems, with Perspective API as a legacy baseline, on IYKYK, a corpus of reclaimed and derogatory usage of three slurs annotated by community members. Across the policy, decision, reasoning, disparity, and steering layers of this audit, we find that whether a system was purpose-built for moderation explains little about how it handles reclaimed language. No system reliably agrees with community judgment, and all fail most on language reclaimed within Black communities. What separates systems is instead how their policy is represented. Only systems whose policy is expressed in the prompt can be steered at all, and even then, explicit definitions change how models justify a decision more than how they make it. We argue that policy transparency determines whether moderation failures can be corrected, but that correcting them requires contextual judgment that definitions supplied at inference time cannot provide.

papers.title: SIRIS: Can LLMs Tell When Simulation Errors Matter in AI-Driven Systems Research
papers.abstract: LLM agents increasingly drive systems research and rely on simulators to evaluate candidate designs at scale. Simulators are imperfect by design: their modeling limitations can distort predictions yet leave the recommended design correct, or change which design should be selected. We introduce Siris to test whether LLMs can tell these cases apart, judging from their systems understanding when a limitation invalidates the simulator's recommendation. By perturbing a simulator, Siris constructs workload pairs with the same candidates, limitation, and simulator recommendation. The perturbation changes predictions on both workloads, yet a reference simulator supports the recommendation on only one. Evaluating thirteen frontier LLMs on LLM serving design problems, we find that identifying a limitation does not ensure a correct choice, and even the strongest models sometimes abandon valid recommendations. Self-correction through a review turn helps these models restore valid choices but introduces new errors in several others. These findings motivate evaluating systems understanding through design decisions under imperfect simulators.

papers.title: MaRiO: Multi-agent Collaborative Reasoning via Shared Observations in MLLMs
papers.abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) show strong visual perception capabilities, but existing evaluations largely focus on single-view or multi-view settings with shared camera parameters, leaving the challenge of multi-agent collaborative scenarios underexplored. In such settings, multiple agents observe a shared environment from independent viewpoints, and reliable decisions require reasoning across these independent observations of the same environment. To study this problem, we introduce MaRiO, a benchmark for evaluating multi-agent collaborative reasoning, and evaluate 23 state-of-the-art MLLMs on it. Our analysis reveals three key findings: (1) tasks governed by static perception are generally easier than tasks that require transformational event sequences; (2) most models struggle to resolve cross-agent correspondences, with errors increasing with scene complexity; and (3) models show limited ability to leverage geometric cues present in the scene. As an initial step toward addressing these challenges, we explore geometry-guided synthetic view augmentation that generates intermediate transition frames between agent observations, providing auxiliary spatial context that improves performance in certain categories. Overall, our results highlight that multi-agent collaborative reasoning remains an open challenge and an important direction for multimodal embodied systems. The code is available on the project page: https://omarftt.github.io/MaRiO-page/.

papers.title: LSRP*: Scalable and Anytime Planning for Multi-Agent Path Finding with Asynchronous Actions
papers.abstract: Multi-Agent Path Finding (MAPF) seeks collision-free paths for multiple agents from their respective starting locations to their respective goal locations while minimizing path costs. Although many MAPF algorithms were developed, most of them rely on a common assumption on synchronized actions, where the actions of all agents start at the same time and always take a time unit. This assumption may limit the use of MAPF planners in practice. To get rid of this assumption, recently, an algorithm called Loosely Synchronized Rule-based Planning (LSRP) was proposed, which can find sub-optimal solutions for many agents. However, LSRP often finds poor quality solutions due to its unbounded sub-optimality. This paper develops a new anytime planner called LSRP* that can keep improving solution quality after the initial solution is obtained until the runtime budget depletes. We analyze the properties of LSRP* and test it against several baselines with up to 1000 agents on various maps. LSRP* can handle up to 25% more agents than LSRP and can reduce up to 40% of the solution cost found by LSRP.

papers.title: From Reflection to Co-Evolution: Self-Evolving Agents with Locally Verified Memory
papers.abstract: LLM agents have made impressive progress in coding and mathematical reasoning, motivating growing interest in learning from long-horizon interaction. Memory supports this process, but plausible lessons can be redundant or reinforce inappropriate actions. Can a memory's source decision provide a practical test for whether to retain it? We localize consequential trajectory steps, extract candidate memories, and replay each source decision with and without its candidate under the same context. This reveals two properties: most candidates barely shift the probed distribution, and both successful and failed source actions can be reinforced or suppressed. These observations motivate Anchor, which tests shift magnitude and source-role alignment before retention. Admitted memories guide later trajectories, enabling experience-driven improvement under a frozen policy. On held-out ALFWorld and WebShop tasks, Anchor improves success rate and mean score by up to 19.9% and 17.2%, respectively, relative to the strongest baseline for each backbone. With Qwen3.5-27B, it retains 41% fewer ALFWorld cards than unfiltered retention and outperforms all four WebShop cost-comparison baselines while using fewer tokens.

papers.title: A Computational Map of the Disaster Mental Health Research Landscape
papers.abstract: When disasters strike, they not only damage infrastructure, buildings, and the economy, but also affect the mental health of affected populations. Research on the mental health effects of disasters has expanded rapidly and has become an important, well-funded area of psychology, public health, and related social sciences. However, the overall structure of this research landscape has not been systematically characterized. Using large language models, we conducted a review of all articles related to terms 'disaster' and 'mental health' indexed in PubMed. 7,859 articles' metadata were retrieved using the NCBI API, and then Claude Sonnet was used to extract structured variables from the abstracts. The results indicated that earthquakes and epidemics were the most commonly studied disasters while many other disasters such as heat and cold waves have received less attention. PTSD, depression, and anxiety were well investigated but many other mental health issues (e.g., aggression, suicide) are relatively ignored. Despite enjoying relatively large sample sizes (median = 452, IQR = 142 - 1,568), the field rarely utilizes machine learning algorithms. Hypothesis significance testing, reviews, qualitative methods, and structural equation modeling are respectively most common methods while agent-based modeling, machine learning, casual inference, and NLP each appear in less than 1% of articles. Studies are limited to a small number of countries, particularly the United States, Japan, and China, while many disaster-prone regions remain substantially underrepresented. This LLM-assisted computational map provides a broad overview of the disaster mental health literature while highlighting important methodological gaps, with particular emphasis on the underutilization of computational methods that could help advance the field.

papers.title: Crustify: Repository-Level Generation of Safe Rust Bindings with LLM Agents and Coverage-Guided Testing
papers.abstract: Wrapping C code in a safe Rust interface lets Rust applications use it without writing unsafe code, until the code itself is migrated to Rust. Such bindings are tedious and error-prone to write, however: their internals use unsafe code that the Rust compiler does not check, so a single mistake can introduce undefined behavior (UB), and they have so far been written mostly by hand. We present Crustify, an agentic co-translator that generates safe Rust bindings for repository-level C libraries. Crustify schedules a target's types and symbols into dependency-ordered waves of independent batches that agents bind concurrently. Its agents derive the ownership and lifecycle contract of every pointer and type they wrap, check each binding with coverage-guided equivalence and UB tests under sanitizers and Miri, and review every wave. They build on three tools that we contribute: (a) ffibox, Rust primitives for C/Rust interop that mirror Box, Arc, and Vec for C objects without ever forming a reference to memory that C may alias; (b) Wavefront, a neuro-symbolic static analyzer that orders a target's items by their dependencies, including those that casts and type-erased pointers hide; and (c) ffimap, a rustc-based analysis that maps the unsafe surface of bindings. On libgit2 and ffmpeg, with one developer in the loop, Crustify generated safe bindings for 41.9% and 42.8% of their public APIs in about 51.9 and 58.9 hours. On the interface consumers are expected to use, only 1.6% and 0.4% of the bindings' public functions are unsafe, and only 0.1% and 0.6% have a raw pointer in their signature. Their tests cover 98.92% and 99.07% of the Rust code and 45.95% and 67.20% of libgit2 and of ffmpeg's libavutil, and the reviewers fixed 8 and 13 defects that caused UB reachable from Rust. To our knowledge, this is the first work to automate the generation of safe Rust bindings for C libraries.

papers.title: The Limits of Information-Flow Control Enforcement for Agentic Systems
papers.abstract: Information-flow control (IFC) is a promising approach to enforce policy in agentic AI systems. However, IFC suffers from label creep, a phenomenon where monotonically increasing security labels propagate through a system and progressively limit its utility. Label creep in agentic AI systems can be mitigated using two major strategies: (1) improved system design and (2) label declassification. In this paper, we characterize how far system design alone can mitigate label creep in agentic systems. Specifically, we measure how system topology, scale, and agent composition affect utility loss and security enforcement cost proxies for conservative IFC enforcement in a stateful agentic system simulator. We develop a pipeline to systematically vary these features and measure their impacts on label propagation. Our results demonstrate strong associations between structural graph features and our IFC utility loss metric (up to a Spearman correlation $|ρ|$ of $0.96$) and show that system size and tool allocation substantially affect how labels propagate. These findings identify design choices to reduce IFC utility loss, but they also demonstrate that system design alone cannot fully prevent utility loss due to monotonic label propagation. This motivates the development of label declassification mechanisms that aid these design choices and diminish IFC utility cost.

papers.title: Coding or Cheating? An Investigation of Frontier Coding LLMs
papers.abstract: Frontier agentic LLMs are trained on verifiable rewards in reinforcement learning (RL) environments built from real software repositories. A passing test suite is treated as the reward for solving the task. We show that, on hard problems, frontier models often satisfy these rewards by obtaining the answer instead of deriving it, known as reward hacking. Prior reports document this behavior on public benchmarks. We test its persistence on unseen problems. In a hardened environment where the answer cannot leak, nearly every model we tested attempted to recover the answer, escalating through tiers of increasingly specialized exploitation: mining the repository history for the upstream fix, inspecting the git object store directly, and sweeping the filesystem for a possible newer copy of the source or hidden tests. These attempts were concentrated on the hardest problems, and the models differed in whether, how often, and how deeply they escalated. Our position is that this behavior is a learned shortcut, acquired in RL environments that leak the answer, not a sign of intelligence. We release agent traces for these models to support further study at https://huggingface.co/datasets/logitly-ai/reward-hacking-raw-v1.
