papers.title: Linking Event-sequence Data Claims to Analytic Provenance in Chatbots: Technique and Evaluation
papers.abstract: Chatbots are increasingly used to analyze temporal event sequences of which website clickstreams are among the most common. Explanations are essential for understanding claims about event-sequence data. However, existing systems often require programming expertise to interpret these explanations and fail to explain the data processes underlying the data claims. We introduce a technique for linking a data claim to its analytic provenance (i.e., the analytic steps and results that produced it). It has two components: a reference table that records analytic steps and results in addressable cells, and a citation format that binds each claim to one or more cells. To operationalize this technique for clickstream analysis, we curated a set of analytic operations for clickstream analysis, organized them through a pivot-table abstraction, and developed tools that an AI agent can invoke to create a reference table and assemble a natural language response with cited data claims. To evaluate how citations affect users' assessment of data claims, we conducted two crowdsourced experiments with 90 participants each. The experiments showed that participants perceived correct data claims to be more accurate with citations when compared with no explanations, and that they perceived incorrect data claims to be less accurate with citations when compared with code and no explanations.

translation.title: 在聊天机器人中将事件序列数据论断链接到分析溯源：技术与评估
translation.abstract: 聊天机器人越来越多地被用于分析时间事件序列，其中网站点击流是最常见的一类。解释对于理解关于事件序列数据的论断至关重要。然而，现有系统往往需要编程专业知识才能解读这些解释，并且无法解释数据论断背后的数据处理过程。我们提出了一种将数据论断链接到其分析溯源（即产生该论断的分析步骤和结果）的技术。该技术包含两个组件：一个以可寻址单元格记录分析步骤和结果的引用表（reference table），以及将每条论断绑定到一个或多个单元格的引用格式。为了将此技术应用于点击流分析，我们整理了一套用于点击流分析的操作集合，通过数据透视表抽象对其加以组织，并开发了 AI agent 可调用的工具来创建引用表并组装带有引用数据论断的自然语言回复。为评估引用如何影响用户对数据论断的评判，我们开展了两项各 90 名参与者的众包实验。实验表明，与不提供解释相比，参与者在有引用时认为正确的数据论断更准确；与代码和不提供解释相比，有引用时他们认为错误的数据论断更不准确。
translation.brief: 针对聊天机器人解释数据论断时无法展示其来源的问题，提出用引用表和引用格式将论断链接到分析溯源的 technique 并以众包实验评估引用的影响。

papers.title: When Credit Turns Against Tools: Transition-Aware Credit Assignment in Agentic Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: Agentic reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards trains language models through multi-turn tool interactions, yet their reasoning performance and tool-calling ability can decline during training. We trace this degradation to three coupled mechanisms: (1) tool-token imbalance produces negative overall tool credit when incorrect trajectories contain more tool tokens per turn than correct ones; (2) aggregation amplification can further strengthen this negative signal as token-mean aggregation gives longer incorrect trajectories greater weight in policy updates; and (3) failure-driven retries prolong trajectories as models tend to call tools again after execution errors, extending potential negative credit to recovery attempts. To counter this suppression, we propose Transition-Aware Credit Assignment (TACA), which targets the transition from reasoning to tool use through supervision of both call initiation and generation. Specifically, TACA uses Advantage Projection to enforce a nonnegative mean advantage on tool-call tokens within each prompt group through a minimal uniform shift. Additionally, TACA guides tool-use decisions with Decision Contrast, comparing rewards for tool-assisted and direct answers to the same prompt. Through Supervised Replay, it reinforces tool-call generation using calls from previously sampled correct trajectories. Across models and tasks, TACA improves performance and sustains more reliable tool interaction during training, raising mean accuracy over MT-GRPO on six reasoning benchmarks by 4.61 percentage points for Qwen2.5-1.5B and 3.61 for Qwen2.5-3B. Our code is available at https://github.com/tmlr-group/TACA.

translation.title: 当信用反噬工具：Agentic 强化学习中的转换感知信用分配
translation.abstract: 基于可验证奖励的 agentic 强化学习通过多轮工具交互训练语言模型，但其推理性能和工具调用能力在训练中可能下降。我们将这种退化归因于三个耦合机制：(1) 工具 token 不平衡——当错误轨迹每轮包含的工具 token 多于正确轨迹时，会产生负的总体工具信用；(2) 聚合放大——token 均值聚合使更长的错误轨迹在策略更新中获得更大权重，从而进一步强化这种负信号；(3) 失败驱动的重试——模型在执行错误后倾向于再次调用工具，延长了轨迹，使潜在的负信用扩展到恢复尝试上。为对抗这种抑制，我们提出转换感知信用分配（Transition-Aware Credit Assignment, TACA），通过同时监督调用发起和生成来针对从推理到工具使用的转换。具体而言，TACA 使用 Advantage Projection，通过最小的统一偏移在每个 prompt 组内对工具调用 token 施加非负的平均 advantage。此外，TACA 使用 Decision Contrast 引导工具使用决策，比较同一 prompt 下使用工具回答与直接回答的奖励。通过 Supervised Replay，它利用先前采样到的正确轨迹中的调用强化工具调用生成。在多个模型和任务上，TACA 提升了性能并在训练中维持更可靠的工具交互，在六个推理基准上将平均准确率相对 MT-GRPO 提升 4.61 个百分点（Qwen2.5-1.5B）和 3.61 个百分点（Qwen2.5-3B）。代码见 https://github.com/tmlr-group/TACA。
translation.brief: 针对多轮工具交互 RL 训练中负信用抑制工具调用的问题，提出通过对推理-工具转换施加监督的 TACA（含 Advantage Projection、Decision Contrast 与 Supervised Replay）来改善信用分配。

papers.title: Agentic Attribution of Cloud Resource Ownership
papers.abstract: Security tools raise findings across cloud environments, and AI agents now investigate and prioritize them. A finding is still resolved by people: it has to reach the people responsible for fixing it and accountable for the resource it concerns. Ownership is the organizational context that decides who that is. Where recorded, it is declared by hand in configuration management databases or owner tags and goes stale unless kept current; accounts are shared, and automation creates much of the infrastructure. The knowledge sits in work records, code history, audit logs and identity directories, encoded in each organization's own conventions. Recovering it poses four challenges: the signal is scattered across sources, none of them authoritative; the conventions that carry it differ between organizations; reaching an owner takes multi-hop links; and those related to a resource differ in the strength of their relation. We define ownership as a set of entities, people or teams, each related to the resource by one of five patterns ordered by strength. We present a reference architecture for agentic ownership attribution that derives ownership from these records instead of declaring it: it profiles an organization offline into tested signal procedures and an ownership playbook, then attributes each resource with a coordinator agent and parallel investigators, with confidence computed by rules. On 100 resources of 50 Amazon Web Services (AWS) resource types in one organization, we pool the architecture's candidates with those of an unprimed general-purpose agent and verify every evidence piece against the records. The architecture reaches 92.1% weighted recall and 86.6% weighted precision, against 54.8% and 77.4%, at 0.55 times the agent's cost per unit of coverage. The difference lies in people who build and change resources without an explicit owner, found through work records and code history.

translation.title: 云资源归属的 Agentic 归因
translation.abstract: 安全工具会在云环境中产生发现（findings），AI agent 如今可对它们进行调查和排序。发现最终仍需人来解决：它必须送达负责修复的人以及对相关资源负有责任的人。归属关系（ownership）是决定“是谁”的组织上下文。在有记录之处，归属通常由人工在配置管理数据库或 owner 标签中声明，若不持续维护便会过时；账户会被共享，且大量基础设施由自动化创建。这些知识散布在工作记录、代码历史、审计日志和身份目录中，并编码在每个组织各自的约定里。恢复这些知识面临四个挑战：信号分散在多个非权威来源之间；承载信号的约定因组织而异；找到 owner 需要多跳链接；与资源相关者在关系强度上各不相同。我们将归属定义为一组实体（人或团队），每个实体通过按强度排序的五种模式之一与资源相关联。我们提出了一个 agentic 归属归因的参考架构，从这些记录中推导归属而非人工声明：先离线剖析组织，生成经过测试的信号流程和归属 playbook，然后由一个协调 agent 与并行的调查 agent 对每个资源进行归因，置信度由规则计算。在一个组织内 50 种 AWS 资源类型的 100 个资源上，我们将该架构的候选结果与未经引导的通用 agent 的结果汇总，并逐条对照记录验证证据。该架构达到 92.1% 加权召回率和 86.6% 加权精确率，而基线为 54.8% 和 77.4%，且每单位覆盖成本仅为该 agent 的 0.55 倍。差异主要来自通过工作记录和代码历史找到的、在变更资源时未明确登记 owner 的人。
translation.brief: 针对云资源归属信息分散、易过时难以确定责任人的问题，提出用协调与并行调查 agent 从工作记录、代码历史等来源推导归属的 agentic 归因架构。

papers.title: Agent Self-Improvement with Frozen Weights: The Added Value and Limits of Failure Traces
papers.abstract: We evaluate whether an AI agent's harness, the notes around its model, can learn from the agent's failure traces beyond a matched search that never sees them. It can, but less than it looks. We tested an open 9-billion-parameter model with fixed weights; a larger teacher model wrote its notes. On generated customer-service decisions, where both note writers were told the target rules, notes based on the agent's mistakes improved accuracy by 4.0 percentage points over notes from the same process with the mistakes withheld. That process alone, trying and keeping better-scoring notes, reached about 60% of the total improvement. In full customer-service conversations the same notes showed no demonstrated improvement. Separately, a strict screen of single lessons admitted two customer-service lessons, still awaiting tests on new data, and one tool-use lesson, written without seeing the agent's mistakes, which showed no demonstrated gain on new tool-use tasks. A neutral note with no procedure scored higher than the learned lessons (exploratory). A blind audit judged 146 of 240 tool-use test items defective.

translation.title: 冻结权重下的 Agent 自我改进：失败轨迹的附加价值与局限
translation.abstract: 我们评估 AI agent 的 harness（围绕模型的笔记）能否从 agent 的失败轨迹中学习，超越从未见过这些轨迹的匹配搜索。答案是能，但提升幅度不如表面看起来那么大。我们测试了一个权重固定的开源 90 亿参数模型，其笔记由更大的教师模型撰写。在生成的客服决策任务上（两位笔记撰写者均被告知目标规则），基于 agent 错误的笔记相比隐藏错误后以相同流程生成的笔记将准确率提高了 4.0 个百分点。而仅靠该流程本身（尝试并保留得分更高的笔记）就已达到总提升的约 60%。在完整的客服对话中，同样的笔记未表现出可证明的改进。另外，通过严格筛选只保留了两个客服教训（仍有待在新数据上检验）和一个工具使用教训（撰写时未接触 agent 的错误），后者在新工具使用任务上未表现出可证明的收益。一条不含具体流程的中性笔记得分高于所学教训（探索性结果）。一项盲审计判定 240 个工具使用测试项中有 146 个存在缺陷。
translation.brief: 针对冻结权重下 agent harness 能否从失败轨迹中自我改进的问题，通过固定权重的 9B 模型与教师模型写笔记的对照实验评估其附加价值与局限。

papers.title: IntentLens: Grounding Underspecified Multimodal Queries for Recommendation via Tool-Augmented Reasoning
papers.abstract: As intelligent personal assistants are increasingly deployed in real-world scenarios, recommendation paradigms are shifting from passive preference matching to inferring user intent from underspecified multimodal inputs. In practical interactions, users typically issue a reference image paired with a vague natural language query, keeping key visual attributes, personalized preferences, and item-side constraints implicit. Existing recommendation methods either leverage historical user interactions augmented with multimodal item features or assume fully articulated textual queries; both paradigms struggle to resolve underspecified multimodal queries for accurate item matching. To address this limitation, we propose IntentLens, a tool-augmented recommendation framework that grounds ambiguous multimodal queries into query-relevant evidence prior to user-item matching. IntentLens follows a ground-then-rank pipeline: a shared multimodal LLM leverages visual tools, user memory modules, and item attribute retrieval tools to (i) infer latent user intent from image-text inputs and (ii) augment each candidate item with fine-grained, query-conditioned evidence. Subsequently, a lightweight ranker scores candidates based on the grounded representations. To facilitate research in this novel setting, we construct two benchmarks with underspecified multimodal queries, namely \textsc{GoogleReview-MMTool} and \textsc{Yelp-MMTool}. Extensive experiments on these benchmarks demonstrate that IntentLens outperforms competitive MLLM and retrieval baselines, and exhibits strong generalization to unseen categories and datasets.

translation.title: IntentLens：通过工具增强推理为推荐落地欠规范的多模态查询
translation.abstract: 随着智能个人助手在真实场景中的部署日益增多，推荐范式正从被动偏好匹配转向从欠规范的多模态输入中推断用户意图。在实际交互中，用户通常给出一张参考图像配以模糊的自然语言查询，关键视觉属性、个性化偏好和物品侧约束均保持隐式。现有推荐方法要么利用带有多模态物品特征增强的历史用户交互，要么假设查询已被完整文本化表述；两种范式都难以解决欠规范多模态查询下的准确物品匹配问题。为解决这一局限，我们提出 IntentLens，一个工具增强的推荐框架，在用户-物品匹配之前将模糊的多模态查询落地为与查询相关的证据。IntentLens 遵循“先落地再排序”的流水线：一个共享的多模态 LLM 利用视觉工具、用户记忆模块和物品属性检索工具来 (i) 从图文输入推断潜在用户意图，以及 (ii) 用细粒度的、以查询为条件的证据增强每个候选物品。随后，一个轻量级 ranker 基于落地后的表示对候选打分。为促进这一新场景的研究，我们构建了两个欠规范多模态查询基准，即 GoogleReview-MMTool 和 Yelp-MMTool。在这些基准上的大量实验表明，IntentLens 优于有竞争力的 MLLM 和检索基线，并对未见过的类别和数据集表现出很强的泛化能力。
translation.brief: 针对用户以模糊图文查询表达隐式意图导致推荐匹配困难的问题，提出用多模态 LLM 调用视觉、记忆与检索工具先落地查询再排序的 IntentLens 框架。

papers.title: Separation of Skilling Context for Standard Operating Procedure-based Agents
papers.abstract: Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) are kept concise for human readability, so LLM agents that generate executable skills from them lack the tacit knowledge and implementation details needed for automation. Human intervention fills these gaps, but must be repeated as SOPs evolve---a problem we call \textit{SOP-skill drift}. We propose managing SOPs and Contextual Knowledge (CK) separately, together with a \textit{contract-aware} evaluation that distinguishes genuine violations from CK-resolved differences. On eight Indeed-derived workflows (single LLM), it raises the functional-equivalence rate from 12\% to 58\%. Under three SOP-revision perturbations, previously extracted CK already covers 79.5\% of newly introduced automation gaps.

translation.title: 基于标准操作规程的智能体的技能上下文分离
translation.abstract: 标准操作规程（SOP）为便于人类阅读而保持简洁，因此从其生成可执行技能的 LLM 智能体缺乏自动化所需的隐性知识和实现细节。人工干预可以填补这些缺口，但随着 SOP 演进必须反复进行——我们将这一问题称为 SOP-skill drift。我们提出将 SOP 与上下文知识（Contextual Knowledge, CK）分开管理，并辅以能够区分真正违规与 CK 可解决差异的 contract-aware 评估。在八个源自 Indeed 的工作流（单 LLM）上，该方法将功能等价率从 12% 提升至 58%。在三种 SOP 修订扰动下，先前提取的 CK 已覆盖 79.5% 新引入的自动化缺口。
translation.brief: 针对 SOP 演进导致的技能失效问题，提出将 SOP 与上下文知识分离管理并结合 contract-aware 评估的方法。

papers.title: AOP-Smart-Finder: A High-Throughput Human-AI Hybrid Framework for AOP Discovery and Evidence Mapping from Large-Scale Literature
papers.abstract: The rapid growth of scientific literature and the high heterogeneity of biological terminology and mechanistic descriptions make it difficult for researchers to integrate scattered research evidence, identify connections among biological events, and construct mechanistic networks. Here, we developed a high-throughput human-AI hybrid framework, AOP-Smart-Finder, for biological event discovery, relationship mining, and Adverse Outcome Pathway (AOP) construction and evidence mapping from large-scale literature. This framework integrates Large Language Models (LLMs), AOP-Smart retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) technology, and Python-based automation, supporting two analysis modes: one based on a single compound and the other based on a predefined set of biological events. In the di(2-ethylhexyl) phthalate (DEHP) case, the system processed 12,983 articles within 30 min and included 1,093 of them, from which it extracted 1,589 biological events (including 458 official key events [KEs] and 1,131 candidate KEs) and 2,519 key event relationships (KERs). In the amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) case, the system identified 55 stressors from 437 articles and extracted 278 biological events and 548 event relationships. Following manual curation and Weight of Evidence (WoE) evaluation, a mechanistic network comprising 16 KEs and 23 KERs was ultimately constructed. This framework can either use existing AOPs as knowledge guidance for mechanistic expansion and evidence supplementation, or discover novel event connections and construct mechanistic networks around user-specified research topics. It provides a high-throughput, traceable, human-AI hybrid methodology for complex biological mechanism elucidation and AOP discovery driven by large-scale literature.

translation.title: AOP-Smart-Finder：面向大规模文献 AOP 发现与证据映射的高通量人机混合框架
translation.abstract: 科学文献的快速增长以及生物术语和机制描述的高度异质性，使研究者难以整合分散的研究证据、识别生物事件之间的关联并构建机制网络。本文开发了一个高通量人机混合框架 AOP-Smart-Finder，用于从大规模文献中进行生物事件发现、关系挖掘以及不良结局通路（AOP）构建与证据映射。该框架整合了大型语言模型（LLM）、AOP-Smart 检索增强生成（RAG）技术和基于 Python 的自动化，支持两种分析模式：基于单一化合物和基于预定义生物事件集合。在邻苯二甲酸二（2-乙基己基）酯（DEHP）案例中，系统在 30 分钟内处理了 12,983 篇文章并纳入其中 1,093 篇，从中提取了 1,589 个生物事件（包括 458 个官方关键事件 [KE] 和 1,131 个候选 KE）以及 2,519 个关键事件关系（KER）。在肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）案例中，系统从 437 篇文章中识别出 55 种应激源，并提取了 278 个生物事件和 548 个事件关系。经过人工整理和证据权重（WoE）评估，最终构建了包含 16 个 KE 和 23 个 KER 的机制网络。该框架既可以利用现有 AOP 作为知识指导进行机制扩展和证据补充，也可以围绕用户指定的研究主题发现新的事件关联并构建机制网络。它为基于大规模文献的复杂生物机制阐明和 AOP 发现提供了一种高通量、可追溯的人机混合方法。
translation.brief: 针对文献分散难以整合构建 AOP 网络的问题，提出融合 LLM 与 RAG 的人机混合高通量框架进行生物事件发现与证据映射。

papers.title: BiVerify: Closing the Loop Between Backward and Forward Verification for Mathematical Self-Correction
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have made substantial progress in mathematical reasoning but still produce incorrect solutions to complex problems, indicating the need for more reliable self-correction mechanisms. Mathematical self-correction typically identifies errors through verification, which can proceed backward or forward. The two directions provide complementary verification capabilities. Backward verification checks a candidate answer against the original constraints, bypassing complex intermediate reasoning, but cannot ensure correct reasoning or objective completeness. Forward verification follows the problem conditions and current solution, enabling it to locate reasoning errors and assess objective completeness, but may overlook key constraints in complex solution chains. We propose BiVerify, a dynamically scheduled framework for bidirectional mathematical verification. BiVerify begins with backward verification to screen the answer against the original constraints, followed by forward verification of the reasoning process; subsequent direction switching, state resetting, and re-verification are governed by verification outcomes. Upon failure, the system revises the candidate or verification flow until the same candidate passes both directions. We also introduce shared mathematical tools that separate logical reasoning from precise computation. We systematically evaluate BiVerify on five challenging mathematical reasoning benchmarks using multiple mainstream DeepSeek, GPT, and Gemini models. BiVerify exceeds the strongest representative public baseline evaluated in this work by 13.5 percentage points in average accuracy, with the margin reaching 31.2 percentage points on GPT. Further analysis shows that BiVerify's overall performance exceeds that of either verification direction alone.

translation.title: BiVerify：打通反向与正向验证闭环的数学自我纠错
translation.abstract: 大型语言模型（LLM）在数学推理方面取得了长足进步，但仍会对复杂问题给出错误解答，这表明需要更可靠的自我纠错机制。数学自我纠错通常通过验证来识别错误，验证可以反向或正向进行，两个方向提供了互补的验证能力。反向验证将候选答案与原始约束进行核对，绕过复杂的中间推理，但无法确保推理正确或目标完备性；正向验证遵循问题条件和当前解答，能够定位推理错误并评估目标完备性，但在复杂求解链条中可能遗漏关键约束。我们提出 BiVerify，一个双向数学验证的动态调度框架。BiVerify 先进行反向验证以依据原始约束筛查答案，随后对推理过程进行正向验证；后续的方向切换、状态重置和重新验证由验证结果决定。一旦失败，系统会修改候选答案或验证流程，直到同一候选答案在两个方向上均通过。我们还引入了共享数学工具，将逻辑推理与精确计算分离。我们在五个具有挑战性的数学推理基准上，使用多个主流的 DeepSeek、GPT 和 Gemini 模型对 BiVerify 进行了系统评估。BiVerify 的平均准确率比本文评估的最强代表性公开基线高出 13.5 个百分点，在 GPT 上的差距达到 31.2 个百分点。进一步分析表明，BiVerify 的整体性能超过了任一单一验证方向。
translation.brief: 针对 LLM 数学推理错误纠错不可靠的问题，提出双向（反向+正向）验证动态调度的自我纠错框架 BiVerify。

papers.title: LLM-based Multi-Criteria Deep Reinforcement Learning for Dynamic Efficient 5G UPF Selection
papers.abstract: User plane function (UPF) selection in 5G networks is an active area of research, with various limited approaches proposed to enhance network efficiency and manage resources effectively. In this paper, we address this gap in the related literature by proposing a Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) UPF selection method that utilizes a dynamic, multi-objective reward function and validating it on a real-world 5G emulation platform. The proposed method is based on the large language models' (LLMs) translation of network operator intents and the network data analytics function (NWDAF) abnormality alerts. The experimental results validated in the real-world experimental setup demonstrate that our dynamic DRL solution achieves an effective balance between latency, power consumption, and traffic distribution, outperforming the heuristic baselines and fixed DRL by 16.89%. These findings highlight the real-world applicability of our approach for dynamic, intent-driven UPF selection.

translation.title: 基于 LLM 的多准则深度强化学习实现动态高效的 5G UPF 选择
translation.abstract: 5G 网络中的用户面功能（UPF）选择是一个活跃的研究领域，已有多种受限方法被提出以提升网络效率和有效管理资源。本文通过提出一种利用动态多目标奖励函数的深度强化学习（DRL）UPF 选择方法来填补相关文献的空白，并在真实世界的 5G 仿真平台上进行验证。该方法基于大型语言模型（LLM）对网络运营商意图的翻译以及网络数据分析功能（NWDAF）的异常告警。在真实实验环境中验证的实验结果表明，我们的动态 DRL 方案在延迟、功耗和流量分配之间实现了有效平衡，相比启发式基线和固定 DRL 提升 16.89%。这些发现凸显了我们方法在动态、意图驱动的 UPF 选择中的现实适用性。
translation.brief: 针对 5G UPF 选择方法受限的问题，提出基于 LLM 意图翻译和 NWDAF 告警的动态多目标 DRL 方法。

papers.title: A Distributed Observer with Random Agent Activations over Random Communication Networks
papers.abstract: This paper develops a distributed observer for the forward-Euler discretization of a continuous-time linear time-invariant system under random local operations and random communications. Under uniform stochastic strong connectivity, we establish almost sure exponential convergence of all local state estimates for sufficiently small discretization step sizes. We further examine how the underlying parameters and components affect the admissible range of the discretization step size and the guaranteed convergence rate bound. Unlike related approaches, the proposed method does not require each local unobservable subspace to admit an $A$-invariant complement.

translation.title: 具有随机智能体激活与随机通信网络的分布式观测器
translation.abstract: 本文针对连续时间线性时不变系统的前向欧拉离散化，在随机局部操作与随机通信条件下开发了一种分布式观测器。在均匀随机强连通条件下，我们证明对于足够小的离散化步长，所有局部状态估计几乎必然指数收敛。我们进一步考察了底层参数和组件如何影响离散化步长的可容许范围以及可保证的收敛速率界。与相关工作不同，所提方法不要求每个局部不可观测子空间存在 $A$-不变补。
translation.brief: 针对随机通信与随机智能体激活下的分布式状态估计问题，提出无需局部不可观测子空间存在 A-不变补的分布式观测器并证明几乎必然指数收敛。

papers.title: Decomposing Earth Embeddings with Sparse Autoencoders
papers.abstract: Earth observation foundation models produce global metre-resolution embeddings that underpin work across agriculture, ecology, hydrology, and beyond. Yet these embeddings are opaque: each dimension entangles unrelated physical concepts, which makes them difficult to interpret and their robustness hard to assess. Here, we propose sparse autoencoders (SAEs) as a principled way to decompose Earth embeddings into sparse, approximately monosemantic features over an overcomplete dictionary. Because LLM judges of interpretations do not transfer to satellite pixels, and spatial autocorrelation matters, we introduce a tailored evaluation protocol. It scores any SAE on reconstruction at matched sparsity, alignment with reference concepts, and spatial scale, each against baselines that include an SAE whose decoder is a frozen random dictionary. On this protocol, SAEs reconstruct AlphaEarth and Tessera embeddings better than every baseline at matched sparsity. Their features align with far fewer reference concepts than raw embedding dimensions (on AlphaEarth, 88% align with at most one of 20 concept groups, most with none, against a median of 12 per raw dimension). They also carry more of their variance at fine spatial scales (23 to 32% within a 640 m patch for BatchTopK and Matryoshka, against 9%). An SAE with a frozen random decoder shares both properties, which therefore follow from sparsity, whereas only a learned dictionary reconstructs the embedding accurately: on AlphaEarth, trained SAEs leave eight times less variance unexplained. We test the sparse code on two applications, discovering land-cover sub-concepts and detecting out-of-distribution pixels by area-of-applicability estimation. Both indicate how sparse features could be used, but neither is yet reliable enough for practical use. Together, these results are a step toward Earth observation models whose features can be inspected.

translation.title: 用稀疏自编码器分解地球观测嵌入
translation.abstract: 地球观测基础模型生成的全球米级分辨率嵌入支撑着农业、生态、水文学等领域的工作，但这些嵌入是不透明的：每个维度纠缠着多个无关的物理概念，难以解释且难以评估其鲁棒性。我们提出稀疏自编码器（SAE）作为将地球嵌入分解为过完备字典上稀疏、近似单语义特征的原则性方法。由于基于LLM的解读评估无法迁移到卫星像素上，且空间自相关很重要，我们引入了一套定制的评估协议，在匹配稀疏度下从重构质量、与参考概念的对齐以及空间尺度三方面评估任意SAE，基线包括解码器为冻结随机字典的SAE。在该协议下，SAE在匹配稀疏度下对AlphaEarth和Tessera嵌入的重构优于所有基线；其特征与参考概念的对齐远少于原始嵌入维度（AlphaEarth上88%的特征至多对齐20个概念组中的一个，多数不对齐，而原始维度中位数对齐12个）；它们在细空间尺度上承载更多方差（BatchTopK和Matryoshka在640米patch内为23%-32%，而原始嵌入为9%）。冻结随机解码器的SAE同样具备后两个性质，说明这些性质源于稀疏性本身，而只有学习到的字典才能准确重构嵌入：在AlphaEarth上，训练后的SAE未解释方差减少8倍。我们在两个应用上测试稀疏编码——发现土地覆盖子概念和通过适用范围估计检测分布外像素——均展示了稀疏特征的潜在用途，但尚不足以投入实际使用。这些结果是迈向特征可检视的地球观测模型的一步。
translation.brief: 针对地球观测嵌入不可解释的问题，提出用稀疏自编码器将嵌入分解为单语义特征，并设计了适配卫星像素的评估协议。

papers.title: RoCoMark: Robust Code Watermarking Against LLM-Based Functionality-Preserving Rewriting Attacks
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) present significant challenges to source tracing of generated code, as LLM rewriting can substantially alter the syntactic and structural characteristics of watermarked code. However, existing watermarking methods often suffer severe performance degradation under LLM-based functionality-preserving rewriting attacks. We attribute this vulnerability not merely to the intensity of rewriting, but to a fundamental distribution mismatch between the perturbations encountered during watermark training and the global, non-deterministic rewriting behaviors induced by LLMs. In order to deal with this challenge, we propose RoCoMark, a Robust Code waterMarking framework that explicitly learns and adapts to LLM rewriting behaviors. RoCoMark is a multi-round minimax game between the watermark embedder and LLM rewriter. In each round, the embedder first learns threat profiling from LLM-rewritten code by optimizing the watermark encoder through contrastive learning and knowledge distillation while mitigating catastrophic representation drift. Then the embedder improves strategies by optimizing the watermark encoder and extractor simultaneously. Finally, an adaptive attack-evolution mechanism based on Reflexion and short- and long-term memory pools is applied, enabling continuous interaction between the watermark embedder and evolving rewriting strategies. This iterative attacker-defender process progressively improves the robustness of the watermark against diverse and previously unseen LLM rewriting behaviors. Extensive experiments on four typical benchmarks, under attacks generated by five LLMs, show the effectiveness of RoCoMark. RoCoMark achieves an average detection AUROC of 74.2% and a Rewrite BitACC of 75.3%, while maintaining a code functionality pass rate above 99.7%.

translation.title: RoCoMark：抵抗基于LLM的保功能重写攻击的鲁棒代码水印
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）对生成代码的溯源构成重大挑战，因为LLM重写会显著改变水印代码的句法和结构特征。然而，现有水印方法在基于LLM的保功能重写攻击下往往性能严重退化。我们将这种脆弱性归因于不仅是重写强度，更是水印训练中遇到的扰动与LLM引发的全局、非确定性重写行为之间的根本分布失配。为应对这一挑战，我们提出RoCoMark，一个显式学习并适应LLM重写行为的鲁棒代码水印框架。RoCoMark是水印嵌入器与LLM重写器之间的多轮极小极大博弈。每一轮中，嵌入器首先通过对比学习和知识蒸馏从LLM重写代码中学习威胁画像，同时缓解灾难性表征漂移；然后同时优化水印编码器和解码器以改进策略；最后应用基于Reflexion和短期、长期记忆池的自适应攻击演化机制，使水印嵌入器与不断演化的重写策略持续交互。这一攻防迭代过程逐步提升水印对多样且前所未见的LLM重写行为的鲁棒性。在四个典型基准上、面对五个LLM生成的攻击的广泛实验表明RoCoMark的有效性：平均检测AUROC为74.2%，重写位准确率（Rewrite BitACC）为75.3%，同时保持代码功能通过率在99.7%以上。
translation.brief: 针对代码水印在LLM重写攻击下失效的问题，提出水印嵌入器与LLM重写器之间多轮极小极大博弈的自适应鲁棒水印框架。

papers.title: How to "train" a surgeon? Benchmarking generalist agents in surgical scene understanding
papers.abstract: Evaluating general-purpose multimodal large language models (MLLMs) for surgical scene understanding remains limited due to scarce surgical data and fragmented evaluation protocols. We address these challenges through a two-stage evaluation framework for surgical scene understanding. In Stage I, we introduce SurgKnowBench, a diagnostic benchmark that harmonizes public surgical datasets across procedures and tasks and evaluates proprietary and open-source MLLMs to map the boundary of pretrained surgical competence. SurgKnowBench reveals that current models retain partial visual priors but remain weak on relational and procedural understanding and workflow assessment. Building on this failure frontier and motivated by the scaffolded nature of surgical training, we introduce SurgAgentGym, an agentic environment where general-purpose MLLM agents can use bounded knowledge search over SurgWiki and general-purpose visual grounding for surgical tasks. SurgAgentGym evaluates whether generalist agents can improve surgical understanding at inference time through tool-mediated evidence use, without additional surgical training. Our results show that agentic inference narrows the gap mainly for perception-heavy tasks, while fine-grained localization and expert-style assessment remain persistent bottlenecks. This opens a path toward future studies of agentic surgical understanding.

translation.title: 如何"培养"一名外科医生？通用智能体在手术场景理解中的基准评测
translation.abstract: 由于手术数据稀缺且评估协议碎片化，对面向手术场景理解的通用多模态大语言模型（MLLM）的评估仍然受限。我们通过一个两阶段评估框架来应对这些挑战。第一阶段我们提出SurgKnowBench，一个统一了公开手术数据集跨术式与任务、并评估专有与开源MLLM的诊断基准，用以刻画预训练手术能力的边界。SurgKnowBench揭示当前模型保留了部分视觉先验，但在关系性与程序性理解及工作流评估上仍然薄弱。基于这一失败边界，并受外科训练分阶段模式启发，我们提出SurgAgentGym，一个智能体环境，其中通用MLLM智能体可对SurgWiki进行受限知识检索，并使用通用视觉定位完成手术任务。SurgAgentGym评估通用智能体能否在推理时通过工具中介的证据使用提升手术理解，而无需额外手术训练。结果表明，智能体推理主要在感知密集型任务上缩小差距，而细粒度定位和专家式评估仍是持续瓶颈。这为未来智能体化手术理解研究开辟了道路。
translation.brief: 针对手术场景理解评估缺乏的问题，构建两阶段基准，先评测MLLM预训练能力边界，再用智能体环境检验工具使用能否在推理时提升手术理解。

papers.title: Semantically Aligned KV Cache Compression for Efficient Agentic Autoregressive Video Generation
papers.abstract: Agentic autoregressive video generation combines semantic planning, sequential generation, and visual verification for controllable synthesis. Growing visual histories enlarge the key-value (KV) cache, increasing memory use and attention costs across candidate rollouts. Existing compression methods primarily optimize individual generators without the planner's semantic constraints, risking low priority for states supporting requested attributes or actions. We introduce SemanticKV, a training-free method for semantically aligned KV cache compression. To our knowledge, SemanticKV is the first KV cache compression method for agentic autoregressive video generation that explicitly uses planner-extracted semantic constraints to guide retention. Text cross-attention identifies constraint-related video positions, whose self-attention queries are collected into separate groups. Attention weights are averaged within each group and maximized across groups, giving each cached entry a high score when strongly used by any represented constraint. A single top-k selection retains high-scoring entries under the memory budget, leaving their keys, values, and positions unchanged. For fixed query groups and equal entry costs, this selection minimizes an additive upper bound on worst-group discarded attention. The method operates independently within each candidate without retraining or additional video generations. We evaluate four AR video backbones on three benchmarks for 5-, 30-, and 60-second generation. On Causal Forcing at a compression ratio of 0.7, SemanticKV obtains a VBench Total Score of 84.10, compared with 84.05 for the strongest compressed baseline and 83.99 for Full KV. It achieves a 1.22x speedup over Full KV and reduces KV-cache memory from 6.04 GB to 1.81 GB, a 3.35x reduction.

translation.title: 面向高效智能体自回归视频生成的语义对齐KV缓存压缩
translation.abstract: 智能体自回归视频生成结合语义规划、顺序生成与视觉验证以实现可控合成。不断增长的视觉历史会扩大键值（KV）缓存，增加候选推演中的内存占用与注意力开销。现有压缩方法主要针对单个生成器优化，缺乏规划器的语义约束，可能低优先级保留支持请求属性或动作的状态。我们提出SemanticKV，一种免训练的语义对齐KV缓存压缩方法。据我们所知，SemanticKV是首个面向智能体自回归视频生成、显式利用规划器提取的语义约束来指导保留的KV缓存压缩方法。文本交叉注意力识别与约束相关的视频位置，其自注意力查询被归入不同组；在组内平均注意力权重并在组间取最大值，使每个缓存条目在被任一所代表的约束强烈使用时获得高分。单一的top-k选择在内存预算下保留高分条目，其键、值和位置保持不变。对于固定的查询组和相同的条目开销，该选择最小化最差组被丢弃注意力的可加性上界。该方法在每个候选内独立运行，无需重训练或额外视频生成。我们在三个基准上对四个自回归视频骨干网络在5、30和60秒生成下进行评估。在Causal Forcing上压缩率为0.7时，SemanticKV获得VBench总分84.10，而最强压缩基线为84.05，完整KV为83.99；相比完整KV获得1.22倍加速，KV缓存内存从6.04 GB降至1.81 GB，缩减3.35倍。
translation.brief: 针对智能体自回归视频生成中KV缓存膨胀的问题，提出免训练的SemanticKV方法，用规划器语义约束指导top-k缓存条目保留。

papers.title: Coding Agents Propagate Vulnerabilities in Code Bases
papers.abstract: LLM-based coding agents are widely used to develop critical production software. Even though coding agents are known to occasionally write vulnerable code, there has not been any investigation into how code base vulnerabilities evolve over time under coding agent contributions. In this work, we close this gap by investigating whether and how vulnerabilities in existing code lead coding agents to introduce similar vulnerabilities in the code they write. We first evaluate coding agents on 96 tasks that require implementing a new backend application in a repository where other applications already exist. Second, we investigate repository-level code generation on 20 pairs of tasks in real C/C++ projects. In each task, the agent is asked to complete code critical to memory safety. We find that in both settings, insecure existing code leads to agents writing vulnerable code more often. In backend generation, insecure neighbors reduce the share of correct and secure implementations by 3.4% on average, and in C/C++ repository-level coding, the average gap between secure and insecure contexts reaches 35.4%. Prompting to follow existing code-style or to be careful about security increases, respectively decreases, how strongly agents propagate vulnerabilities, but neither stops them. When asked to explain their implementation choices, coding agents attribute them to following another code site in 76.5% of cases, even though they recognize the introduced vulnerability in 69.9% of cases. These findings show that agents use existing vulnerabilities as templates for new ones indiscriminatorily, turning each contribution into an opportunity to introduce more vulnerabilities. As such, as agents write a growing share of production code under decreasing human review, code bases can increasingly degrade in security if security vulnerabilities are not thoroughly fixed continuously.

translation.title: 编程智能体会传播代码库中的漏洞
translation.abstract: 基于LLM的编程智能体被广泛用于开发关键生产软件。尽管已知编程智能体偶尔会写出易受攻击的代码，但尚无研究考察代码库漏洞在智能体贡献下如何随时间演变。我们通过研究现有代码中的漏洞是否以及如何导致编程智能体在其编写的代码中引入类似漏洞来填补这一空白。我们首先在96个需要在已有其他应用后端实现的仓库中编写新后端应用的任务上评估编程智能体；其次，我们在20对真实C/C++项目的任务上研究仓库级代码生成，每项任务要求智能体完成对内存安全至关重要的代码。我们发现，在两种设置下，不安全的现有代码都会更频繁地导致智能体写出易受攻击的代码：在后端生成中，不安全的邻近代码平均使正确且安全实现的比例降低3.4%；在C/C++仓库级编码中，安全与不安全上下文之间的平均差距达35.4%。提示智能体遵循现有代码风格会增强其传播漏洞，提示其注意安全会减弱传播，但均无法阻止。当要求解释实现选择时，编程智能体在76.5%的情况下将其归因于模仿另一处代码，尽管其中69.9%的情况下它们已识别出所引入的漏洞。这些发现表明智能体不加区分地将现有漏洞作为新漏洞的模板，使每次贡献都可能引入更多漏洞。因此，随着智能体编写的生产代码份额日益增大而人工审查减少，若不持续彻底修复安全漏洞，代码库的安全性可能不断退化。
translation.brief: 研究发现现有代码中的漏洞会诱导编程智能体模仿并引入新的相似漏洞，即使提示注意安全也无法完全阻止。

papers.title: RealEmbedBench: Benchmarking LLMs on Real-World Application-Layer Embedded Software Tasks
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) perform well on general coding tasks, but their capabilities in application-layer embedded software development remain underexplored. Existing embedded benchmarks primarily focus on hardware-in-the-loop validation in simulated environments. We introduce RealEmbedBench, a benchmark of 5,142 samples covering three application-layer tasks: code generation and completion, state machine modeling and implementation, and cross-OS code translation. We evaluate six representative LLMs and find substantial performance differences across tasks and models. Project context, especially the local code window, significantly affects code generation and completion. Models perform reasonably well at state machine modeling but struggle to translate these models into executable code. Cross-OS translation performance varies substantially by direction. Translation from Harmony to RT-Thread is particularly challenging, with an average pass rate of 0.1667. These findings suggest that developers should consider local code context when using LLMs for code generation and completion and select models according to the translation direction. They also motivate the use of more real-world state machine implementation data in LLM training to narrow the gap between modeling and executable code.

translation.title: RealEmbedBench：在真实世界应用层嵌入式软件任务上评测大语言模型
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）在通用编程任务上表现出色，但其在应用层嵌入式软件开发中的能力仍未被充分探索。现有嵌入式基准主要关注模拟环境中的硬件在环验证。我们提出RealEmbedBench，一个包含5,142个样本的基准，涵盖三类应用层任务：代码生成与补全、状态机建模与实现，以及跨操作系统代码翻译。我们评测了六个代表性LLM，发现不同任务和模型之间存在显著性能差异。项目上下文（尤其是局部代码窗口）对代码生成与补全影响显著。模型在状态机建模方面表现尚可，但难以将这些模型转化为可执行代码。跨操作系统翻译性能因方向不同差异很大，从Harmony翻译到RT-Thread尤其困难，平均通过率仅为0.1667。这些发现表明，开发者在用LLM进行代码生成与补全时应考虑局部代码上下文，并根据翻译方向选择模型。这些发现也促使在LLM训练中使用更多真实世界的状态机实现数据，以缩小建模与可执行代码之间的差距。
translation.brief: 构建涵盖代码生成补全、状态机实现和跨OS翻译的5,142样本嵌入式基准RealEmbedBench，并系统评测六个LLM在真实应用层嵌入式任务上的能力。

papers.title: GOPR-CAD: Graph-of-Operations Progressive Reasoning for CAD Generation
papers.abstract: Generating accurate CAD models requires substantial engineering expertise and careful control of geometry, topology, and mechanical constraints. Text-to-CAD aims to simplify this process, but current LLM-based methods often generate CAD programs directly. Language models remain unreliable when producing long code while coordinating coupled geometric, topological, and dimensional constraints. Consequently, executable programs may still produce structurally incorrect models, which execution rate and rendered appearance may fail to reveal. To address these limitations, we propose GOPR-CAD, an agentic Text-to-CAD pipeline based on Graph-of-Operations Progressive Reasoning. A language model acts as a decision agent over encapsulated CAD operations and progressively constructs an executable operation graph, which a deterministic compiler converts into the final CAD model. This separation requires no additional training and supports different language models. To evaluate structural fidelity, we construct MHCAD, a benchmark of 300 standard mechanical part requirements derived from Machinery's Handbook. Their explicit structures enable reference-free STEP/B-rep evaluation. GOPR-CAD achieves 82.7% Structural Yield on MHCAD, and 87.2% Structural Yield on an external CADPrompt subset.

translation.title: GOPR-CAD：面向CAD生成的图操作渐进推理
translation.abstract: 生成准确的CAD模型需要大量工程专业知识以及对几何、拓扑和机械约束的精细控制。Text-to-CAD旨在简化这一过程，但当前基于LLM的方法通常直接生成CAD程序。语言模型在生成协调耦合几何、拓扑和尺寸约束的长代码时仍不可靠。因此，可执行的程序仍可能产生结构上错误的模型，而执行率和渲染外观可能无法揭示这些错误。为解决这些局限，我们提出GOPR-CAD，一个基于图操作渐进推理的agentic Text-to-CAD流水线。语言模型作为封装CAD操作之上的决策agent，渐进地构建可执行的操作图，再由确定性编译器转换为最终CAD模型。这种分离无需额外训练，并支持不同的语言模型。为评估结构保真度，我们构建了MHCAD，一个源自《Machinery's Handbook》的300个标准机械零件需求基准。其显式结构支持无参考的STEP/B-rep评估。GOPR-CAD在MHCAD上达到82.7%的结构良率（Structural Yield），在外部CADPrompt子集上达到87.2%。
translation.brief: 提出GOPR-CAD，让LLM作为决策agent渐进构建封装CAD操作图并由确定性编译器生成模型，以解决直接生成CAD程序导致结构错误的问题。

papers.title: Beyond Ranking: Are Decision Models Calibrated Relevance Scorers?
papers.abstract: Decision models such as Jev are a new kind of relevance scorer. Their typed score primitive takes a question, an ordered set of textual relevance levels and a state, and returns a probability for each level directly, rather than token likelihoods or generated labels. Jev's vendor promises that these probabilities are calibrated. This motivates revisiting 'Beyond Yes and No', which improved zero-shot pointwise LLM reranking using likelihood-derived scores over fine-grained relevance labels but left calibration against human assessors as future work. In this paper, we first reproduce its open-model FLAN-UL2 setting on eight BEIR collections, confirming its ranking trends, and then run Jev and two open-weight decision models with the same protocol. Jev and the 27B pplx-decider rerank ahead of FLAN-UL2 and three cross-encoders on average. We then compare Jev's native probabilities with the human assessors' labels and find them overconfident: of the DL21 pairs it scores above 0.9, only 66% are relevant. Since this is mostly an error of scale, a two-parameter calibration fitted on 2,257 DL19 pairs removes much of it and transfers to DL21. After calibration, Jev has a lower DL21 Brier score than FLAN-UL2 and the three cross-encoders, mainly because it separates relevant from non-relevant pairs better. Finally, with calibrated probabilities, choosing each query's cut-off by expected F1 needs no parameter of its own, beats a fixed top-10 cut and matches a cut-off threshold tuned on DL19.

translation.title: 超越排序：决策模型是经过校准的相关性评分器吗？
translation.abstract: 以Jev为代表的决策模型是一类新的相关性评分器。其类型化评分原语接受一个问题、一个有序的文本相关性级别集合和一个状态，直接返回每个级别的概率，而非token似然或生成的标签。Jev的厂商承诺这些概率是经过校准的。这促使我们重新审视《Beyond Yes and No》，该工作利用基于细粒度相关性标签的似然派生分数改进了零样本pointwise LLM重排，但把针对人工评估者的校准留作未来工作。本文首先在八个BEIR集合上复现其开放模型FLAN-UL2设置，确认其排序趋势，然后用相同协议运行Jev和两个开放权重决策模型。Jev和27B的pplx-decider重排平均领先于FLAN-UL2和三个cross-encoder。随后，我们将Jev的原生概率与人工评估者的标签比较，发现其过度自信：在其评分高于0.9的DL21样本对中，只有66%是相关的。由于这主要是量级误差，在2,257个DL19样本对上拟合的两参数校准消除了大部分误差，并可迁移到DL21。校准后，Jev的DL21 Brier分数低于FLAN-UL2和三个cross-encoder，主要因为它能更好地区分相关与不相关样本对。最后，借助校准后的概率，按期望F1为每个查询选择截断点无需额外参数，优于固定top-10截断，并与在DL19上调优的截断阈值相当。
translation.brief: 复现并扩展pointwise重排研究，检验决策模型Jev等输出概率的校准性，发现其过度自信并用两参数校准显著改善相关性概率估计。

papers.title: THEATRON: A Benchmark for Evaluating Persona Persistence in Long-Horizon LLM Decision-Making
papers.abstract: Existing evaluations often test persona expression rather than whether persona information persists in extended decision-making. We introduce THEATRON, a controlled benchmark that uses financial replay to evaluate persona persistence in long-horizon sequential decision-making. In these environments, models conditioned on fixed behavioral-finance personas observe shared daily market evidence and trajectory-specific account-state feedback and make sequential decisions over multi-month trajectories. We evaluate Zero-Shot, One-Shot, and Chain-of-Thought persona injection across four LLMs, using cumulative-return and action trajectories to diagnose within-persona stability, cross-persona separability, and action collapse. Persona conditioning produces systematic behavioral shifts beyond a no-persona baseline, and persona-level separation generally exceeds the variation induced by semantically equivalent descriptions. Nevertheless, these shifts do not reliably form coherent persona-specific policies: apparently stable separation can arise from stereotyped action collapse, while diverse policies can exhibit noisy trajectory switching. These findings expose a gap between observable persona-induced behavior and persistent, context-sensitive persona-conditioned decision policies. Code and benchmark data are publicly available at: https://github.com/yuyan12138/theatron

translation.title: THEATRON：评测长时程LLM决策中人格持久性的基准
translation.abstract: 现有评测往往测试人格表达，而非人格信息是否在长时程决策中持续存在。我们提出THEATRON，一个使用金融回放的受控基准，用于评估长时程序贯决策中的人格持久性。在这些环境中，以固定行为金融学人格为条件的模型观察共享的每日市场证据和轨迹特定的账户状态反馈，并在数月的轨迹上做出序贯决策。我们在四个LLM上评测Zero-Shot、One-Shot和Chain-of-Thought人格注入，利用累计收益和动作轨迹诊断人格内稳定性、跨人格可分性和动作坍缩。人格条件产生了超越无人格基线的系统性行为偏移，且人格层面的分离通常超过语义等价描述引发的变异。然而，这些偏移并不能可靠地形成连贯的人格特定策略：看似稳定的分离可能源于刻板的动作坍缩，而多样的策略也可能表现出嘈杂的轨迹切换。这些发现揭示了可观察的人格诱导行为与持久、上下文敏感的人格条件决策策略之间的差距。代码和基准数据公开于：https://github.com/yuyan12138/theatron
translation.brief: 构建基于金融回放的受控基准THEATRON，诊断LLM在长时程序贯决策中人格条件是否真正形成持久一致的决策策略。

papers.title: JoMoHa: Joint Model--Harness Optimization with Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: The performance of language agents depends jointly on model weights and the harness. Optimizing either alone can be constrained by the other component, limiting overall performance gains. Our analysis of naive alternating training reveals progressive incompatibility between the model and harness, which increasingly interferes with task execution and may also undermine model training, leading to performance degradation. To coordinate the evolution of models and harnesses, we introduce JoMoHa, to our knowledge the first framework to jointly train an executable harness generation policy and a task execution policy through reinforcement learning. JoMoHa outperforms the evaluated weight-only and harness-only baselines and achieves the highest success rates among the evaluated methods on ALFWorld, WebShop, and DBBench, averaging 70.3% and reaching 97.0% on ALFWorld. By learning both task execution and runtime improvement from its own generated trajectories, JoMoHa performs recursive self-improvement (RSI).

translation.title: JoMoHa：基于强化学习的模型-执行框架联合优化
translation.abstract: 语言agent的性能同时取决于模型权重和执行框架（harness）。单独优化任一组件都可能受另一组件的制约，限制整体性能提升。我们对朴素交替训练的分析揭示了模型与框架之间的渐进性不兼容，这种不兼容日益干扰任务执行，也可能损害模型训练，导致性能退化。为协调模型与框架的协同演化，我们提出JoMoHa，据我们所知是首个通过强化学习联合训练可执行框架生成策略和任务执行策略的框架。JoMoHa超越了所评测的仅权重和仅框架基线，在ALFWorld、WebShop和DBBench上取得所评测方法中最高的成功率，平均70.3%，在ALFWorld上达到97.0%。通过从自身生成的轨迹中同时学习任务执行和运行时改进，JoMoHa实现了递归自我改进（RSI）。
translation.brief: 提出JoMoHa，用强化学习联合训练任务执行策略与可执行框架生成策略，解决模型与harness交替优化时相互制约导致性能退化的问题。

papers.title: AgentCT: A Vision-Language Agent for Universal CT Imaging
papers.abstract: Computed tomography (CT) restoration methods often use a single network for low-dose CT (LDCT), sparse-view CT (SVCT), and metal artifact reduction (MAR), despite the distinct physics of these degradations. We propose AgentCT, a vision-language agent that identifies the degradation and routes images to task-specific restoration models. A LoRA-adapted Qwen3-VL-4B controller predicts degradation type and severity, selects a specialist, and reassesses the restored image. The LDCT specialist uses an image-domain diffusion model, whereas the SVCT and MAR specialists combine projection-domain correction, data consistency, differentiable filtered back-projection, and image refinement. We evaluated the controller and specialists separately on patient-disjoint Mayo 2020 abdominal CT data across three severity levels for each degradation. The controller achieved 95.7% accuracy for degradation type and 93.9% for severity, with a 100% JSON parse rate. Using ground-truth degradation labels for routing, AgentCT achieved an overall PSNR/SSIM of 46.18 dB/0.984, compared with 44.93 dB/0.976 for AMIR and 44.29 dB/0.979 for TAMP, and attained the highest PSNR in all nine settings. For SVCT, its dual-domain specialist achieved 46.04 dB with 4.2 million parameters, compared with 44.43 dB for single-task AMIR and 43.57 dB for all-in-one AMIR with 23.5 million parameters. These results support degradation-specific CT restoration with controller-based model selection; evaluation under automatic routing and on independent clinical data remains necessary. Code is available at https://github.com/hao1635/AgentCT.

translation.title: AgentCT: A Vision-Language Agent for Universal CT Imaging
translation.abstract: Computed tomography (CT) restoration methods often use a single network for low-dose CT (LDCT), sparse-view CT (SVCT), and metal artifact reduction (MAR), despite the distinct physics of these degradations. We propose AgentCT, a vision-language agent that identifies the degradation and routes images to task-specific restoration models. A LoRA-adapted Qwen3-VL-4B controller predicts degradation type and severity, selects a specialist, and reassesses the restored image. The LDCT specialist uses an image-domain diffusion model, whereas the SVCT and MAR specialists combine projection-domain correction, data consistency, differentiable filtered back-projection, and image refinement. We evaluated the controller and specialists separately on patient-disjoint Mayo 2020 abdominal CT data across three severity levels for each degradation. The controller achieved 95.7% accuracy for degradation type and 93.9% for severity, with a 100% JSON parse rate. Using ground-truth degradation labels for routing, AgentCT achieved an overall PSNR/SSIM of 46.18 dB/0.984, compared with 44.93 dB/0.976 for AMIR and 44.29 dB/0.979 for TAMP, and attained the highest PSNR in all nine settings. For SVCT, its dual-domain specialist achieved 46.04 dB with 4.2 million parameters, compared with 44.43 dB for single-task AMIR and 43.57 dB for all-in-one AMIR with 23.5 million parameters. papers.title: On the Relative Security of Prompt Injection: Mechanised Definitions, Defences and Verdicts for LLM Agents
papers.abstract: An LLM agent that reads untrusted content, such as an email or a web page, may follow instructions hidden in it. Noninterference is too strong for such agents, since a useful agent lets untrusted content influence what it does and may disclose the user's data by design, and declassification needs a release policy written for each task. We instead state security relative to a reference agent, which runs the same plan under the same runtime monitor with a model that never obeys untrusted content. An agent is relatively secure if every leak it has is a leak the reference already has. Our framework, PlanTERS, instantiates relative security, a notion from speculative execution, with a small agent language in which the attacker chooses how the model follows instructions, a composition with runtime monitors, and attacker models that differ in what they observe. A fence theorem shows that revoking injectable tools at the first untrusted read, and never granting them back, makes every plan relatively secure at the event level on finite runs, for every model behaviour in which each injection is a single call and the model obeys on a schedule fixed in advance; with a fairness condition, this extends to possibly infinite runs. We prove or refute relative security for agents with fences, budgets, approvals, loops and dual LLMs, in Isabelle/HOL.

papers.title: Review the Episodes, Refine the Lessons: Simple Memory Evolution for Embodied Agents
papers.abstract: Recent studies of embodied agents based on frontier multimodal large language models (MLLMs) develop harness engineering around the MLLM, such as harnesses with post-trained policies and recursive self-improvement loops. Yet whether these additions exceed the native capability of the MLLM remains unexplored. We introduce SimplEvo to explore how far an MLLM can improve under direct control when it retains its execution experience in self-written text memories. It requires no weight updates, post-trained policies, or privileged information. The MLLM writes a coordinate-free task memory once from a single demonstration. Under a strict train-test protocol, it then creates a bounded working memory on training episodes only and refines it after each episode with lessons on procedure, completion, and recovery. Both memories stay fixed at test time. On EBench, SimplEvo lifts the success rate (SR) of GPT-6-Astra under direct control from 46.7% to 81.7%, and tops the RoboDojo leaderboard with 69.63% SR and a score of 75.32. Compared with memories that also store past visual frames, SimplEvo reaches a similar SR with text memory alone while using fewer tokens. With its memories fixed, SimplEvo also generalizes to unseen layouts and randomized scene configurations. Moreover, the working memory transfers across models: written by GPT-6-Astra, it can be reused as is by weaker MLLMs and improve their performance without any adaptation of their own.

papers.title: Probing Transformer Representations Layer by Layer, Module by Module
papers.abstract: Which representation should be probed in a transformer-based foundation model? Recent work shows that the standard practice of probing the final layer is often suboptimal, as intermediate layers can provide better features. Yet, representations are still largely studied along depth alone, treating each transformer block as an atomic unit. In this work, we analyze transformer representations layer by layer, module by module. Through more than 144,000 linear probing evaluations of vision foundation models (VFMs) and large language models (LLMs), we show that layer and module choices should be considered jointly: the best layer-module pair yields substantially larger gains over the final-layer residual stream than the best layer with the residual stream fixed. Moreover, module performance can vary substantially across layers, showing that useful representations cannot be characterized by depth alone. Building on these findings, we evaluate simple fixed probing strategies: the final-layer feedforward activation (Act@100) for vision and the second normalization layer at 60% depth (LN2@60) for language. These strategies improve over the probing baseline in a majority of evaluations and recover, on average, 42% and 86% of the gains from probing the best layer-module pair for vision and language, respectively. For VFMs, these gains increase with the transfer difficulty between pretraining and downstream data.

papers.title: Ostinato: Fast CPU-GPU MoE Inference for Local Agents via Resident Experts in Every Forward Pass
papers.abstract: Language-model agents increasingly run on workstations with a few consumer GPUs, where large mixture-of-experts (MoE) models keep part of their experts in host memory. With existing CPU-GPU engines, these agents get fast prefill or fast decode, not both: llama.cpp's expert cache skips forward passes of more than 32 tokens to keep the experts of decode cached, so an agent waits 2.1-2.8 s after each tool output, whereas its default layer placement shortens this wait but is 1.5-1.6$\times$ slower in decode. Our key insight is that a short prefill touches too many distinct experts to upload, yet sends 84% of its expert activations (routes) to a stable set of experts that fits in GPU memory. We present Ostinato, a CPU-GPU MoE inference engine that computes these experts on the GPUs in every forward pass without changing what the model computes. Short prefills split their routes, leaving fewer than one of a token's six routed experts per layer to the CPU; long prefills upload each distinct cold expert once; and each decode step runs as one fixed-shape CUDA graph per GPU. On real coding and customer-service agent sessions with DeepSeek-V4-Flash on four RTX 4090D GPUs, Ostinato is the fastest engine in both phases and finishes every session sooner than all six baselines. Against llama.cpp and KTransformers, it cuts the median wait after a tool output by 22-55% and finishes sessions 1.4-2.5$\times$ sooner.

papers.title: PRISM: Causal Counterfactual Minimization of Agent Tool Privileges via Information Bottleneck Role Induction
papers.abstract: This paper shifts the object of role engineering from human users to large language model (LLM) agents, and proposes PRISM to address the over-authorization that arises when an agent obtains full tool privileges through the Model Context Protocol (MCP). PRISM formulates whether a tool is necessary for a task as an intervenable causal proposition, and applies structured interventions in a sandbox to learn a counterfactual necessity model. It then compresses trajectories into discrete latent variables through an information bottleneck, and determines the number of roles from the knee of the rate-distortion curve. Finally, it formalizes pruning as a bilevel Stackelberg game, in which a generative flow network samples diverse near-optimal solutions. On three public benchmarks, AgentDojo, $τ$-bench and ToolEmu, PRISM compresses the number of authorized tools per role by 78.3%, attains a task success rate of 78.2%, reaches a counterfactual necessity accuracy of 88.7%, and lowers the blast radius to 15.9%.

papers.title: Safeguarding Agentic AI in Radiology Workflows: A Multimodel Evaluation of Rule-based and Large Language Model-based Verification
papers.abstract: Purpose: To estimate how often tool-using large language model (LLM) agents record clinically relevant false or unsupported information in simulated radiology documentation and how much safeguards applied before each action reduce these errors. Materials and Methods: In this simulation study (October 2026), 48 synthetic, radiologist-reviewed base scenarios covered finding communication, tumor board preparation and follow-up management. Forty-three also had a misleading-information variant (91 variants). Six LLM agents (Claude Sonnet 5.5, GPT-6.1-Sol, GLM-5.3, MiniMax M3, Gemma-4-31B, Qwen3.8-27B) completed each variant with permissions only, deterministic rules, and rules plus a locally run LLM checker (1638 episodes). The primary outcome was at least one executed high-severity violation per episode. Risk differences were estimated per agent at base-scenario level and, exploratorily, pooled across agents, with analyses of document access and blocks. Results: With permissions only, 7.3%-27.1% of episodes had a high-severity violation (pooled across agents, 19.4%). Pooled, it was 16.7% with rules (-2.8 percentage points; 95% CI: -6.1, 0.5) and 13.2% with rules plus the LLM checker (-6.2; 95% CI: -9.5, -3.0). Adding the LLM checker to rules changed it by -3.5 (95% CI: -6.3, -0.7). No difference between agents was detected (P = .43), and task success did not decrease detectably. In misleading variants, agents opened the altered document in 83% of episodes regardless of error, and 58% of erroneous statements cited it. Most blocked actions (64%-68%) would not have caused a violation and were returned for revision. Conclusion: Layered safeguards reduced but did not prevent high-severity errors. Errors after misleading information reflected misjudged rather than missed information.

papers.title: The Complexity of Computing a Competitive Equilibrium in Fisher Markets with Chores
papers.abstract: We study the complexity of computing competitive equilibria in Fisher markets with divisible chores and positive rational disutility coefficients and earning requirements. For linear disutilities, we prove that exact equilibrium computation is CLS-complete. In particular, the problem remains CLS-hard even when the earning requirements are binary in $1$ and $2^k$, where $k$ is an integer. We prove hardness by encoding the first-order conditions of a box-constrained quadratic program in equilibrium prices and earning flows, using a compact minimum-cost flow construction. For convex constant-elasticity-of-substitution (CES) disutilities, exact equilibrium prices may be irrational. We formulate the problem of finite-precision equilibrium price computation, in which we seek rational prices with a certified market clearing error at most a given rational tolerance encoded in binary. We prove that this problem is CLS-complete for every fixed rational exponent $ρ>1$. To prove this hardness, we encode a quartic polynomial through the fourth-order expansion of the CES price potential function corresponding to the Eisenberg-Gale (EG) dual program, and show that every sufficiently accurate approximate equilibrium of the constructed market lies near uniform prices. Additionally, we also identify a tractable special case of chores Fisher markets. In particular, we provide a strongly polynomial algorithm for exact equilibrium computation in linear markets whose disutility matrix has rank at most two and earning requirements are arbitrary positive rationals. For $n$ agents and $m$ chores, the algorithm uses $O(nm(n+m))$ rational arithmetic operations and comparisons, with polynomial intermediate encoding length.

papers.title: InfraRSI: Harnessing Recursive Self-Improvement for Training Infrastructure
papers.abstract: While Recursive Self-Improvement (RSI) accelerates isolated algorithm and kernel synthesis, distributed LLM training depends on tightly coupled launch settings, operator kernels, and communication schedules, where single edits often hit out-of-memory (OOM) boundaries, compiler conflicts, measurement jitter, or silent numerical drift. We present InfraRSI, the agentic harness that turns open-ended human commands into verified training optimizations via a five-stage workflow: init locks editable scope and a fixed task contract over workload, loss, and timing invariants to prevent reward hacking, doctor profiles baseline phases and calibrates cluster noise, run co-optimizes launch knobs and code patches before re-verifying top candidates against the baseline and logging findings to a cross-hardware experience bank, and report and apply audit source paths, track failed-trial costs, and commit promoted changes. Rather than stepping greedily from a single incumbent, InfraRSI initializes from diverse experience-seeded configurations and fits global execution-time and censored peak-memory models across all trials, including OOMs. Using these models, it prices per-setting memory costs, revises miscalibrated LLM priors from live runs, and pairs memory-hungry optimizations with memory savers and verified code patches. Across four single- and multi-node dense and Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) LLM workloads, InfraRSI achieves a speedup of up to $2.75\times$ and lifts mean Model FLOPs Utilization (MFU) from $17.4\%$ to $30.0\%$, outperforming existing tuners and coding agents while transferring experience across GPUs. As it improves training infrastructure efficiency, InfraRSI forms a two-level Recursive Self-Improvement loop---revising priors online within runs and distilling experience across clusters---to push foundation model scaling.

papers.title: LiveAsset: Learning Intent Assets from Corrective Interactions for Agent Runtime Control
papers.abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents acting across web applications and online services often need multi-turn corrections to align their work with users' underspecified goals and preferences. In practice, users may identify problems in the current outcome without specifying the desired result, so learning user intentions requires interpreting each correction against the agent's preceding and revised outcomes. These expectations are often connected to a particular context, making it hard to know when they apply and how to ensure the agent later acts as the user expects. To this end, we propose LiveAsset, an intent harness that learns reusable intent assets from corrective interactions and uses them for runtime control of agent execution. LiveAsset jointly interprets each correction with the agent's original and revised results to infer user intent, incrementally updating the assets while preserving earlier requirements that remain applicable. The learned requirements guide agent execution from task entry and provide criteria for runtime verification, which uses the explanations to assess applicability before each reply is delivered and directs the agent to revise the result to address unmet requirements while preserving those already satisfied. Following a learning phase in which simulated users progressively reveal requirements through multi-turn corrections, we evaluate LiveAsset using same-task replay of the original requests on π-Bench, PERMA, and Vita and cross-task transfer on PAST-Bench and SkillEvolBench. Experiments show that LiveAsset better fulfills requirements learned from corrective interactions and improves performance on these benchmarks compared with memory, skill, and rule-based harness baselines. Code is available at github.com/landian60/LiveAsset.

papers.title: Actions Should EARN Their Credit: Test-Time Adaptation and Route Consolidation for Frozen LLM Agents
papers.abstract: LLM agents can use feedback from repeated attempts to improve their decisions without updating model parameters. However, positive action credits can continue to favor actions that repeatedly achieve the same score, even when higher scores are achievable. Under a fixed interaction budget, trying new actions in the final attempts can also lower performance. We introduce EARN, a method that uses past experience to guide further progress and retain earlier performance through conditional reuse of effective action sequences. EARN reduces action credits for reaching scores repeatedly attained in earlier episodes and assigns larger credits to action segments that reach higher scores. These credits adjust the probabilities of LLM-proposed actions. During the final episodes, EARN directly replays stored actions when the current context matches the recorded context and the actions remain available, bypassing LLM candidate generation. We evaluate performance at the end of the interaction budget using the average score over the final four episodes. Across Jericho, ScienceWorld, and Crafter, EARN achieves the best score on this metric in 31 of 33 task--budget settings among the evaluated methods, including ties. Across the evaluated Jericho budgets, replay bypasses 78.9--86.3\% of candidate-generation calls in the final four episodes, averaged across games.

papers.title: Treating the Model as an Untrusted Component: Deterministic Policy Enforcement, Human Approval and Taint Tracking Against Prompt Injection in Tool-Using Agents, with Validation on Open-Weights Models
papers.abstract: Tool-using LLM agents act on instructions embedded in the data they read, so prompt injection is a structural rather than a prompt-wording problem. We compare in-prompt defences (hardened prompts, spotlighting, LLM detectors) with deterministic enforcement outside the model (four reference monitors of increasing strength), human approval and taint tracking, judged by one effect-based oracle independent of every defence in an executable environment of 13 tasks and 12 tools, with argument-fuzzing attackers and severity-weighted harm. In an evaluation with real open-weights models (Qwen2.5-1.5B and Qwen2.5-7B; 156 attack episodes per defence and model), the models proposed the attacker's call in 64% and 84% of attack episodes behind the task-bound monitor, which admitted 1.3% and 7.7%; guardrail effects depended on the model (a prompt guardrail moved obedience from 67% to 65% and from 86% to 55%, spotlighting plus a detector to 12% and 0%) against static attacks. Simulation with an assumed model covers what no real run did: under the assumed erosion law a persistent adaptive attacker or a compromised model drives every guardrail stack to 100.0% attack success, whereas the task-bound monitor holds severe actions at 0.0%; its residual (harm 0.69/10) falls by 62% under taint-triggered human review, and a human layer without a deterministic monitor fails against approval spamming unless each episode has a deterministic approval budget. Implementation quality matters: a naive monitor admits 18 of 33 effective attack variants, a hardened one 6 and a capability-bound one 1. The real-model evidence is limited to two open-weights models and static attacks, the human-approval and taint results are simulation-only, and the larger model's detector stack contradicts the assumed erosion law. Code, data, a two-rater oracle audit and a notebook for repeating the real-model evaluation are provided.

translation.abstract: Tool-using LLM agents act on instructions embedded in the data they read, so prompt injection is a structural rather than a prompt-wording problem. We compare in-prompt defences (hardened prompts, spotlighting, LLM detectors) with deterministic enforcement outside the model (four reference monitors of increasing strength), human approval and taint tracking, judged by one effect-based oracle independent of every defence in an executable environment of 13 tasks and 12 tools, with argument-fuzzing attackers and severity-weighted harm. In an evaluation with real open-weights models (Qwen2.5-1.5B and Qwen2.5-7B; 156 attack episodes per defence and model), the models proposed the attacker's call in 64% and 84% of attack episodes behind the task-bound monitor, which admitted 1.3% and 7.7%; guardrail effects depended on the model (a prompt guardrail moved obedience from 67% to 65% and from 86% to 55%, spotlighting plus a detector to 12% and 0%) against static attacks. Simulation with an assumed model covers what no real run did: under the assumed erosion law a persistent adaptive attacker or a compromised model drives every guardrail stack to 100.0% attack success, whereas the task-bound monitor holds severe actions at 0.0%; its residual (harm 0.69/10) falls by 62% under taint-triggered human review, and a human layer without a deterministic monitor fails against approval spamming unless each episode has a deterministic approval budget. Implementation quality matters: a naive monitor admits 18 of 33 effective attack variants, a hardened one 6 and a capability-bound one 1. The real-model evidence is limited to two open-weights models and static attacks, the human-approval and taint results are simulation-only, and the larger model's detector stack contradicts the assumed erosion law. Code, data, a two-rater oracle audit and a notebook for repeating the real-model evaluation are provided.

papers.title: Same Error, Different Recovery: How Delivery Changes LLM Agent Behavior
papers.abstract: A tool-using language model must decide whether to retry a failed call, correct it, or stop and tell the user. The error text alone may not be enough: the same feedback can lead to different actions depending on where it appears in the conversation. We isolate this delivery problem by varying placement, guidance, retained history and turn structure. Two studies with plans fixed before data collection, across 13 open models from 3B to 70B parameters, compare the next action and subsequent task completion, with exact deterministic reruns. A new user turn that retains the failed exchange avoids the severe stopping failure observed in Llama models when that exchange is removed. It is non-inferior to history rewriting in pooled synthetic comparisons, but is not best for every model. We implement this form as an opt-in recovery layer within a deterministic inference engine and evaluate it on public benchmarks and a coding agent. On ToolMaze, it raises success on explicit errors by 14.2 points with 7-8B models and 10.5 points with 32-70B models; Loud/Quiet, 24 multi-turn tasks with visible failures and silent corruption, scored by final-state agreement, shows no measurable gain. A client given the exact fault kind performs better still. The findings support delivery as a distinct factor in recovery, not an engine-exclusive solution or a universal retry policy.

papers.title: FinCutBench: A Continually Updated Benchmark for Measuring the Temporal Boundaries of LLM Financial Knowledge
papers.abstract: In financial backtesting and other point-in-time tasks, external inputs can be restricted by date, but model parameters may retain financial facts disclosed later, introducing parametric look-ahead bias. We introduce FinCutBench, a continually updated monthly financial knowledge benchmark for measuring how far a fixed model's financial knowledge extends over calendar time. The current dataset contains 9,000 Chinese and English four-option multiple-choice questions from January 2023 to September 2026, covering Chinese and U.S. markets and four categories of financial information. We construct monthly knowledge profiles using the approximate months in which the tested facts became public. After a profile passes the decline test and knot checks, we define the FinCut Boundary as the first month when the fitted profile reaches its lower level, and report the stability of the estimated date under resampling. Boundary dates and localization precision vary across models. Using the independently measured Transition Start and Boundary as fixed references for downstream sample grouping, we find clear relative declines after the Boundary in U.S. asset ranking and earnings recall for some models, while Chinese-market ranking estimates vary across models and all eight disclosure-period-paired forecast-error comparisons have unadjusted $p$ values above 0.10. The FinCut Boundary thus provides an empirical reference for the temporal scope of parametric knowledge in point-in-time financial evaluation, supporting evaluation-window selection and result interpretation.

papers.title: Out of Parameters, Saved by Syntax: UD-PrMPT for Parser Augmented Low Resource Machine Translation
papers.abstract: Recent work advancing machine translation quality using LLMs for very low resource languages has relied on the injection of lexicon-based prompt components to expose vocabulary to models. However, these approaches run into a ceiling when models must guess sentence meaning purely from plausible combinations of possible word senses mapped to strings. In this paper we test UD-PrMPT, an approach using syntactic analyses in the Universal Dependencies formalism as prompt components to improve MT in five diverse low resource languages: Beja, Chintang, Chukchi, Coptic, and Xibe. Our results show additive improvements which stack on top of the lexicon based approach which are stronger for higher quality manual analyses but consistent for predicted parses as well.

translation.title: Out of Parameters, Saved by Syntax: UD-PrMPT for Parser Augmented Low Resource Machine Translation
