papers.title: Weight-Space Programming of Policies and Their Verification via Model Checking
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) can write the weights of small neural networks directly, without gradient descent. This weight-space programming creates policies for sequential decision-making from a task description alone, but nothing guarantees that a written policy behaves as intended. We combine weight-space programming with probabilistic model checking. Given an environment modeled as a Markov decision process and a requirement in probabilistic computation tree logic (PCTL), an LLM writes all weights of a policy network, optionally repairs them on a dataset of optimal actions, and receives model-checking feedback until the requirement holds or a round limit is reached. The model checker Storm computes, rather than estimates from simulations, the probability that the policy satisfies the requirement, so every returned policy is verified. With two LLMs on three environments, the created policy of each of the 18 runs attains the optimal probability, before any dataset or model-checking feedback. Four of six policies programmed for two transporter jobs also complete three jobs with probability 1, so they generalize to a task that the LLM never saw. The pipeline also programs a policy that satisfies a complex safety requirement expressed with the PCTL until operator in all six runs. In one of them, dataset repair raised the accuracy to 98.4\% but broke the requirement, and one round of model-checking feedback restored it.

translation.title: 策略的权重空间编程及基于模型检测的验证
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）可以直接写出小型神经网络的权重，而无需梯度下降。这种权重空间编程仅凭任务描述即可为序贯决策创建策略，但无法保证写出的策略按预期行事。我们将权重空间编程与概率模型检测相结合。给定建模为马尔可夫决策过程的环境和概率计算树逻辑（PCTL）表达的需求，LLM 写出策略网络的全部权重，可选地在最优动作数据集上进行修复，并接收模型检测反馈，直到需求成立或达到轮数上限。模型检测器 Storm 计算而非通过仿真估计策略满足需求的概率，因此每个返回的策略都经过验证。在三个环境中使用两个 LLM，全部 18 次运行所创建的策略在任何数据集或模型检测反馈之前就达到了最优概率。为两个运输任务编程的六个策略中有四个还以概率 1 完成三个任务，从而泛化到 LLM 从未见过的任务。该流程还编程出满足用 PCTL until 算子表达的复杂安全需求的策略，全部六次运行均成功。其中一次运行中，数据集修复将准确率提升至 98.4% 却破坏了需求，而一轮模型检测反馈恢复了它。
translation.brief: 解决 LLM 直接编写策略网络权重时缺乏行为保证的问题，方法是将权重空间编程与基于 Storm 的概率模型检测结合，用 PCTL 需求的模型检测反馈迭代验证和修复策略。

papers.title: ScanDreamer: A Map-Grounded World Model for Quadrotor Navigation
papers.abstract: Quadrotors inspecting buildings and tunnels must navigate unknown clutter with a forward-facing depth camera whose limited field of view constrains scene understanding and collision-avoiding navigation. Recent world-model agents learn navigation through imagined experience (e.g., AirDreamer), but remain data-intensive and often lack explicit geometric memory and awareness of what the camera can observe. We propose ScanDreamer, a map-grounded world model that constructs an online 2D scan-memory map from depth images and vehicle pose. Our world model, actor, and critic are conditioned on this map, which also defines a geodesic progress reward. Moreover, a forward-cone penalty discourages horizontal motion outside the camera's viewing direction. During imagination, ScanDreamer propagates the quadrotor pose over a frozen map and derives progress and wall-contact signals from the mapped geometry. We train ScanDreamer for 0.8 million environment steps (5.5 h on one GPU) and evaluate it in NVIDIA Isaac Sim over 1560 episodes spanning unseen layouts and parameter ranges. Across three seeds (mean $\pm$ SD), ScanDreamer achieves 96.3 $\pm$ 0.3% success with 3.6 $\pm$ 0.3% collision, compared with 59.6 $\pm$ 3.0% success and 28.8 $\pm$ 2.8% collision for AirDreamer at the same online-interaction budget. Removing the forward-cone penalty increases collisions to 9.9 $\pm$ 3.1%. These results show that combining explicit map memory, map-grounded imagination, and perception-aware motion substantially improves navigation performance and data efficiency. The source code is available at https://github.com/WANGSHUAIzzzz/ScanDreamer.

translation.title: ScanDreamer：面向四旋翼导航的地图接地世界模型
translation.abstract: 检查建筑和隧道的四旋翼必须在前视深度相机视野受限、制约场景理解与避障导航的情况下，在未知杂乱环境中导航。近期的世界模型智能体（如 AirDreamer）通过想象经验学习导航，但仍需大量数据，且往往缺乏显式几何记忆和对相机可观测范围的感知。我们提出 ScanDreamer，一种地图接地的世界模型，它从深度图像和载具位姿在线构建 2D 扫描记忆地图。我们的世界模型、actor 和 critic 均以该地图为条件，该地图还定义了测地进度奖励。此外，前向锥惩罚抑制相机 viewing 方向之外的水平运动。在想象过程中，ScanDreamer 在冻结地图上传播四旋翼位姿，并从地图几何推导进度和撞墙信号。我们用 80 万环境步（单 GPU 5.5 小时）训练 ScanDreamer，并在 NVIDIA Isaac Sim 中跨越未见布局和参数范围的 1560 个回合上评估。跨三个随机种子（均值 ± 标准差），ScanDreamer 达到 96.3 ± 0.3% 的成功率与 3.6 ± 0.3% 的碰撞率，而相同在线交互预算下 AirDreamer 为 59.6 ± 3.0% 的成功率与 28.8 ± 2.8% 的碰撞率。移除前向锥惩罚会使碰撞率升至 9.9 ± 3.1%。这些结果表明，结合显式地图记忆、地图接地想象和感知感知的运动，能显著提升导航性能与数据效率。源代码见 https://github.com/WANGSHUAIzzzz/ScanDreamer。
translation.brief: 解决前视深度相机视野受限下四旋翼在未知环境中导航数据需求高的问题，方法是在线构建 2D 扫描记忆地图并以此条件化世界模型训练，辅以测地进度奖励和前向锥惩罚。

papers.title: ODSA: Orchestrated Discovery and Self-Aggregation
papers.abstract: Test-time scaling improves the accuracy of a language model's answers by spending more computation at inference time. Established methods do so either sequentially, revising a single solution over several passes, or in parallel, generating several independent solutions and selecting among them. We present ODSA (Orchestrated Discovery and Self-Aggregation), an LLM-directed scaling framework in which an orchestrator LLM is given existing test-time scaling methods as actions --- discovery of a new independent solution, comparison of existing solutions to build a better one, and acceptance of a proposed answer, which triggers its verification --- and directs stateless workers to carry them out. The orchestrator does not solve the problem itself: it allocates computation, feeds the results of earlier actions into later ones, and takes every action from a single context, so that each decision is informed by everything tried before. On Humanity's Last Exam, ODSA improves accuracy by 4.7 to 18.0 points across three models over a single direct call to the model with no test-time scaling. On LiveCodeBench, where a single direct call already solves most problems, it improves accuracy by 0.6 to 14.0 points.

translation.title: ODSA：编排式发现与自聚合
translation.abstract: 测试时扩展通过在推理时投入更多计算来提升语言模型答案的准确性。已有方法要么串行地在多次迭代中修订单一解，要么并行地生成多个独立解并在其中选择。我们提出 ODSA（编排式发现与自聚合），一个由 LLM 指导的扩展框架：编排器 LLM 将现有测试时扩展方法视为动作——发现新的独立解、比较现有解以构造更好的解、以及接受候选答案（触发其验证）——并指挥无状态的 worker 执行这些动作。编排器自身不解题：它分配计算，将先前动作的结果输入后续动作，并从单一上下文执行每个动作，使每个决策都基于此前尝试过的一切。在 Humanity's Last Exam 上，ODSA 相对无测试时扩展的单次直接调用，在三个模型上将准确率提升 4.7 至 18.0 个百分点。在 LiveCodeBench 上（单次直接调用已能解决大多数问题），它将准确率提升 0.6 至 14.0 个百分点。
translation.brief: 解决测试时计算扩展策略固定低效的问题，方法是用一个编排器 LLM 把发现新解、比较聚合和接受验证等扩展方法作为动作统一调度，指挥无状态 worker 执行。

papers.title: Inside the Trading Loop: Markets, Models, and Moves with LLM Agents
papers.abstract: We built a hybrid multi-agent trading system that combines large language model (LLM) analysts with momentum-based portfolio construction and rule-based execution. Company-news and macroeconomic agents return structured reports to a coordinator that sets stock weights and cash reserves. We evaluate the portfolio engine using its broker-recorded paper account, which operated with deterministic fallbacks, and compare LLM-enabled configurations through retrospective replays. From March 11 to August 28, 2026, the account returned 34.5%, compared with 14.4% for the S&P 500 fund SPY over the same dates. This raw return advantage came with a larger maximum drawdown. Reconstructed policies also finish above matched SPY and QQQ references when assessments are used in the same session or deferred to the next. Design comparisons examine cash authority, selective invocation, and response contracts. A constant-cash control gives a return estimate close to stance-based sizing, and shorter report contracts improve observed parsing but can change recommendations.

translation.title: 交易回路内部：市场、模型与 LLM 智能体的操作
translation.abstract: 我们构建了一个混合多智能体交易系统，将大语言模型（LLM）分析师与基于动量的组合构建和规则化执行相结合。公司新闻和宏观经济智能体向协调器返回结构化报告，协调器据此设定股票权重和现金储备。我们使用其券商记录的模拟账户评估组合引擎，该账户以确定性回退运行，并通过回溯重放比较启用 LLM 的配置。2026 年 3 月 11 日至 8 月 28 日，该账户回报 34.5%，而同期 S&P 500 基金 SPY 为 14.4%。这一原始回报优势伴随着更大的最大回撤。当评估在同一会话中使用或延迟至下一会话时，重构的策略也跑赢匹配的 SPY 和 QQQ 基准。设计比较考察了现金权限、选择性调用和响应契约。恒定现金控制的回报估计接近基于立场的仓位设定，而更短的报告契约改善了观测到的解析效果，但可能改变建议。
translation.brief: 解决如何将 LLM 分析有效融入实际交易系统的问题，方法是将 LLM 新闻与宏观分析智能体的结构化报告接入基于动量的组合构建与规则化执行引擎，并用回溯重放评估。

papers.title: RADE: Risk-Adjusted Deployment Efficiency, A Framework for Routing, Memory, and Escalation in Safe LLM Systems
papers.abstract: A deployed language model does not merely answer questions. It spends computation, consumes time, consults evidence, exposes memory, invites or avoids human review, and sometimes makes mistakes whose consequences are radically unequal. Yet LLM systems are still commonly compared as if the relevant object were a single model and the relevant outcome were a single benchmark score. This paper argues that the unit of analysis should instead be the deployment policy: the mechanism that decides when to retrieve, when to remember, when to call a larger model, when to verify, and when not to answer at all. We introduce risk-adjusted deployment efficiency (RADE), a system-level objective that scores the utility a deployment delivers net of inference, retry, oversight, and priced expected failure cost, while treating harms that cannot be priced as hard budgets alongside constraints on latency, privacy, and resources. The framework brings selective routing, retrieval and governed memory, efficient specialization, uncertainty estimation, abstention, and human escalation into a common account. We then examine five deployment regimes in which the same nominal LLM capability leads to different rational architectures, and propose a reporting protocol based on risk-coverage behavior, end-to-end cost, update drift, memory exposure, evidence quality, and escalation load. The central claim is modest but consequential: frontier capability should be treated as a resource to allocate, not a default state to maintain. A safe and sustainable system is not the one that always uses the strongest model; it is the one that spends capability where the reduction in risk or increase in utility justifies the cost.

translation.title: RADE：风险调整部署效率——安全 LLM 系统中路由、记忆与升级的框架
translation.abstract: 部署的语言模型不只是回答问题。它消耗计算和时间，查阅证据，暴露记忆，邀请或回避人工审查，有时还犯下后果极不相同的错误。然而 LLM 系统仍常被当作单一模型和单一基准分数来比较。本文主张分析单元应当是部署策略：决定何时检索、何时记忆、何时调用更大模型、何时验证以及何时干脆不作答的机制。我们提出风险调整部署效率（RADE），一个系统级目标，对部署在扣除推理、重试、监督和定价的预期失败成本后交付的效用进行评分，同时将无法定价的危害作为硬预算，与延迟、隐私和资源约束并列。该框架将选择性路由、检索与受治理的记忆、高效专业化、不确定性估计、弃答和人工升级纳入统一核算。随后我们考察五种部署情形——其中相同的名义 LLM 能力会导致不同的合理架构——并提出基于风险-覆盖行为、端到端成本、更新漂移、记忆暴露、证据质量和升级负载的报告协议。核心主张朴素但影响深远：前沿能力应被视为需要分配的资源，而非需要维持的默认状态。安全且可持续的系统不是始终使用最强模型的系统，而是把能力花在风险降低或效用提升足以证明成本合理之处的系统。
translation.brief: 解决将 LLM 系统当作单一模型和基准分数评估的局限问题，方法是把部署策略（路由、记忆、验证、升级等决策机制）作为分析单元，提出以风险调整部署效率为核心的系统级评估框架与报告协议。

papers.title: SurfScaff3D: Bridging Geometric and Semantic Representations for LLM-based 3D Object Generation
papers.abstract: Creating high-quality 3D content has traditionally required specialist expertise and experience with complex tools. The growing ecosystem of AI-assisted creativity demands accessible and intuitive 3D generation systems. Recent advances in Large Language Models (LLMs) offer promising directions, yet extending their generative capabilities to 3D remains fundamentally challenging because existing 3D representations are not naturally compatible with language-based reasoning. Current approaches either depend on expensive fine-tuning or impose restrictive structural priors that sacrifice expressiveness and exclude organic shapes. We argue that the mismatch between LLM-native reasoning and conventional 3D parameterizations is a core bottleneck of LLM-driven 3D generation. To address this, we introduce the Hierarchical Patch Scaffold (HPS), a representation designed around semantically meaningful, interpretable part-level abstractions that are naturally understood by both humans and LLMs, enabling expressive, editable, and open-domain 3D generation without imposing restrictive geometric priors or expensive fine-tuning. Building upon HPS, we introduce SurfScaff3D, an interactive framework for text and image-to-3D generation. HPS inherits the flexibility of B-spline patches, while exposing an interface that leverages open-world capabilities of foundation models to reliably generate 3D. Its hierarchical part-level semantic labels enable targeted, natural-language edits at any level of granularity without re-running generation. Further, HPS offers explicit per-patch control over surface detail, enabling more expressive geometry capable of representing arbitrary objects. Extensive experiments against state-of-the-art LLM-based 3D generation methods demonstrate strong geometric fidelity, semantic alignment, and flexible editing across diverse object categories.

translation.title: SurfScaff3D：为基于LLM的3D物体生成架起几何与语义表示的桥梁
translation.abstract: 高质量3D内容创作历来需要专业知识和复杂工具经验，AI辅助创作生态的兴起要求易用直观的3D生成系统。尽管大语言模型（LLM）的进展提供了有前景的方向，但将其生成能力扩展到3D仍然面临根本性挑战，因为现有3D表示与基于语言的推理并不天然兼容。现有方法要么依赖昂贵的微调，要么施加限制性结构先验，牺牲了表达能力并排除了有机形状。我们认为LLM原生推理与传统3D参数化之间的失配是LLM驱动3D生成的核心瓶颈。为此，我们提出层次化补丁骨架（HPS），一种围绕语义有意义、可解释的部件级抽象设计的表示，可被人类和LLM自然理解，实现表达力强、可编辑、开放领域的3D生成，而无需施加限制性几何先验或昂贵微调。基于HPS，我们提出SurfScaff3D，一个文本与图像到3D生成的交互式框架。HPS继承了B-spline补丁的灵活性，同时暴露出利用基础模型开放世界能力可靠生成3D的接口。其层次化部件级语义标签支持任意粒度的自然语言定向编辑而无需重新运行生成。此外，HPS提供对每个补丁表面细节的显式控制，使几何能表达任意物体。与最先进的基于LLM的3D生成方法的大量实验表明，其在多样物体类别上具有强几何保真度、语义对齐和灵活编辑能力。
translation.brief: 解决LLM与现有3D表示不兼容导致3D生成受限的问题，提出语义化的层次化补丁骨架（HPS）表示及交互式生成框架SurfScaff3D。

papers.title: The Average Patient: Do Simulated Psychiatric Patients Answer Like Real People?
papers.abstract: Language models are used as simulated psychiatric patients to train clinicians and evaluate AI therapists, and are judged by plausibility or total scores. We give a framework for simulated respondents: an information budget bounds how much simulated patients can differ, and an average-patient hypothesis, that a model answers each item at the level typical of the named condition and severity, implies little variation, a full profile of the condition's typical symptoms and totals at or above the top of the stated severity band. We examine these implications at matched totals on item-level data from eight human samples, including a clinical and an instructed-feigning sample. Across 17 models, simulated patients vary 1.5 to 11 times less than real respondents with the same total and on most questionnaires endorse nearly every symptom at a middling level; on the PHQ-9 their symptoms covary less like real ones. People, honest or feigning, answer "not at all" about as often as genuine patients with the same totals, and more often than every model. Single answers are highly concentrated, and prompt changes, published personas, larger models and reasoning reduce the pattern without removing it. In interviews, patients told a severity are rated as having nearly every symptom, so an assessment agent's recognition of absent symptoms goes untested, and scored against the stated severity the agent places a quarter of them in their band, against about half of patients given a real symptom profile. Having the model word such a profile restores half to two thirds of the variation.

translation.title: 平均病人：模拟精神病人回答得像真人吗？
translation.abstract: 语言模型被用作模拟精神病人来训练临床医生和评估AI治疗师，并以合理性或总分来评判。我们给出模拟受访者的分析框架：信息预算限制了模拟病人可差异的程度，而“平均病人假设”——即模型按所述疾病及严重程度的典型水平回答每个条目——意味着变异很小、完整呈现该疾病典型症状且总分处于或高于所述严重程度区间上界。我们在总分匹配的条件下，对包括临床样本和装病指令样本在内的八个人类样本的条目级数据检验这些推论。在17个模型中，模拟病人的变异比同总分真实受访者少1.5到11倍，且在多数问卷上以中等水平几乎确认每一症状；在PHQ-9上其症状共变也不像真实情况。无论诚实还是装病的人，回答“完全没有”的频率与同总分真实病人相当，且高于所有模型。单个回答高度集中，提示词修改、发布的人物设定、更大模型和推理能力可缓解但无法消除该模式。在访谈中，被告知严重程度的病人被评为几乎具有每一症状，因此评估智能体识别缺失症状的能力未被检验，且以所述严重程度评分时智能体将其四分之一置于该区间，而给定真实症状特征的病人约为二分之一。让模型据实表述症状特征可恢复一半到三分之二的变异。
translation.brief: 揭示LLM模拟精神病人回答过于集中、缺乏真实变异（平均病人效应），并提出信息预算与平均病人假设的检验框架来评估模拟受访者与真实人类回答的差异。

papers.title: Self-Indexing Latent Memories for Access-Aware Continual Instruction Tuning of LLMs
papers.abstract: Continual instruction tuning often preserves old skills with task-private modules. Inference still requires selecting the right module from the prompt alone. We introduce Task-Isolated Latent Adapter Continual Training (TILA-CT), a replay-free method that makes each task module self-indexing. Each task receives a latent memory and adapter bank in a frozen LLM. During adaptation, the memory gathers causal-prefix information and injects task-conditioned context. For access, its persistent state provides the routing prototype used by a shared prompt-only router. On the 8-task CT-Pipeline stream, TILA-CT achieves 65.19 acquisition and 63.98 final macro score, with 1.38 points of average forgetting. A middle-reversed order gives 65.38 acquisition and 64.17 final macro score. Across 6 backbones, final scores remain within 1.5 points of acquisition. Ablations support memory-derived routing keys and causal gathering. Final macro routing accuracy is 93.9\%, and oracle routing recovers 1.21 final macro points. These results separate preserved task computation from learned access to it.

translation.title: 用于LLM访问感知持续指令微调的自索引潜记忆
translation.abstract: 持续指令微调常用任务私有模块来保留旧技能，但推理时仍需仅凭提示词选择正确的模块。我们提出任务隔离潜适配器持续训练（TILA-CT），一种无重放方法，使每个任务模块可自索引。每个任务在冻结的LLM中获得一个潜记忆和适配器组。适配过程中，记忆收集因果前缀信息并注入任务条件化的上下文。在访问方面，其持久状态提供共享的仅提示词路由器所用的路由原型。在8任务CT-Pipeline流上，TILA-CT获得65.19的习得分数和63.98的最终宏平均分数，平均遗忘仅1.38分。中段逆序下习得为65.38、最终宏平均为64.17。在6个骨干模型上，最终分数与习得分数差距在1.5分以内。消融实验支持源自记忆的路由键和因果收集。最终宏平均路由准确率为93.9%，oracle路由可再提升1.21最终宏平均分。这些结果将保留的任务计算与对它的习得访问相分离。
translation.brief: 解决持续指令微调中仅凭提示词选择任务模块困难的问题，提出TILA-CT方法，通过自索引潜记忆提供路由原型实现无重放的持续训练。

papers.title: Direct GPU Energy Measurements of Batch-Level Sharing in Mixture-of-Experts and Recurrent Models
papers.abstract: Energy claims for efficient neural networks are often inferred from operation counts. We report direct GPU energy measurements on two workloads that batch very differently, recurrent policies in GPU-vectorised multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) and mixture-of-experts (MoE) language models, and ask one question of both: can the rows of a batch be made to share computation, across the batch and over time, at a measured saving? On recurrent policies the answer so far is no. Shared activity patterns exist but rarely last one step, masking a frozen policy fails, and trained-in masks succeed only because a fixed mask is equivalent to a narrow GRU, at 11x the energy of a small dense policy in our implementation. Test-time steering adds nothing beyond re-picking on either workload. On MoE models the answer is yes, and granularity decides how much: on Qwen3-30B-A3B, batch-aware routing reads 25-31% fewer expert weights within KL 0.05, with benchmark changes within noise at 500 items, and uses 12-18% less energy per token on a fused forward. We also introduce persistence-aware OEA, a one-parameter rule that keeps the batch-aware cut with about 40% fewer new experts per step than native routing at batch 32-64, though its energy has not yet been measured. These are pilot measurements on one GPU type, and we state their limits.

translation.title: 混合专家与循环模型中批次级共享计算的GPU直接能耗测量
translation.abstract: 高效神经网络的能耗声明常由算子计数推断。我们对两个批处理方式迥异的工作负载——GPU向量化多智能体强化学习（MARL）中的循环策略和混合专家（MoE）语言模型——进行GPU直接能耗测量，并对二者提出同一问题：批中的行能否在批内和时间维度上共享计算，并带来实测的节省？对循环策略，目前答案是否定的：共享活动模式存在但极少持续一步，冻结策略的掩码失败，训练出的掩码之所以有效仅因固定掩码等价于一个窄GRU，在我们的实现中能耗是小稠密策略的11倍。测试时引导在两个负载上都不优于重新选择。对MoE模型答案是肯定的，且粒度决定节省程度：在Qwen3-30B-A3B上，批次感知路由在KL 0.05内读取的专家权重减少25-31%，500条样本上基准变化在噪声范围内，融合前向中每token能耗降低12-18%。我们还提出持久性感知OEA，一种单参数规则，在批次32-64下每步新专家数比原生路由少约40%仍保持批次感知的裁剪，但其能耗尚未测量。这些是单一GPU类型的试点测量，我们说明了其局限。
translation.brief: 通过GPU直接能耗测量检验批次行能否共享计算，发现循环策略难以实现共享而MoE模型的批次感知路由可显著降低能耗。

papers.title: Scalable Counterfactual Explanations for Time Series via Policy Learning
papers.abstract: Generating counterfactual (CF) explanations for time series is challenging due to complex temporal dependencies and the computational inefficiency of traditional instance-specific optimization. We propose a policy learning framework for counterfactual explanation in time series, trained as a one-step contextual-bandit policy-learning problem. By training an actor-critic agent in the latent space of a pre-trained autoencoder, our method learns a transferable policy that captures global structural regularities. Unlike existing methods that rely on iterative optimization for each new input, the learned policy enables direct generation of valid and plausible counterfactuals through a single forward pass, avoiding per-instance optimization at inference time. Experiments on 13 UCR benchmark datasets show that our framework achieves high validity and strong plausibility across multiple anomaly detection metrics. Overall, by decoupling counterfactual generation from per-instance optimization, the proposed method provides an efficient and scalable alternative to existing approaches for time series counterfactual explanations.

translation.title: 基于策略学习的可扩展时间序列反事实解释
translation.abstract: 为时间序列生成反事实（CF）解释具有挑战性，原因在于复杂的时序依赖和传统实例级优化的计算低效。我们提出一个用于时间序列反事实解释的策略学习框架，将其训练为单步上下文赌博机策略学习问题。通过在预训练自编码器的潜空间中训练actor-critic智能体，我们的方法学得一个捕捉全局结构规律的迁移策略。与依赖对新输入进行迭代优化的现有方法不同，学得的策略通过单次前向传播直接生成有效且合理的反事实，避免推理时的逐实例优化。在13个UCR基准数据集上的实验表明，该框架在多个异常检测指标上达到高有效性和强合理性。总体而言，通过将反事实生成与逐实例优化解耦，所提方法为时间序列反事实解释提供了高效且可扩展的替代方案。
translation.brief: 解决时间序列反事实解释中逐实例优化计算低效的问题，提出在自编码器潜空间训练actor-critic策略以单次前向传播直接生成反事实。

papers.title: CASCoDe: A Closed-Loop Agentic Framework for Analog Sizing and Layout Co-Design
papers.abstract: Expert analog layouts differ from auto-generated ones in density and regularity, not only in legality: experts make a succession of discrete, hierarchical physical decisions and revisit each after extracted electrical results, while most existing automated flows act on a physical search space fixed before the controller runs. We present CASCoDe, a closed-loop LLM agent framework for analog netlist-to-layout design that formalizes those expert decisions as a hierarchical discrete action space-sizing selection, structural floorplan, local layout refinement, routing-attempt selection-on which the agent runs feedback-driven tree search from a circuit netlist to a verified GDS. The agent authors the circuit-specific floorplans and scripts, and an execution layer of interface adaptations over adapted tools make every action land at physical implementation and be judged by DRC, LVS, and extracted-RC simulation. On 20 SKY130 amplifiers spanning single-, two-, and three-stage topologies, CASCoDe is the only flow that delivers a DRC- and LVS-clean routed layout when meeting design specifications for every circuit. It reduces area by 59-85% (mean 71%) against a conventional P&R flow on identical PCells, raises mean device density from 0.39 to 0.74 against APPlace, MAGICAL, ALIGN and ICPI. A layout that beats every baseline in area and legality appears after 11 minutes of agent time on average, and ablations show that the structured action space and the feedback-guided tree search each reduce area and search cost.

translation.title: CASCoDe：面向模拟电路尺寸设计与版图协同设计的闭环智能体框架
translation.abstract: 专家模拟电路版图与自动生成版图的差异不仅在于合法性，还在于密度与规整度：专家会做出一系列离散、层次化的物理决策，并在提取电学结果后反复审视每项决策，而大多数现有自动化流程作用于控制器运行前就已固定的物理搜索空间。我们提出CASCoDe，一个面向模拟电路从网表到版图设计的闭环LLM智能体框架，将专家决策形式化为层次化离散动作空间——尺寸选择、结构化布局规划、局部版图细化、布线尝试选择——智能体在其上运行反馈驱动的树搜索，从电路网表到经验证的GDS。智能体自行编写电路特定的布局与脚本，由接口适配组成的执行层使每个动作都落地为物理实现，并通过DRC、LVS和提取RC仿真进行评判。在涵盖单级、两级和三级拓扑的20个SKY130放大器上，CASCoDe是唯一在满足所有电路设计规格的同时交付DRC和LVS均通过的可布线版图的流程。在相同PCell下，相比传统P&R流程，其面积减少59-85%（平均71%）；相比APPlace、MAGICAL、ALIGN和ICPI，平均器件密度从0.39提升至0.74。平均智能体运行11分钟后即可得到在面积和合法性上超越所有基线的版图，消融实验表明结构化动作空间和反馈引导的树搜索均能降低面积与搜索成本。
translation.brief: 针对模拟电路版图自动化设计中搜索空间固定、缺乏专家式迭代决策的问题，提出闭环LLM智能体框架CASCoDe，将设计决策形式化为层次化离散动作空间并运行反馈驱动的树搜索，实现从网表到验证版图的自动生成。

papers.title: Steering Emergent Behavior in Multi-Agent LLM Systems via Information Networks
papers.abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly operate in groups, each pursuing an individual objective while jointly determining system performance. If an operator controls which agent observes which other agent, but not their payoffs or messages, how should observations be structured to raise collective welfare? We make the information network (who observes whom) a design object, decoupled from the fixed interaction network over which agents act. Ten identical LLM agents play repeated group-decision games; by default each observes only an anonymous summary of the group's previous-round outcome, and a manager with a fixed budget adds directed observation links that reveal peers' past actions. Across 1,080 episodes and six games spanning coordination, anti-coordination, social dilemmas, and discovery, we ask how much information to share and, at a fixed budget, who should observe whom. Disclosure creates behavioral coupling: observation acts as a contagion channel whose welfare effect depends on the alignment between individually attractive behavior and the collective objective. First, the value of information is alignment-contingent: more peer information tends to help or be neutral when individual behavior is aligned with the collective goal, but under free-riding or congestion externalities it amplifies collectively harmful behavior; in a public-goods game the group does best with no information at all. We read this sign separation as a cross-game regularity within one controlled LLM population, not a model-invariant law. Second, at a fixed budget, who observes whom matters primarily when coupling is harmful: a modular "barbell" that lets sub-populations entrench harmful behavior is reliably the worst wiring, reversing the network-reciprocity intuition from human evolutionary game theory. These results argue against a default of full transparency for agent collectives.

translation.title: 通过信息网络引导多智能体LLM系统中的涌现行为
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）智能体越来越多地以群体形式运作，每个智能体追求各自的目标，同时共同决定系统性能。如果操作者只控制哪个智能体观察哪个其他智能体，而不控制其收益或消息，应如何组织观察以提升集体福祉？我们将信息网络（谁观察谁）作为设计对象，与智能体行动所依赖的固定交互网络解耦。十个相同的LLM智能体进行重复群体决策博弈；默认情况下每个智能体只观察群体上一轮结果的匿名摘要，而拥有固定预算的管理者可以添加有向观察链接以揭示同伴的过去行为。跨越1080个回合和六种博弈（涵盖协调、反协调、社会困境和发现类博弈），我们探讨应共享多少信息，以及在固定预算下谁应观察谁。信息披露产生行为耦合：观察充当传染通道，其福利效应取决于个体上有吸引力的行为与集体目标之间的一致性。第一，信息的价值取决于一致性：当个体行为与集体目标一致时，更多同伴信息往往有益或中性；但在搭便车或拥塞外部性下，它会放大对集体有害的行为；在公共物品博弈中，群体在完全不共享信息时表现最好。我们将这种符号差异解读为同一受控LLM群体内的跨博弈规律，而非模型不变的定律。第二，在固定预算下，谁观察谁主要在耦合有害时才重要：允许子群体固化有害行为的模块化哑铃结构总是最差的连接方式，这与人类演化博弈论中的网络互惠直觉相反。这些结果表明不应将完全透明作为智能体集合的默认设置。
translation.brief: 针对多智能体LLM系统中如何设计智能体间的观察结构以提升集体福祉的问题，提出将信息网络（谁观察谁）作为设计对象，通过固定预算下管理者添加观察链接的群体决策实验，分析信息披露对集体行为的影响规律。

papers.title: ShadowBench-MCP: Measuring Shadow Invocations in MCP-Style Tool Routing
papers.abstract: LLM agents increasingly act as routers for tools, APIs, and software-supply-chain workflows, making an execution path - rather than generated text alone - a security-relevant model output. We study shadow invocation: a task-preserving request variant that causes an LLM router to select a riskier execution path, potentially skipping validation, provenance, staging, redaction, or audit controls even though the request does not ask for a malicious action. We introduce ShadowBench-MCP, a benchmark and metric suite that separates task preservation (TPSS), operational pressure (OPSS), and route-geometric drift (RGAS), and combines them in the pre-execution SODS score. In a focused policy-ablation study using a Groq-hosted qwen/qwen3-32b router, 120 routing decisions yield 96 original-versus-variant comparisons across six security-sensitive workflows. Efficiency-first routing produces a 29.2% shadow-invocation rate and 26.7% safety-tool skip rate. Policy-aware routing reduces these to 4.2% and 1.7%, respectively, corresponding to an 85.7% relative reduction in shadow invocations. Pre-execution signals distinguish shadow routes with ROC AUC up to 0.94. These results are early, single-router evidence of a policy-dependent routing-layer security effect, not a claim of universal vulnerability.

translation.title: ShadowBench-MCP：度量MCP式工具路由中的影子调用
translation.abstract: LLM智能体日益充任工具、API和软件供应链工作流的路由器，使得执行路径——而不仅仅是生成的文本——成为与安全相关的模型输出。我们研究影子调用：一种保持任务不变的请求变体，会使LLM路由器选择风险更高的执行路径，可能跳过验证、来源、预发布、脱敏或审计控制，即使请求本身并未要求恶意行为。我们提出ShadowBench-MCP，一个基准与指标套件，将任务保持（TPSS）、操作压力（OPSS）与路由几何漂移（RGAS）分开度量，并在执行前将它们组合为SODS分数。在使用Groq托管的qwen/qwen3-32b路由器的聚焦策略消融研究中，120次路由决策在六个安全敏感工作流上产生96组原始与变体对比。效率优先路由产生29.2%的影子调用率和26.7%的安全工具跳过率；策略感知路由将两者分别降至4.2%和1.7%，对应影子调用相对减少85.7%。执行前信号区分影子路由的ROC AUC最高达0.94。这些结果是关于路由层安全效应依赖策略的早期单路由器证据，并非普适性漏洞声明。
translation.brief: 针对LLM工具路由中影子调用（保持任务不变但选更危险执行路径）的安全度量问题，提出ShadowBench-MCP基准与指标套件，并通过策略消融实验验证策略感知路由可显著降低影子调用率。

papers.title: Decalage: Uncovering the Gap Between Model-Generated Reasoning and Actual Code Implementation in Small Language Models
papers.abstract: Agentic code generation often asks a model to explain its reasoning before it writes code, and a common way to make such a workflow safer is to add a security instruction to the prompt. We test what that instruction does in small language models, which are attractive because they run locally and cheaply. Four open code models of 1.5B to 3B parameters generate C++ from 166 sections of eleven public requirements documents, once with a general prompt and once with a secure prompt. The secure prompt more than doubles the share of reasoning about validation, resource handling and threats, and we find no evidence that the rise is larger for requirements with security content. The code changes only in part. Among functions with a body and reasoning, the share with a check that our lexical test recognises rises from 23% to 39%, but more than a quarter of the functions remain stubs, compile rates stay low, and half or more of the functions whose reasoning mentions a check contain no such check. Two rounds of compiler-feedback repair leave more than 80% of sections unusable, and neither cppcheck nor an exploratory ESBMC run separates the prompts on the usable code. A hand check by two annotators supports the stub measure and the direction of the reasoning result. For small models, a security instruction changes the reasoning broadly but the code only in part, so the reasoning should be checked against the code rather than trusted.

translation.title: Decalage：揭示小型语言模型中模型生成推理与实际代码实现之间的差距
translation.abstract: 智能体代码生成常要求模型在写代码前解释其推理，而提升此类工作流安全性的常见做法是在提示中加入安全指令。我们在小型语言模型上测试该指令的作用——这类模型因可本地、低成本运行而颇具吸引力。四个1.5B至3B参数的开源代码模型从11份公开需求文档的166个章节生成C++代码，分别使用通用提示和安全提示。安全提示使关于验证、资源处理和威胁的推理占比提高一倍以上，且没有证据表明该提升在含安全内容的需求上更大。代码只部分改变。在有函数体和推理的函数中，我们的词法测试能识别出检查的占比从23%升至39%，但超过四分之一的函数仍是存根，编译率依然很低，且推理中提到检查的函数有一半以上并不包含此类检查。两轮编译器反馈修复后仍有超过80%的章节不可用，在可用代码上cppcheck和探索性的ESBMC运行均无法区分两种提示。两位标注者的手工核查支持存根度量与推理结果的结论。对小型模型而言，安全指令广泛改变了推理但只部分改变了代码，因此推理应对照代码进行核查而非直接信任。
translation.brief: 针对安全提示指令对小型语言模型代码生成实际作用的问题，通过多模型多需求文档实验发现其推理改变大但代码实现改变有限，推理与代码之间存在显著差距，需对照代码核查推理。

papers.title: Explaining and interrupting collective misalignment in language model systems
papers.abstract: In collectives, language model agents can exchange individually innocuous messages that together support a policy violation. Understanding and preventing collective misalignment requires answering the question of which messages sufficiently influenced and necessarily enabled the violation. Collective Dependence Analysis (CDA) operationalises necessity and sufficiency to explain decisions and find the fewest removals interrupting support within tested combinations. Tests covered constructed violations, unscripted agent conversations, and recorded interactions, with selected message removals reducing violations from 93% to 6% in controlled cases. Using O(N) model evaluations for N messages, CDA achieves the same violation reduction with half the deletions of a frontier LLM judge given the transcript and asked for all supporting messages in eligible operational cases. CDA also proposes the mechanism through which the collective misalignment emerged. Nonetheless, complete explanations remain difficult on unfamiliar tasks and some removals can inadvertently disrupt correct decisions. CDA unifies explanations of collective misalignment with experimentally tested interventions.

translation.title: 解释并中断语言模型系统中的集体失调
translation.abstract: 在智能体集合中，语言模型智能体可以交换各自无害的消息，而这些消息合在一起支持了一项策略违规。理解与预防集体失调需要回答：哪些消息充分影响并必要地促成了违规。集体依赖分析（CDA）将必要性与充分性可操作化，以解释决策并在已测组合中找出中断支持所需的最少移除。测试涵盖构造性违规、无脚本智能体对话和记录的交互，在受控案例中选定消息的移除使违规率从93%降至6%。CDA对N条消息只需O(N)次模型评估，在符合条件的操作案例中，相比拿到完整对话记录并被要求列出所有支持消息的前沿LLM裁判，CDA用一半的删除量即可达到相同的违规降低。CDA还提出了集体失调产生的机制。尽管如此，在不熟悉任务上实现完整解释仍然困难，且某些移除可能无意中破坏正确决策。CDA将集体失调的解释与经过实验检验的干预措施统一起来。
translation.brief: 针对多智能体LLM系统中集体失调（无害消息组合促成违规）的定位与中断问题，提出集体依赖分析（CDA），基于必要性与充分性找出并移除少量关键消息以解释和阻断违规。

papers.title: The Value of Not Knowing: How Fresh Eyes through Naive LLMs Fuel Creativity
papers.abstract: Many major scientific advances come from approaching a problem with a new or novel perspective. While large language models (LLMs) with internet-scale knowledge seem poised to take such perspectives, their consistent generation remains elusive. Instead, models are drawn to dominant views and preexisting, in-field bias. To explore the potential of fresh eyes to increase creativity, this paper proposes naive LLMs, models that are made intentionally ignorant of a specific topic. Through deprivation in training or intentional forgetting, naive models are unburdened by existing dogma, allowing them to be free to make new associations and conjectures. These naive models can then be paired with a stronger mentor model that can refine their unique perspectives into concrete proposals. For the 1B and 7B models tested in this paper, naive models consistently produce seed ideas that are more novel and useful than baseline counterparts, and mentor refinement improves the ideas even further. Thus, contrary to the prevailing tradition of scaling up training data, we demonstrate a case where less information is actually more powerful, in particular when the aim is to discover genuinely outside-the-box solutions.

translation.title: 无知的价值：朴素 LLM 带来的全新视角如何激发创造力
translation.abstract: 许多重大科学进展源自以全新或新颖的视角审视问题。虽然拥有互联网规模知识的大型语言模型（LLM）似乎有望提供这样的视角，但其一致性生成仍然难以实现。相反，这些模型往往被主流观点和领域内的既有偏见所吸引。为探索全新视角提升创造力的潜力，本文提出朴素 LLM（naive LLMs），即被刻意剥夺对特定主题认知的模型。通过训练数据缺失或有意遗忘，朴素模型不受既有教条的束缚，从而能够自由地进行新的联想和推测。这些朴素模型随后可与一个更强的导师模型配对，将它们独特的视角细化为具体的提案。对于本文测试的 1B 和 7B 模型，朴素模型始终能产生比基线对应模型更新颖、更有用的种子想法，而导师模型的进一步细化还能提升这些想法的质量。因此，与当前扩大训练数据规模的主流传统相反，我们展示了信息更少反而更强大的案例，尤其是在目标是发现真正跳出常规的解决方案时。
translation.brief: 该论文解决 LLM 受主流观点和领域偏见束缚、难以产生新颖想法的问题，核心方法是通过刻意剥夺或遗忘特定领域知识构建朴素模型，再由导师模型将其独特视角细化为具体提案。

papers.title: Silinx: An Open, Browser-Based HDL Design Platform for Teaching Digital Systems on FPGA Boards
papers.abstract: Many digital systems courses teach on FPGA boards whose vendor tool is no longer maintained: the Digilent Basys2 and Nexys2 (Xilinx Spartan-3E) and Nexys3 and Atlys (Spartan-6) need Xilinx ISE 14.7, discontinued since 2013 and hard to install on the computers and tablets students use today. The author presents Silinx, a free (AGPL-3.0) HDL design platform for teaching that keeps ISE's Project Navigator workflow but runs in a web browser with nothing to install. A module can be written in VHDL or Verilog, in C or C++ through Silinx HLS, which is compatible with AMD's Vitis HLS and passes all 73 of its introductory examples, or drawn as a schematic, an ASM chart, a state diagram, a Boolean function with its Karnaugh map, or a Petri net, from which its HDL is generated. Designs are checked with explanations written for beginners, simulated, run on an emulated board, built, and programmed onto a real board over WebUSB. The implementation flow is open and runs in the browser: Yosys and nextpnr compiled to WebAssembly, with Silinx's own device data, timing model and bitstream writer for the Spartan-3E and Spartan-6, built by black-box observation of ISE's documented tools; Lattice iCE40 boards use the existing open iCE40 tools, and further families are planned. ISE is the oracle: Silinx's bitstreams are byte-identical to those ISE writes for the same placed and routed design, and pass ISE's design rule check. Against ISE at the same optimization goal, the open flow uses 15% fewer slices with 14% shorter critical paths when optimizing for area, and 21% fewer slices with 8% shorter critical paths when optimizing for speed (geometric means over 45 open-source designs built by both flows). The author also describes how the platform was developed with AI coding agents under test-first project rules.

translation.title: Silinx：一个基于浏览器的开放式 HDL 设计平台，用于在 FPGA 开发板上教授数字系统课程
translation.abstract: 许多数字系统课程使用的 FPGA 开发板，其厂商工具已不再维护：Digilent Basys2 和 Nexys2（Xilinx Spartan-3E）以及 Nexys3 和 Atlys（Spartan-6）需要 Xilinx ISE 14.7，该软件自 2013 年起已停止支持，且难以安装在当今学生使用的电脑和平板上。作者提出了 Silinx，一个用于教学的免费（AGPL-3.0）HDL 设计平台，它保留了 ISE Project Navigator 的工作流程，但完全在浏览器中运行，无需安装任何东西。模块可以用 VHDL 或 Verilog 编写，也可以通过 Silinx HLS 用 C 或 C++ 编写（与 AMD 的 Vitis HLS 兼容，并通过其全部 73 个入门示例），还可以绘制为原理图、ASM 图、状态图、带有卡诺图的布尔函数或 Petri 网，平台会从中生成 HDL。设计可以在面向初学者撰写的解释性检查下进行校验、仿真、在模拟开发板上运行、构建，并通过 WebUSB 下载到真实开发板。实现流程是开放的并在浏览器中运行：Yosys 和 nextpnr 被编译为 WebAssembly，配合 Silinx 自行针对 Spartan-3E 和 Spartan-6 构建的器件数据、时序模型和位流生成器，这些是通过对 ISE 已有文档工具的黑盒观察建立的；Lattice iCE40 开发板则使用现有的开放 iCE40 工具，更多器件系列已在计划中。ISE 作为基准（oracle）：Silinx 对同一布局布线设计生成的位流与 ISE 写出的位流逐字节相同，并通过 ISE 的设计规则检查。在相同优化目标下与 ISE 对比，开源流程在面积优化时使用少 15% 的 slice 且关键路径短 14%，在速度优化时使用少 21% 的 slice 且关键路径短 8%（基于两个流程共同构建的 45 个开源设计的几何平均）。作者还描述了如何在测试优先的项目规则下，利用 AI 编码代理开发该平台。
translation.brief: 该论文解决老旧 FPGA 教学板所需工具 Xilinx ISE 已停止维护且难以安装的问题，核心方法是构建一个完全在浏览器中运行的开放式 HDL 设计平台，采用编译为 WebAssembly 的 Yosys/nextpnr 及自研器件支持，输出与 ISE 位流一致的设计结果。

papers.title: BridgeKV: Large-Model Prefill and Small-Model Decoding for LLM Inference via KV Cache Translation
papers.abstract: LLM inference has two phases with different bottlenecks: LLM prefill runs once per request and is compute-intensive. Decoding repeats for every output token and is limited by memory bandwidth. To address the challenges associated with this issue, different solutions have been proposed. All of these solutions use the same model for both prefill and decode phases. We propose BridgeKV, which uses a larger model for prefill and a smaller model of the same family for decoding. A lightweight KV-stitching module translates the larger model's prompt cache into the smaller model's cache layout. It handles differences in cache shape and representation through learned local layer mixing and separate nonlinear maps for keys and values. With both models frozen, we train the module to align their caches and make the smaller model follow the larger model's next-token predictions. A second training stage adds low-rank adapters when further task adaptation is needed. Across six model pairs and five datasets, BridgeKV outperforms fine-tuned small-model baselines with matched trainable parameter budgets in all 30 settings. It closes up to 80% of the quality gap to using the larger model for both phases. On one A40 GPU, Llama-3.1-Instruct-8B to Llama-3.2-Instruct-1B achieves 3.0X faster requests than the larger model alone, with latency close to the smaller model alone. BridgeKV can improve the hardware and system solutions that separate prefill and decode phases across GPUs. A separate serving simulation models request arrivals, queues, and cache transfer. For Llama-3.1-Instruct-70B to Llama-3.2-Instruct-1B, it predicts up to 33.86X faster requests and 27.5X lower energy use than using the larger model for both prefill and decode phases.

translation.title: BridgeKV：通过 KV Cache 翻译实现大模型 Prefill 与小模型 Decoding 的 LLM 推理
translation.abstract: LLM 推理包含两个瓶颈不同的阶段：prefill 对每个请求仅运行一次，是计算密集型的；decoding 则针对每个输出 token 重复执行，受内存带宽限制。为解决这一问题带来的挑战，已有多种方案被提出，但它们都在 prefill 和 decode 阶段使用同一模型。我们提出 BridgeKV，它在 prefill 阶段使用较大的模型，而在解码阶段使用同系列的较小模型。一个轻量级的 KV 拼接（KV-stitching）模块将较大模型的 prompt 缓存转换为较小模型的缓存布局。该模块通过学习到的局部层混合以及针对 key 和 value 的独立非线性映射，来处理缓存形状与表示的差异。在两个模型均冻结的情况下，我们训练该模块以对齐它们的缓存，并使较小模型跟随较大模型的下一 token 预测。当需要进一步的任务适配时，第二个训练阶段会加入低秩适配器。在六个模型对和五个数据集上，BridgeKV 在全部 30 种设置中都优于使用同等可训练参数预算的微调小模型基线，最多弥合了与两阶段均使用较大模型之间 80% 的质量差距。在单张 A40 GPU 上，从 Llama-3.1-Instruct-8B 到 Llama-3.2-Instruct-1B 的配置相比单独使用较大模型实现了 3.0 倍的请求提速，且延迟接近单独使用较小模型。BridgeKV 可以增强在多个 GPU 间分离 prefill 和 decode 阶段的硬件与系统方案。一个独立的服务仿真对请求到达、队列和缓存传输进行建模：对于 Llama-3.1-Instruct-70B 到 Llama-3.2-Instruct-1B 的配置，仿真预测相比两阶段均使用较大模型可获得最高 33.86 倍的请求提速和 27.5 倍的能耗降低。
translation.brief: 该论文解决 LLM 推理中 prefill 计算密集与 decoding 受内存带宽限制的瓶颈问题，核心方法是大模型做 prefill、小模型做 decoding，并通过训练一个轻量级 KV 拼接模块将大模型的 KV 缓存翻译到小模型的缓存布局。

papers.title: ChemInsight: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Evaluating and Diagnosing Chemistry Understanding and Reasoning in Large Language Models
papers.abstract: We introduce ChemInsight, a benchmark designed to evaluate large language models (LLMs) on chemistry tasks that require multi-step reasoning and structured chemical understanding. We propose a two-dimensional scoring system (scope and depth) to assess both task coverage and reasoning completeness. ChemInsight consists of 203 challenging chemistry questions organized into 50 bundles, which support the two-dimensional scoring evaluation scheme. We evaluate ten representative LLMs using ChemInsight and observe consistently low performance across models, with scope scores below 30% and depth scores below 11%, substantially lower than human expert performance. We then proceed to ask (1) What factor limits the advancement of current LLMs in chemistry? (2) To what extent are statistically driven language-model training methods effective at modeling chemistry symbolic language such as SMILES? And (3) Can LLM performance in chemistry be improved through intensive training on large, domain-specific corpora?

translation.title: ChemInsight：用于评估和诊断大型语言模型化学理解与推理能力的综合基准
translation.abstract: 我们提出 ChemInsight，一个旨在评估大型语言模型（LLM）在需要多步推理和结构化化学理解任务上表现的基准。我们提出一个二维评分体系（广度与深度），以同时评估任务覆盖度和推理完整性。ChemInsight 由 203 道具有挑战性的化学问题组成，分为 50 个问题组，支持该二维评分评估方案。我们用 ChemInsight 评估了十个代表性 LLM，观察到所有模型的表现一致偏低：广度得分低于 30%，深度得分低于 11%，远低于人类专家水平。我们随后提出以下问题：(1) 什么因素限制了当前 LLM 在化学领域的发展？(2) 基于统计的语言模型训练方法在多大程度上能有效建模 SMILES 等化学符号语言？(3) 通过在大规模领域专用语料上密集训练，能否提升 LLM 在化学上的表现？
translation.brief: 该论文解决如何系统评估和诊断 LLM 化学理解与多步推理能力的问题，核心方法是构建包含 203 道难题、按广度和深度二维评分的基准 ChemInsight。

papers.title: HiddenPathQA: A Benchmark for Knowledge Graph Question Answering When Questions Hide Their Paths
papers.abstract: Knowledge graph question answering (KGQA) systems are typically evaluated on questions whose surface tokens lexically expose the gold KG path. Users, however, may ask questions without knowing the underlying schema: "Which condition could Andrew have due to family history?" compresses a 4-hop chain "Andrew --[father]--> parent --[father]--> grandparent --[medical condition]--> disease --[subclass of]--> hereditary disorder" into a single phrase (family history) that names none of those relations. We identify this collapse of path-question alignment as a blind spot in existing KGQA evaluation. Three major LLM-KG paradigms, hop-by-hop exploration, plan-then-retrieve, and similarity-based retrieval, implicitly rely on such lexical cues, an assumption rarely tested in practice. We make three contributions. (i) We introduce HiddenPathQA, a manually verified benchmark of 1,055 questions spanning 2-6 hops and multiple domains, constructed so that question wording does not reveal the gold path's relations. (ii) We propose Holistic Path Selection, which compares questions against candidate relation chains in the local subgraph as complete units, replacing irreversible per-hop relation scoring with globally informed chain-level reasoning. We develop two implementations, TieredHolistic and FlatHolistic. (iii) We conduct a pseudoword stress test that replaces entity names with meaningless placeholders to distinguish KG-grounded reasoning from entity-level memorization. Holistic Path Selection outperforms six strong KGQA baselines (ToG, PoG, FiDeLiS, R2-KG, KAPING, and KARPA) by 8.8-17.9 accuracy points across two LLM backbones and both original and pseudoword settings. Its advantage under pseudoword replacement shows that the gains cannot be explained by entity-level memorization alone.

translation.title: HiddenPathQA：针对问题隐藏其推理路径的知识图谱问答基准
translation.abstract: 知识图谱问答（KGQA）系统通常在这些问题上评测：其表面词汇会在字面上暴露标准 KG 路径。然而，用户提问时可能并不了解底层 schema："Andrew 由于家族史可能患有什么疾病？"将一条 4 跳链"Andrew --[father]--> 父亲 --[father]--> 祖父母 --[medical condition]--> 疾病 --[subclass of]--> 遗传性疾病"压缩成一个短语（家族史），其中没有提及任何这些关系。我们将这种问题-路径对齐的坍缩视为现有 KGQA 评估中的一个盲点。三种主流 LLM-KG 范式——逐跳探索、先规划后检索以及基于相似度的检索——都隐式依赖这类词汇线索，而这一假设在实践中很少被检验。我们做出三项贡献：(i) 我们提出 HiddenPathQA，一个经人工核验的基准，包含 1,055 个跨越 2-6 跳和多个领域的问题，其构建确保问题措辞不会暴露标准路径上的关系。(ii) 我们提出整体路径选择（Holistic Path Selection），将问题与局部子图中的候选关系链作为完整单元进行比较，用具有全局信息的链级推理取代不可逆的逐跳关系打分。我们开发了两种实现：TieredHolistic 和 FlatHolistic。(iii) 我们进行了伪词压力测试，将实体名替换为无意义占位符，以区分基于 KG 的推理与实体级记忆。整体路径选择在两个 LLM 骨干以及原始和伪词两种设置下，超越六个强 KGQA 基线（ToG、PoG、FiDeLiS、R2-KG、KAPING 和 KARPA）8.8-17.9 个准确率点。其在伪词替换下的优势表明，这些提升无法仅用实体级记忆来解释。
translation.brief: 该论文解决现有 KGQA 评测中问题措辞暴露标准推理路径导致的评估盲点问题，核心方法是构建路径不显露于问题措辞的 HiddenPathQA 基准，并提出以链为单位进行全局推理的整体路径选择方法。

papers.title: Exploiting Native Hardware Heterogeneity: Custom GPSIMD Operators for Accelerating Emerging LLM Memory on AWS Trainium
papers.abstract: Emerging memory modules of large language models, such as Engram in DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, mix irregular integer work (a 64-bit n-gram hash and a sparse table lookup) with dense computation (a GEMM and a gate). When deploying on a GPU-FPGA system, we can disaggregate operations to different devices for Engram to speed up by 5.9$\times$. AWS Trainium provides a similar heterogeneity natively: each Trainium NeuronCore pairs dense engines with a customizable GPSIMD Engine, and all engines share the on-chip SBUF. However, the Neuron Kernel Interface (NKI) exposes the GPSIMD cores only through fixed built-in instructions, and the official GPSIMD custom-operator toolchain does not support Trainium 2 or 3 and cannot be used with NKI. In this work, we build a toolchain that compiles C++ custom operators for the GPSIMD cores and injects them into the compiled NEFF from the NKI kernel on Trainium 3, expanding the customizability of GPSIMD with the current software stack. Over a hand-optimized NKI baseline of DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, two GPSIMD operators speed up the n-gram hashing by 1.79$\times$ at decode, the table retrieval by up to 4.95$\times$, and the whole Engram computation by up to 1.14$\times$.

translation.title: 挖掘原生硬件异构性：面向AWS Trainium上新兴LLM记忆模块加速的自定义GPSIMD算子
translation.abstract: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash中的Engram等新兴LLM记忆模块将不规则整数计算（64位n-gram哈希与稀疏表查找）与稠密计算（GEMM与门控）混合在一起。在GPU-FPGA系统上部署时，可将操作分解到不同设备上，使Engram加速5.9倍。AWS Trainium提供了类似的内生异构性：每个Trainium NeuronCore将稠密引擎与可定制的GPSIMD引擎配对，且所有引擎共享片上SBUF。然而，Neuron Kernel Interface（NKI）仅通过固定的内建指令暴露GPSIMD核心，官方GPSIMD自定义算子工具链不支持Trainium 2或3，也无法与NKI配合使用。本工作构建了一套工具链，可将C++自定义算子编译到GPSIMD核心，并注入到Trainium 3上由NKI内核编译生成的NEFF中，从而在当前软件栈下扩展GPSIMD的可定制性。相对于手工优化的NKI基线，两个GPSIMD算子在解码阶段将n-gram哈希加速1.79倍，表查找加速最高4.95倍，整个Engram计算加速最高1.14倍。
translation.brief: 针对在AWS Trainium上加速Engram类LLM记忆模块的问题，构建了可将C++自定义算子编译注入GPSIMD核心与NKI编译产物的工具链。

papers.title: KKT-Perturbation-Aware Communication for Fully Distributed Online Convex Optimization with Nonseparable Coupling
papers.abstract: Nonseparable costs and coupled constraints in distributed online convex optimization often arise when system performance and operational constraints depend on the joint configuration of all agents and cannot be decomposed into individual contributions. Such nonseparability leads to fully distributed decision-making with challenging partial local information, where each agent evaluates its local primal-dual update using estimated global information via a local belief of the joint action and the shared Lagrange multiplier to be exchanged with neighbors. While the belief consensus established by prior works ensures no-regret learning, exchanging beliefs comprising full-dimensional primal and dual states at every round imposes a communication overhead that scales with both the joint decision dimension and the network size. Existing event-triggered schemes typically activate communication according to state variation or consensus error. Under nonseparable coupling, however, errors of equal magnitude can produce markedly different perturbations after passing through the KKT operator. We therefore propose a randomized KKT-perturbation-aware communication mechanism, where the triggering of each agent's primal and dual communication channels depends on their impact on the KKT operator. The proposed mechanism transfers the adaptive-sampling principle of coordinate descent from allocating computation across decision blocks to allocating communication across information channels: channels with larger estimated perturbations receive greater priority for refresh. Under standard regularity assumptions, the resulting algorithm achieves $O({T}^{2/3})$ expected static regret and $O({T}^{2/3})$ expected cumulative constraint violation. Numerical experiments demonstrate improved learning and constraint-enforcement performance per transmitted bit over belief consensus baselines.

translation.title: 具有不可分耦合的全分布式在线凸优化的KKT扰动感知通信
translation.abstract: 分布式在线凸优化中的不可分代价与耦合约束常出现于系统性能和运行约束依赖于所有智能体的联合配置、无法分解为个体贡献的场景。这种不可分性导致在部分局部信息下进行全分布式决策，每个智能体基于联合动作的局部信念和与邻居交换的共享Lagrange乘子，使用估计的全局信息执行本地原始-对偶更新。先前工作建立的信念共识虽保证无悔学习，但每轮交换包含全维原始与对偶状态的信念会带来随联合决策维度和网络规模增长的开销。现有事件触发方案通常依据状态变化或共识误差触发通信；在不可分耦合下，同等大小的误差经过KKT算子后会产生差异显著的扰动。为此，我们提出随机化的KKT扰动感知通信机制，每个智能体的原始与对偶通信信道的触发取决于其对KKT算子的影响。该机制将坐标下降的自适应采样原则从在决策块间分配计算转移到在信息信道间分配通信：估计扰动更大的信道获得更高的刷新优先级。在标准正则性假设下，所得算法实现O(T^{2/3})的期望静态遗憾与O(T^{2/3})的期望累积约束违反。数值实验表明，每传输比特的学习与约束执行性能优于信念共识基线。
translation.brief: 针对带不可分耦合的分布式在线凸优化通信开销问题，提出依据信道对KKT算子扰动的随机化事件触发通信机制。

papers.title: Correct Answers from Insufficient Histories: A Controlled Study of Agent Memory Evaluation
papers.abstract: An answer can match the reference for a complete agent history even when the reader's visible history does not determine it. We study this distinction using executable device logs. Our protocol separates reference agreement, certified evidence sufficiency, and context-appropriate behavior. Insufficiency requires two legal histories yielding byte-identical visible contexts but different answers; public chronology and query cutoffs certify sufficient prefixes. On 80 confirmation histories, Qwen3-32B matches 87 hidden references among 203 insufficient raw-prefix instances, with only seven appropriate abstentions. A fixed-input DeepSeek-V4-Flash replication matches 85 and abstains on 21 of the same 203 instances. Each reader makes 1,600 requests. Compact CSV's estimated appropriateness effects remain inconclusive: +3.16 percentage points, clustered 95% interval [0.00,6.57], for Qwen and +2.46, [-1.84,6.94], for DeepSeek. A separate held-out judge study achieves 99.38% correctness but retains support errors and truncations; a deterministic baseline solves all constructed cases. These results support an evaluation diagnosis across two hosted reader configurations, not gains for a general memory system or natural-language evidence assessment.

translation.title: 不充分历史下的正确答案：智能体记忆评估的受控研究
translation.abstract: 即使读者的可见历史不能决定答案，答案仍可能匹配完整智能体历史对应的参考答案。我们使用可执行设备日志研究这一区别。我们的协议区分参考一致性、经认证的证据充分性以及符合上下文的恰当行为。不充分性要求存在两条合法历史，其可见上下文字节完全相同却产生不同答案；公共时间线与查询截止用于认证充分前缀。在80条确认历史上，Qwen3-32B在203个不充分原始前缀实例中匹配了87个隐藏参考答案，仅出现7次恰当的拒答。固定输入的DeepSeek-V4-Flash复现实验匹配85个，并在同一203个实例中拒答21次。每位读者发起1,600次请求。紧凑CSV的估计恰当性效应仍不确定：Qwen为+3.16个百分点，聚类95%区间[0.00,6.57]；DeepSeek为+2.46，[-1.84,6.94]。单独的保留集裁判研究达到99.38%的正确率，但仍存在支持错误与截断；确定性基线可解决所有构造案例。这些结果支持在两种托管读者配置下进行评估诊断，而非证明通用记忆系统或自然语言证据评估的改进。
translation.brief: 针对智能体记忆评估中答案正确但证据不充分的问题，构建基于可执行日志的受控协议以区分参考一致性、证据充分性与恰当行为。

papers.title: AI and Mathematical Work on Mastodon: Attention, Topics, and Target-Specific Evaluations
papers.abstract: How does a mathematical community discuss AI on a federated social platform? We study 24,920 public posts from January--September 2026 by 272 accounts in a fixed roster of 1,002 Mastodon accounts whose profiles indicate mathematical research or study. LLM-assisted extraction identifies 1,191 AI-for-mathematics posts by 101 accounts. Their share of all posts rises from 1.1\% in January to 11.5\% in September, with contributing accounts increasing from 10 to 59. We represent discussion through linked target--aspect--stance triples, separating what is discussed from the property assessed and the author's evaluation. From July to September, capability and usefulness decline as a share of related discussion, while social and institutional concerns increase; changing contributors account for much of the latter shift. Among 38 accounts evaluating both technical quality or utility and communication, credit, or verification procedures, the procedural negative-component fraction is 19.4 percentage points higher on average (95\% account-bootstrap interval: 3.8--35.1). Matching targets within posts gives a similar direction. Repeated extraction varies substantially at the level of individual triples, although replacing the repeated sample preserves the aggregate contrast. Around OpenAI's October 6 mathematics release, related-post share rises from 9.6\% to 13.6\%, and contributing accounts increase from 13 to 28. Post-release discussion includes appreciation of the results' potential mathematical value and applications alongside criticism of promotion centered on result counts, limited methodological disclosure, and verification arrangements.

translation.title: Mastodon上的AI与数学工作：注意力、话题与针对目标的评估
translation.abstract: 数学社区如何在联邦社交平台上讨论AI？我们研究了2026年1月至9月间，一个固定的1,002个Mastodon账号名单中、个人资料显示从事数学研究或学习的272个账号发布的24,920条公开帖子。LLM辅助提取识别出101个账号的1,191条数学中应用AI的帖子。其占全部帖子的比例从1月的1.1%升至9月的11.5%，贡献账号从10个增至59个。我们用链接的目标—属性—立场三元组表示讨论，区分讨论对象、被评估的性质与作者的评估。从7月到9月，能力与有用性在相关讨论中的占比下降，而社会与制度性关切上升；后者变化很大程度源于贡献者的更替。在同时评估技术质量或实用性以及沟通、署名或验证流程的38个账号中，流程性负面成分平均高出19.4个百分点（95%账号自助法区间：3.8—35.1）。帖子内目标匹配给出类似方向。单个三元组层面的重复提取变化很大，但替换重复样本仍保持总体对比。围绕OpenAI 10月6日的数学发布，相关帖子占比从9.6%升至13.6%，贡献账号从13个增至28个。发布后的讨论既包含对结果潜在数学价值与应用的赞赏，也包含对以结果数量为中心的宣传、有限的方法披露和验证安排的批评。
translation.brief: 针对数学社区如何在Mastodon上讨论AI的问题，采用LLM辅助提取与目标—属性—立场三元组分析大规模帖子的注意力、话题与立场演变。

papers.title: MOTIF: LLM-Defined Material Taxonomies for OOD Property Prediction via Invariant Feature Selection
papers.abstract: Out-of-distribution (OOD) generalization remains a central challenge in materials property prediction, where models must extrapolate to novel chemistries beyond the training distribution. While large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong scientific reasoning, their direct use for quantitative prediction remains limited. To address this, we systematically evaluate multiple roles for LLM assistance, finding that only taxonomy-based grouping consistently improves OOD generalization over a strong kNN+GBT baseline. Building on this, we here propose MOTIF, a framework that leverages LLMs not as predictors, but as generators of candidate taxonomies that partition materials into chemically meaningful environments. These taxonomies are evaluated via training-only pseudo-OOD validation, and only those that improve generalization are retained. Invariant feature selection is then applied within each accepted taxonomy, followed by gated aggregation across taxonomies. We evaluate on 2D halide perovskites, where bandgap prediction must generalize across distinct organic spacer families. On this benchmark, MOTIF reduces mean OOD MAE from 0.122 to 0.111 eV. Under a frozen dev/test protocol, the deployable configuration further improves errors from 0.123 to 0.117 eV (electronic bandgap) and from 0.181 to 0.173 eV (optical bandgap). Beyond this primary task, we validate transferability across additional materials datasets, including 3D perovskite solar cell efficiencies and Matbench benchmarks with structure-based splits. Across domains, MOTIF consistently improves robustness under distribution shift, outperforming expert-defined groupings, rule-based heuristics, and clustering baselines, while remaining competitive with strong classical selection methods. These results demonstrate that LLMs are most effective not as predictors, but as tools for discovering structure in data.

translation.title: MOTIF：通过不变特征选择实现OOD性质预测的LLM定义材料分类法
translation.abstract: 分布外（OOD）泛化是材料性质预测的核心挑战，模型必须外推到训练分布之外的新化学体系。尽管大语言模型（LLM）展现出强大的科学推理能力，但其直接用于定量预测仍然有限。为此，我们系统评估了LLM辅助的多种角色，发现只有基于分类法的分组能在强kNN+GBT基线之上持续提升OOD泛化。在此基础上，我们提出MOTIF框架：LLM不是作为预测器，而是作为候选分类法的生成器，将材料划分为化学上意义明确的环境。这些分类法通过仅用训练数据的伪OOD验证进行评估，只保留能提升泛化的分类法，然后在每个被接受的分类法内进行不变特征选择，并跨分类法进行门控聚合。我们在二维卤化物钙钛矿上评估，其中带隙预测需在不同有机间隔基家族间泛化。在该基准上，MOTIF将平均OOD MAE从0.122降至0.111 eV。在冻结的开发/测试协议下，可部署配置进一步将误差从0.123降至0.117 eV（电子带隙）、从0.181降至0.173 eV（光学带隙）。除该主要任务外，我们还在更多材料数据集上验证可迁移性，包括三维钙钛矿太阳能电池效率以及基于结构划分的Matbench基准。跨领域结果表明，MOTIF在分布偏移下持续提升鲁棒性，优于专家定义的分组、规则启发式与聚类基线，同时与强经典选择方法保持竞争力。这些结果证明，LLM最有效的角色不是作为预测器，而是作为发现数据中结构的工具。
translation.brief: 针对材料性质OOD泛化问题，让LLM生成候选材料分类法并结合不变特征选择与门控聚合来提升预测鲁棒性。

papers.title: Scaling Adaptive Prompt Injection Attacks with Agent Swarms
papers.abstract: Prompt injections have emerged as one of the top security risks faced by AI agents today. Early work in prompt injection attacks looked at simple tool-call agents and static attack payloads, and were saturated since mid-2025. As of Fall 2026, human red-teaming may be nearing saturation, especially on the Gemini family of models. In this work, we argue that despite this apparent plateau, prompt injection attacks are still possible and continued effort into prompt injection defense is needed. We design a new synthetic evaluation dataset which uses random non-malicious actions as adversarial goals. Such dataset design helps us to evaluate prompt injection robustness as a model ability to respect instruction hierarchy, and disentangle this ability from model knowledge of security practices. We show that an agentic attacker of increased capabilities can reliably trick model to follow instructions in tool output in our evaluation, even for models previously considered robust on public prompt injection benchmarks such as GraySwan Arena. This shows that current frontier defenses may require proactive, automated red-teaming to remain resilient to increasingly capable adversaries.

translation.title: 利用智能体集群扩展自适应提示注入攻击
translation.abstract: 提示注入已成为当今AI智能体面临的首要安全风险之一。早期的提示注入攻击研究针对简单的工具调用智能体和静态攻击载荷，且自2025年中期以来已趋于饱和。截至2026年秋季，人工红队测试可能也接近饱和，尤其是在Gemini系列模型上。在本工作中，我们论证尽管存在这一明显平台期，提示注入攻击仍然可行，且对提示注入防御的持续投入仍属必要。我们设计了一个新的合成评估数据集，使用随机非恶意动作作为对抗目标。这种数据集设计帮助我们将提示注入鲁棒性评估为模型遵循指令层级的能力，并将该能力与模型的安全实践知识解耦。我们展示了能力更强的智能体化攻击者在我们的评估中可以可靠地诱使模型遵循工具输出中的指令，即使对于此前在GraySwan Arena等公开提示注入基准上被认为鲁棒的模型也是如此。这表明当前的前沿防御可能需要主动的、自动化的红队测试，以在面对日益强大的对手时保持韧性。
translation.brief: 研究如何在提示注入攻击看似饱和的情况下继续攻击与防御，方法是将提示注入鲁棒性建模为遵循指令层级的能力并设计合成评估数据集，再用能力更强的智能体化攻击者验证攻击仍可奏效。

papers.title: Can Hindsight Critics Guide Delayed Actors?
papers.abstract: Sensory delays create temporal misalignments between the state of the environment and the observations available to an agent, turning Markovian control problems into partially observable ones. In this work, we inquire whether such misalignments can be mitigated during training by using hindsight to recover aligned state-action transitions. We introduce Hindsight Critics, an asymmetric extension of the Soft Actor-Critic for reinforcement learning under partial observability. The critics are trained on hindsight-aligned transitions whereas the actor learns from the resulting privileged value estimates despite only having access to delayed observations. Comparisons against delay-aware and unaware baselines on the DelayBench suite show that Hindsight Critics can partially compensate for observation delays without requiring modifications to the agent's observations during deployment.

translation.title: 事后 critic 能否引导延迟的 actor？
translation.abstract: 感官延迟会造成环境状态与智能体可用观测之间的时间错位，将马尔可夫控制问题转化为部分可观测问题。本工作探究这种错位能否在训练期间通过事后（hindsight）技术恢复对齐的状态-动作转移来缓解。我们提出 Hindsight Critics，这是 Soft Actor-Critic 在部分可观测强化学习下的一种非对称扩展。critic 在事后对齐的转移上训练，而 actor 尽管只能访问延迟观测，却可以从由此产生的特权价值估计中学习。在 DelayBench 套件上与延迟感知和延迟无感知基线的比较表明，Hindsight Critics 可以部分补偿观测延迟，且无需在部署时修改智能体的观测。
translation.brief: 研究如何在强化学习训练中缓解观测延迟造成的时间错位问题，核心方法是提出 Hindsight Critics——critic 在事后对齐的转移上训练并为仅见延迟观测的 actor 提供特权价值估计。

papers.title: DeFSM: Robust and Efficient Decentralization of Federated Submodular Maximization
papers.abstract: Submodular maximization seeks a small subset best representing a large dataset. In its federated setting, the server is a single point of failure and some clients may be Byzantine. Removing the server raises a trilemma of decentraliza- tion, efficiency, and security. We propose DeFSM, a Byzantine-robust and communication-efficient architecture that replaces the server with a lightweight smart contract and a pool of independent, consensus-free agents. Its aggregation rule, SafeGM, builds on two notions from combinatorial geometry: Tukey depth and safe points (the points lying in the convex hull of the good points wherever the bad points are). SafeGM makes the robust decision on 2D Gaussian random projections, which the contract can compute efficiently, and lifts it back as a convex combination of actual updates. Since lifting loses information, it uses the projected geometric median only when its depth certifies it, and otherwise a Tukey median. The share of bad updates is then bounded only by a count: how many there are, not what they contain. We prove, and confirm empirically, that this bound controls the solution quality. On CIFAR10 and PathMNIST, with up to 30% Byzantine clients and agents, DeFSM never collapses and retains on average about 91% of the quality of the ideal reference, the geometric median at a trusted central server. The geometric median decentralized in its best setting would retain about 96%, but the contract cannot compute it, and so each agent would have to download six times more data, or each client twice as much.

translation.title: DeFSM：鲁棒且高效的联邦次模最大化的去中心化
translation.abstract: 次模最大化旨在寻找最能代表大规模数据集的小规模子集。在联邦场景下，服务器是单点故障，且部分客户端可能是拜占庭的。移除服务器会带来去中心化、效率与安全的三难困境。我们提出 DeFSM，一种拜占庭鲁棒且通信高效的架构，用轻量级智能合约和无共识的独立智能体池替代服务器。其聚合规则 SafeGM 建立在组合几何的两个概念之上：Tukey 深度和安全点（即无论坏点在哪，都位于好点凸包内的点）。SafeGM 在二维高斯随机投影上做出鲁棒决策——合约可以高效计算——再将其提升为实际更新的凸组合。由于提升会损失信息，仅当投影几何中位数被其深度证明可靠时才使用它，否则使用 Tukey 中位数。这样坏更新占比的上界仅取决于数量而非内容。我们证明并实证确认该上界控制着解的质量。在 CIFAR10 和 PathMNIST 上，面对高达30%的拜占庭客户端与智能体，DeFSM 从未崩溃，平均保留理想参照（可信中央服务器上的几何中位数）约91%的质量。几何中位数在其最佳去中心化设置下可保留约96%，但合约无法计算它，因此每个智能体需下载六倍的数据，或每个客户端两倍的数据。
translation.brief: 研究无服务器去中心化联邦次模最大化中安全、效率与鲁棒性的三难问题，核心方法是用智能合约加无共识智能体池，基于Tukey深度与安全点的几何聚合规则SafeGM实现拜占庭鲁棒聚合。

papers.title: Multi-Modal Agricultural Document Understanding at the DAGRI Task
papers.abstract: Agricultural documents, such as prefectural technical reports and crop calendars, are critical knowledge resources. However, their complex table layouts, significant variations in document length, and dense multi-modal elements pose substantial challenges for automated understanding. To address these issues, the NTCIR-19 DAGRI (Data Analytics for aGRicultural Information) task introduced three subtasks focusing on different dimensions of document intelligence. In the Table Information Extraction (TableIE) task, we developed a multi-stage pipeline combining structure-preserving parsing via MinerU, region-adaptive segmentation for long documents, and a dual-modal (vision-text) extraction strategy for complex work schedules. This approach achieved first place with an exact match score of 0.6566. For Multi-Table Multi-Hop Question Answering (MTMH-QA) over interrelated JSON tables, we adopted an agentic search framework utilizing DCI-Agent to iteratively explore directories via bash commands, reinforced by a cross-model validation mechanism. This yielded a revised accuracy of 0.8444, initially ranked first. In the Figure and Table Question Answering (FiT-QA) task, which requires comprehending single large composite images, we implemented a dual-modal VLM pipeline enhanced by deterministic answer normalization, securing the highest BLEU score. Together, our system effectively addresses regional structural variations, dynamic cross-file evidence discovery, and multi-modal alignment, providing a robust framework for complex agricultural document understanding.

translation.title: DAGRI 任务中的多模态农业文档理解
translation.abstract: 农业文档，如都道府县技术报告和作物日历，是重要的知识资源。然而其复杂的表格布局、显著的文档长度差异以及密集的多模态元素给自动化理解带来巨大挑战。为解决这些问题，NTCIR-19 DAGRI（Data Analytics for aGRicultural Information）任务引入了聚焦文档智能不同维度的三个子任务。在表格信息抽取（TableIE）任务中，我们开发了一个多阶段流水线，结合基于 MinerU 的结构保持解析、面向长文档的区域自适应分割，以及面向复杂作业日程的双模态（视觉-文本）抽取策略。该方法以0.6566的精确匹配得分获得第一名。对于跨关联 JSON 表格的多表多跳问答（MTMH-QA），我们采用基于 DCI-Agent 的智能体搜索框架，通过 bash 命令迭代探索目录，并辅以跨模型验证机制，取得0.8444的修订准确率，初评排名第一。在要求理解单张大尺寸复合图像的图表问答（FiT-QA）任务中，我们实现了由确定性答案归一化增强的双模态 VLM 流水线，获得最高 BLEU 得分。我们的系统有效应对了区域结构差异、动态跨文件证据发现和多模态对齐，为复杂农业文档理解提供了鲁棒框架。
translation.brief: 研究农业文档中表格布局复杂、长度差异大、多模态元素密集导致的自动理解难题，核心方法是针对三个子任务分别构建多阶段解析、DCI-Agent迭代搜索和双模态VLM流水线。

papers.title: LEGION: Benchmarking Language Agents on Sparse-Signal Investigation Under Adversarial Noise
papers.abstract: Autonomous language-model agents are increasingly deployed on discovery-driven tasks where signal is sparse and most retrieved information is irrelevant. Current benchmarks fail to evaluate this regime due to dense signals, cooperative environments, and ground truth typically being only a few tool calls away. We introduce Legion, a benchmark framework coupling a stochastic enterprise-telemetry simulator (Legion-Sim) with a tiered library of 74 expertly-crafted adversarial scenarios (Legion-Bench) and an evaluation protocol that scores investigation efficiency alongside detection accuracy. Scenarios are injected into freshly simulated companies, allowing independent control over confounder density and event volume. We test five agent architectures on two simulated companies and find that while recall is high (0.82-0.88) precision lags behind (0.61--0.72). They fail to find all of the indicators of compromise of the attack or mistake genuine indicators with attack related ones, which is critical in the context of cybersecurity investigation. Failures are consistent across reasoning tiers and persist across confounder density and event volume. We release Legion, the scenario library, performance on common agent architectures, and pipeline for reproducibility and extension.

translation.title: LEGION：在对抗噪声下对语言智能体稀疏信号调查能力的基准测试
translation.abstract: 自主语言模型智能体日益被部署于发现驱动型任务中，其中信号稀疏且大部分检索到的信息无关。现有基准因信号密集、环境合作性强、真值通常仅距几次工具调用之遥，而无法评估这一情境。我们提出 Legion，一个基准框架，它将随机企业遥测模拟器（Legion-Sim）与包含74个专家精心构建的对抗场景的分级库（Legion-Bench）以及同时评估调查效率与检测准确率的评估协议相耦合。场景被注入新模拟的公司中，可独立控制混淆因素密度与事件数量。我们在两家模拟公司上测试了五种智能体架构，发现虽然召回率较高（0.82-0.88），精确率却落后（0.61-0.72）。它们无法找到攻击的全部入侵指标，或把真实指标与攻击相关指标混淆——这在网络安全调查中至关重要。失败在各推理层级上一致，并在混淆因素密度与事件数量变化下持续存在。我们发布 Legion、场景库、常见智能体架构的性能表现以及用于复现和扩展的流水线。
translation.brief: 研究现有基准无法评估语言智能体在稀疏信号、对抗噪声环境下的调查能力问题，核心方法是构建企业遥测模拟器与74个对抗场景库耦合、同时评估调查效率与检测准确率的基准框架Legion。

papers.title: Spectral Unlearning: Transformer Structure-Preserving Updates for Language Models
papers.abstract: Machine unlearning in large language models (LLMs) aims to remove specific learned knowledge, capabilities, or behaviors while preserving model utility. Existing methods have mostly focused on the design of unlearning objectives, while largely overlooking the intrinsic matrix structure of transformer weights. In particular, standard optimizers operate on independent scalar coordinates, thereby ignoring this matrix structure. We propose spectral unlearning, an update framework that combines standard unlearning objectives with matrix-structured optimization. We show that the spectral update corresponds to the steepest-descent direction for transformers composed of linear layers with normalized inputs and outputs. Our approach is applied on top of existing unlearning methods and evaluated across complementary axes of memorization, privacy, and utility, summarized via their harmonic mean. Spectral unlearning consistently outperforms a broad range of baselines and closes most of the gap to a retain-trained reference. Code is available at https://github.com/unlearn-ml/spectral-unlearning/.

papers.title: Late but Valuable: Why Deadlines Change the Measured Value of LLM Reasoning
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly plan and run experiments in automated laboratories. These experiments keep running while the model reasons and run on schedules with hard deadlines. If an LLM-generated answer arrives late, the system executes a safe fallback action instead, such as rejecting a sample. This creates a systems problem that standard serving metrics do not capture. An answer that matches the fallback adds no value, and answers that differ from the fallback may require more reasoning time. Reporting answer quality and latency separately can therefore overstate the value of reasoning. We test this on synthetic sample decisions, where the best choice is known exactly and a runtime enforces the deadline. We compare one LLM's fast mode, which answers directly, with its thinking mode, which reasons first. In a prespecified replay of 1,200 new decisions, thinking answers that missed a deadline were worth about five times as much as on-time ones. Multiplying the on-time rate by the mean answer value predicted about twice the value that thinking delivered. This prediction overstated thinking's advantage over fast mode by 0.0241 per decision, and by 0.0191 in a repeat on 300 new decisions. Both 95% confidence intervals excluded zero. In a single-GPU Qwen3-8B experiment using simultaneous request bursts, raising the number of requests from 8 to 56 reduced the share of thinking answers that met a 45 s deadline from 79.2% to 1.4%, although total output tripled. Evaluations of LLM agents for laboratories should therefore measure each answer's value and arrival time together and score the action that actually runs.

papers.title: Can LLM Agents Organize Their Own Memory?
papers.abstract: In most LLM agents, weights are fixed after deployment, so new information must be retained in external memory. Existing approaches often rely on predefined records and fixed organizational rules, which cannot readily accommodate evolving tasks and interactions. This raises the question: can LLM agents organize their own memory using ordinary documents? We introduce self-organized memory (SoMem), a framework that stores memory in linked documents. The agent decides what to summarize, how to group related information, and when to revise existing topics, and every summary it produces stays linked to the original interactions as evidence. The runtime validates updates and automatically derives temporal, relational, and recent-memory views from the organized content. At query time, the agent chooses what to search and read, following document links and inspecting original evidence as needed. On LoCoMo, BEAM-100K, and LongMemEval-S, SoMem outperforms the strongest baseline by 2.66, 3.10, and 2.00 percentage points, respectively. The constructed memory can be reused across models, and additional reasoning effort can further improve answer quality. These findings demonstrate the feasibility of agents organizing and using their own persistent memory through ordinary documents. Code is available at: https://github.com/Qi202/SoMem.

papers.title: BharatSynthQA: A Context-Grounded Question Answering Dataset on Indian Temples and Religious Heritage
papers.abstract: India's temples and other places of worship are among its richest repositories of cultural heritage, bringing together religious tradition, history, architecture, and art. Due to the widespread curiosity, people increasingly turn to Artificial Intelligence (AI) assistants for information about them. Current models are rarely trained or evaluated on this domain. We present BharatSynthQA, a passage grounded question answering (QA) dataset focused on Indian temples, which also covers other religious sites connected to them. Our pipeline crawls Wikipedia from topics seeded by authentic heritage sources, filters articles for topical relevance, and locations in India. Further it generates Boolean, factoid, and explanatory QA pairs with a fewshot prompted LLM. An LLM judge filters the pairs on answer correctness, retaining 98,677 of 131,494 generated pairs. Additionally, 300 human-annotated pairs are released separately as a reference set. Human evaluation of the subsample of this dataset showed 89.83% of the questions were formed correctly. Benchmarking five current LLMs shows that factoid token F1 is only 0.18-0.30 without the source passage but 0.73-0.77 with it, indicating that this domain is poorly captured in model knowledge. The dataset is available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/theshivam7/bharatsynth-qa to support research on culturally grounded QA and retrieval-augmented generation for Indian heritage.

papers.title: CHO-Bench: How Do Context Hints Affect Ad Rankings in LLM Advertising?
papers.abstract: LLM advertising selects advertisements based on user conversations, where user needs may extend beyond explicit product searches. ChatGPT Ads allows advertisers to provide natural-language context hints describing what they offer, who may find it useful, and when it may be useful, as additional information for ranking advertisements across diverse user conversations. However, how to effectively construct these hints remains unclear. We formulate Context Hint Optimization (CHO) as the problem of constructing context hints to improve an advertisement's ranking under a given budget. Drawing on established marketing frameworks, we develop seven context hint generation strategies covering What, Who, and When, along with a Unified strategy that combines all seven dimensions. We introduce CHO-Bench and conduct over 1.19 million paired evaluations across five datasets using embedding-based and LLM-based rankers. Our results show that context hints improve advertisement rankings under the evaluated offline rankers. While individual strategies achieve similar average gains and Unified offers no consistent advantage, strategy differences become more pronounced under specific generation-ranking configurations, with embedding-based and LLM-based rankers favoring different information dimensions. Increasing the hint budget further improves rankings with diminishing marginal gains. These findings establish an offline benchmark for studying ad-side ranking optimization in LLM advertising and highlight opportunities for model-specific hint selection and budget-aware generation and aggregation.
