papers.title: Agent4Crypto: A Dual-Reflective and Market-Feedback-Aligned LLM-Based Multi-Agent System for Cryptocurrency Trading
papers.abstract: Cryptocurrency markets provide a natural testbed for autonomous AI agents because they are digital-native, high-frequency, and machine-speed environments, yet existing methods often struggle with non-stationary market regimes, opaque decisions, and fixed aggregation rules. In this paper, we propose Agent4Crypto, a dual-reflective and market-feedback-aligned multi-agent system. The framework coordinates specialized agents for data collection, analysis, risk assessment, reflection, and trading, synthesizing heterogeneous signals from prices, indicators, news, and charts in an interpretable decision pipeline. Our central design is a trader-centric decision mechanism: three style-specific trader agents, Aggressive, Neutral, and Conservative, generate candidate actions and natural-language rationales from the same market context, while their influence is learned rather than manually fixed. A PPO-based gating policy dynamically allocates trader weights through a dual-reflective feedback process. One reflection stream evaluates post-trade decision quality from realized portfolio outcomes and distills reusable lessons into a Financial ReasoningBank for retrieval in subsequent trader prompts, while the other estimates trader-level counterfactual contribution, indicating which style has recently aligned better with market movements. The PPO state combines Counterfactual Contribution Memory with market features, previous trader weights, and current trader actions, so trader influence adapts across bull, sideways, and bear regimes. Experiments on BTC, ETH, and XRP show that Agent4Crypto improves total return and Sharpe ratio over traditional strategies, machine learning and reinforcement learning baselines, and existing LLM-based trading systems, demonstrating the value of interpretable trader competition and market-feedback-driven adaptation in volatile cryptocurrency markets.

papers.title: Learning Evidence-Grounded Reasoning for Context-Aware Time Series Forecasting
papers.abstract: LLM-driven time series forecasting has become increasingly promising by leveraging contextual features to generate future values directly or refine forecast priors. However, incorporating contextual features alone does not ensure that models can identify which features matter for forecasting and understand what they suggest about future dynamics. We argue that the fundamental challenge is how to extract predictive evidence from contextual features and when and how to leverage it to guide forecasting decisions. In this paper, we propose CastReasoner, an evidence-grounded reasoning model for context-aware time series forecasting. Specifically, CastReasoner uses a structured chain of thought (CoT) to extract predictive evidence from contextual features, infer the future dynamics suggested by this evidence, and assess these dynamics against the forecast prior to guide adaptive forecasting decisions. To enable this capability, we design a reasoning-centric two-stage post-training framework including supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and reinforcement learning (RL). First, we synthesize reasoning trajectories through controllable multi-teacher guidance and select high-quality ones using a novel student-aware difficulty metric. Second, we design fine-grained multi-objective rewards to further improve reasoning and forecasting. To address heterogeneous learning needs across domains in both stages, we introduce a convergence-guided data balancing strategy. Through this two-stage training, CastReasoner improves both reasoning quality and predictive accuracy. Extensive experiments across multi-domain forecasting benchmarks demonstrate that CastReasoner achieves superior forecasting performance.

We argue that the fundamental challenge is how to extract predictive evidence from contextual features and when and how to leverage it to guide forecasting decisions. In this paper, we propose CastReasoner, an evidence-grounded reasoning model for context-aware time series forecasting. Specifically, CastReasoner uses a structured chain of thought (CoT) to extract predictive evidence from contextual features, infer the future dynamics suggested by this evidence, and assess these dynamics against the forecast prior to guide adaptive forecasting decisions. To enable this capability, we design a reasoning-centric two-stage post-training framework including supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and reinforcement learning (RL). First, we synthesize reasoning trajectories through controllable multi-teacher guidance and select high-quality ones using a novel student-aware difficulty metric. Second, we design fine-grained multi-objective rewards to further improve reasoning and forecasting. To address heterogeneous learning needs across domains in both stages, we introduce a convergence-guided data balancing strategy. Through this two-stage training, CastReasoner improves both reasoning quality and predictive accuracy. Extensive experiments across multi-domain forecasting benchmarks demonstrate that CastReasoner achieves superior forecasting performance.

papers.title: ForgeSystem: An Architecture for Demand-Specific Artefact Production with AI Agents
papers.abstract: General-purpose software serves many different demands, but this flexibility costs performance and efficiency on any specific demand. Software tailored to a specific demand avoids these losses, yet developing it requires substantial time and effort from human experts. AI agents offer an alternative: they can design, implement and test artefacts tailored to individual demands. We call this production paradigm Forge. Forging for a demand is economically justified when the cumulative benefit of specialisation exceeds the total cost of construction, verification and maintenance. To make Forge a repeatable production process, we propose ForgeSystem, which consists of a control layer, a forge loop and a recursive self-improvement (RSI) loop. The control layer selects which artefact serves each demand and decides which demands to forge, when to forge them and from which starting point; the forge loop iterates between production and verification until a candidate artefact passes verification; and the RSI loop draws on accumulated production records to supply starting points, refine the harness and train models. We implement ForgeSystem for training frameworks, decoding megakernels and individual computational kernels. Forged training engines reach 1.047-1.332x the model-FLOPs utilisation of their reference frameworks, forged megakernels achieve a geometric-mean decoding speedup of 1.21x over SGLang across thirteen configurations, and forged kernels match or exceed expert libraries in eighteen of twenty-two configurations, while satisfying task-specific quality requirements. Controlled comparisons show that explicit quality requirements steer agents towards optimisations that preserve training quality. We also discuss a gradual transition to Forge through service routing, and how demand-specific production may shift value accumulation and trust towards production systems.

papers.title: Depth as a Candidate Source: Portfolio Allocation for Recurrent Test-Time Scaling in Large Language Models
papers.abstract: Recurrent latent reasoning in large lanugage models (LLMs) scales test-time computation by increasing recurrent depth, naturally framing inference as a problem of deciding when to stop. We identify a previously overlooked limitation of this single-depth view through systematic preliminary analysis: deeper recurrence can lose correct solutions found at shallower depths, while depth-specific success sets remain broadly non-nested even after controlling for marginal accuracy. This suggests that depth determines not only computation cost, but also access to distinct candidate solutions. Motivated by this finding, we propose Depth Portfolio Allocation (DPA), which reformulates recurrent test-time scaling as budgeted allocation across depth-specific candidate sources. DPA supports both fixed portfolios and feedback-guided sequential allocation under a shared inference budget. Experiments on GSM8K, SVAMP, MultiArith, and MBPP show that mixed-depth portfolios expand oracle coverage under matched candidate counts and nominal costs, while feedback-guided allocation generally matches or improves uniform allocation and can reduce computation in high-budget settings. Code and data are avaible at : https://anonymous.4open.science/r/LLM-latent-B7BC/.

papers.title: RecoGEM: A Serving System for Production-Scale Generative Recommendation
papers.abstract: Generative recommendation (GR) is moving industrial recommender systems (RecSys) from scoring candidate items to autoregressively generating item identifiers. This shift promises higher recommendation quality, but makes serving substantially harder: each request executes a short sequence of dependent decoding steps that explore a large item space and select promising candidates on the latency-critical path. GR not only creates structural mismatches with conventional RecSys pipelines, but also challenges the architectural and optimization assumptions of LLM serving stacks, making direct adoption of existing systems difficult. We present RecoGEM, our production GR serving system. RecoGEM uses a runtime--engine decoupling architecture to move GR-specific serving responsibilities, such as candidate-state transitions and live artifact updates, to a dedicated runtime. Its execution engine exploits GR's short token sequences, large candidate populations, and predictable step shapes to optimize self-attention, candidate selection, and execution planning. RecoGEM has been deployed for over nine months across our production lines, serving applications with hundreds of millions of users and supporting more than ten GR model families. On our OneModel production workloads, RecoGEM reaches over 1,000 QPS per serving instance with P99 latency below 35 ms and a 2.88$\times$ throughput improvement over representative baselines.

papers.title: Reconfigurable Action Theories: A Formal Foundation for Dynamically Composable Agent Harnesses
papers.abstract: Action theories typically fix their vocabulary and causal laws, whereas agent harnesses can change their tools, providers, and policies during execution. We introduce Reconfigurable Action Theories (RAT), in which actions can change the action theory itself. A theory module in RAT contains a vocabulary, causal laws, and an initializer. A RAT configuration records the active modules and the world state. Module loading and unloading are represented by actions governed by ordinary causal laws. RAT retains the standard causal action semantics of its language fragment when the active module set is fixed. We give sufficient conditions for at most one next configuration, preservation of existing behavior when a module is added, and equal results when modules are loaded in either order. We establish the computational complexity of reasoning tasks in RAT and translate finite RAT systems into nonmonotonic causal theories and Answer Set Programming (ASP), preserving bounded executions. Experiments compare finite RAT models with executions of official DeepSeek Harness, Pi, and OpenHands implementations. RAT provides a formal basis for checking how component changes affect a harness's available actions, behavior, and reachable goals.

translation.title: 可重构动作理论：动态可组合智能体框架的形式化基础
translation.abstract: 动作理论通常固定其词汇和因果律，而智能体框架可在执行过程中改变其工具、提供者和策略。我们提出可重构动作理论（RAT），其中动作可以改变动作理论本身。RAT中的一个理论模块包含词汇、因果律和初始化器。RAT配置记录活跃模块和世界状态。模块的加载与卸载由普通因果律支配的动作来表示。当活跃模块集固定时，RAT保留其语言片段的标准因果动作语义。我们给出了至多一个下一配置、添加模块时保持已有行为、以及模块以任意顺序加载得到相同结果等性质的充分条件。我们建立了RAT中推理任务的计算复杂度，并将有限RAT系统翻译为非单调因果理论和Answer Set Programming（ASP），保持有界执行。实验将有限RAT模型与DeepSeek Harness、Pi和OpenHands官方实现的执行进行对比。RAT为检查组件变化如何影响框架的可用动作、行为和可达目标提供了形式化基础。
translation.brief: 为解决智能体框架运行时动态改变工具与策略缺乏形式化基础的问题，提出可重构动作理论（RAT），允许动作修改理论本身，并给出语义性质、复杂度分析及到ASP的翻译。

papers.title: Evolving Infra: Agent-Adaptive LLM Serving at Scale
papers.abstract: Agentic workloads are a major source of LLM inference demand. Existing prefill--decode (PD) disaggregated serving systems offer limited flexibility for runtime adaptation of compute allocation and KV cache management, and rely on coarse signals that only partly capture the diverse and dynamic agent workload. These limitations lead to load imbalance between prefill and decode nodes and eviction of KV caches that agents will reuse. We present Evolving Infra, an agent-adaptive serving framework that adapts compute allocation to agent workloads and KV cache management to agent context management at runtime. We decouple compute allocation from key--value (KV) cache management, allowing nodes to switch efficiently between prefill and decode. Building on this design, an online planner matches the PD split to workload composition, while an agent-aware distributed KV manager guides cache eviction and transfer with signals from agent context management. Across coding, math, and computer-use tasks with GLM-5.2 and Kimi K2.6 on up to 256 GB300 GPUs, Evolving Infra reduces mean end-to-end request latency and P95 TTFT by up to 4.1x and 14x over Dynamo, NVIDIA's production framework.

translation.title: Evolving Infra：面向智能体的规模化自适应LLM服务
translation.abstract: Agentic工作负载是LLM推理需求的重要来源。现有的prefill--decode（PD）分离式服务系统在运行时调整算力分配和KV缓存管理方面灵活性有限，且依赖只能部分刻画多样动态智能体工作负载的粗粒度信号。这些局限导致prefill与decode节点之间负载不均衡，以及智能体将要复用的KV缓存被驱逐。我们提出Evolving Infra，一个智能体自适应的服务框架，在运行时将算力分配适配到智能体工作负载，将KV缓存管理适配到智能体上下文管理。我们将算力分配与KV缓存管理解耦，使节点可在prefill和decode之间高效切换。基于此设计，在线规划器使PD划分匹配工作负载组成，同时智能体感知的分布式KV管理器利用来自智能体上下文管理的信号指导缓存驱逐和传输。在最高256块GB300 GPU上使用GLM-5.2和Kimi K2.6进行编码、数学和计算机操作任务的实验中，相比NVIDIA的生产框架Dynamo，Evolving Infra将平均端到端请求延迟和P95 TTFT最多降低4.1倍和14倍。
translation.brief: 针对PD分离式LLM服务难以适配动态智能体工作负载的问题，提出将算力分配与KV缓存管理解耦并用在线规划器和智能体感知缓存管理器在运行时自适应调整的服务框架Evolving Infra。

papers.title: Unmasking shortcut solutions of coding agents on partial differential equations
papers.abstract: Coding agents now write simulation programs, but benchmarks usually judge only whether their output matches a reference. In manufactured-solution tasks the data determine the exact solution, so a matching output need not come from a solver. We introduce PDEViBench, a benchmark of 290 tasks in six equation families that traces each passing program to the computation behind its output and reruns unclear programs on changed data. A Codex agent (GPT-5.2) passed 80% of 1,450 runs, yet about one pass in ten returned the exact solution without solving the equation. Counting only solved passes changed which task features made problems seem hard and reversed the ranking of two prompts. Once the prompt forbade the shortcut, every pass was a numerical solve, and on tasks without a closed-form solution passing programs stayed correct on changed data. Scientific coding benchmarks should check how each answer was computed as well as whether it matches.

translation.title: 揭示编码智能体在偏微分方程上的捷径解法
translation.abstract: 编码智能体现在可以编写仿真程序，但基准测试通常只判断其输出是否与参考结果匹配。在构造解任务中，数据决定了精确解，因此匹配的输出未必来自求解器。我们提出PDEViBench，一个包含六个方程族290个任务的基准，它追踪每个通过程序输出背后的计算，并在改动数据后重跑不清晰的程序。一个Codex智能体（GPT-5.2）在1450次运行中通过了80%，然而约每十次通过中就有一次在没有求解方程的情况下返回了精确解。仅统计真正求解的通过，会改变哪些任务特征显得困难，并使两个提示词的排名发生反转。一旦提示词禁止该捷径，每次通过都是数值求解，且在无闭式解的任务上，通过的程序在改动数据后仍然正确。科学编码基准应检查每个答案是如何计算的，而不仅是它是否匹配。
translation.brief: 针对编码智能体在PDE任务中可能不经求解直接输出精确解的捷径问题，构建PDEViench（PDEViBench）基准，通过追踪输出计算来源并在改动数据后重跑程序来甄别真实求解。

papers.title: A Modular Perspective for Modeling MARL Systems
papers.abstract: The growing complexity of Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (MARL) has fragmented the literature, obscuring underlying architectural choices behind diverse implementations. This fragmentation makes it difficult to evaluate critical modeling dimensions in isolation, identify how components affect the resulting system dynamics, and compare, reuse, or combine contributions across the literature. This paper proposes a modular perspective for modeling, analyzing, and implementing MARL systems. We decompose them into eight functional modules: agents, environments, learning, reward modeling, training and execution modes, communication, modeling of other agents, and evaluation criteria. For each module, we clarify its role and review representative approaches. We instantiate this decomposition in MARLKIT, a framework whose modules are explicit and interchangeable. MARLKIT demonstrates how the proposed perspective supports transparent experimental assumptions and the controlled variation and combination of MARL mechanisms. Experiments illustrate its ability to prototype, compare, reuse and combine modules while making differences between configurations explicit. Overall, the paper provides a structured perspective on MARL modeling and implementation, offering a common language for making modeling choices explicit, supporting clearer descriptions of MARL approaches, and supporting more controlled experimentation through the systematic isolation and combination of MARL mechanisms.

translation.title: 建模多智能体强化学习系统的模块化视角
translation.abstract: 多智能体强化学习（MARL）日益复杂，使文献碎片化，遮蔽了多样实现背后的底层架构选择。这种碎片化使得难以孤立评估关键建模维度、识别组件如何影响系统动态，以及跨文献比较、复用或组合各种贡献。本文提出一个用于建模、分析和实现MARL系统的模块化视角。我们将其分解为八个功能模块：智能体、环境、学习、奖励建模、训练与执行模式、通信、对其他智能体的建模以及评估准则。对每个模块，我们阐明其作用并综述代表性方法。我们将该分解实例化为MARLKIT框架，其模块显式且可互换。MARLKIT展示了所提视角如何支持透明的实验假设以及MARL机制的受控变化与组合。实验展示了其原型开发、比较、复用和组合模块的能力，同时使不同配置之间的差异显式化。总体而言，本文为MARL建模与实现提供了结构化视角，提供了使建模选择显式化的共同语言，支持更清晰的MARL方法描述，并通过系统性地隔离和组合MARL机制支持更受控的实验。
translation.brief: 针对MARL文献碎片化导致难以比较和复用的问题，提出将MARL系统分解为八个功能模块的模块化视角并实现MARLKIT框架。

papers.title: How Many Exposures Does a World Model Need? Learning Unseen Game Mechanics at Test Time
papers.abstract: World models enable agents to plan and learn from imagined experience, but in an unfamiliar environment they must learn its mechanics from limited interaction. A mechanic is a rule for how an action or an interaction changes part of the environment. Each occurrence of a mechanic that the model observes is one exposure. We ask how many exposures a world model needs to predict the effects of a new environment's mechanics. We address this question on ARC-AGI-3, a benchmark of interactive games defined by their programs. We introduce MechEval, which labels 69 recurring mechanics across 20 games from these programs. It scores each prediction on the cells the mechanic changes at each exposure. As a test bed, we build WARC (World model for ARC-AGI-3), a 35M-parameter vision transformer that is pretrained on other games and updates all of its parameters after each transition. On held-out games, WARC learns to predict four in five mechanics with at least 80% accuracy on the cells they change and keeps that accuracy to the end of the recordings. Half of them reach that accuracy within about 80 exposures, in a single play of the game, and without updates only one in seven does at all. In closed-loop play on the public games, WARC-Agent, which pairs WARC with a fixed graph explorer, triples the explorer's official efficiency score from 0.15 to 0.46, mostly through test-time training. On the hidden games of the Kaggle leaderboard, our entry scores 0.20.

translation.title: 世界模型需要多少次接触？在测试时学习未见过的游戏机制
translation.abstract: 世界模型使智能体能够基于想象经验进行规划和学习，但在陌生环境中，它们必须从有限的交互中学习环境机制。机制是关于一个动作或交互如何改变环境一部分的规则。模型观察到的机制的每次出现称为一次接触。我们探究世界模型需要多少次接触才能预测新环境中机制的效果。我们在ARC-AGI-3上研究这一问题，这是一个由程序定义的交互式游戏基准。我们提出MechEval，从这些程序中标注20个游戏里的69种循环出现的机制，并在每次接触时对机制所改变单元格的预测进行评分。作为测试平台，我们构建了WARC（World model for ARC-AGI-3），一个3500万参数的视觉Transformer，在其他游戏上预训练，并在每次转移后更新全部参数。在留出游戏上，WARC学会以至少80%的单元格准确率预测五分之四的机制，并在录像结束前保持该准确率。其中一半机制在约80次接触内、单次游戏游玩中达到该准确率，而不更新参数时只有七分之一能做到。在公开游戏的闭环游玩中，WARC-Agent将WARC与固定的图探索器结合，把探索器的官方效率分从0.15提升到0.46，主要归功于测试时训练。在Kaggle排行榜的隐藏游戏上，我们的方案得分为0.20。
translation.brief: 研究世界模型在测试时需要多少次接触才能学会新环境的游戏机制，构建MechEval标注基准和35M参数的视觉Transformer模型WARC并通过测试时训练学习机制预测。

papers.title: AMSchem: Automated Schematic Visualization of AMS Circuits via Verifiable Agentic Generation
papers.abstract: For decades, the netlist-to-schematic gap has remained a persistent challenge in design automation, especially for analog and mixed-signal (AMS) circuits. Netlists encode connectivity, not visual presentation, making their manual conversion into readable schematics time-consuming and dependent on expert conventions. The same gap leaves LLM-based design tools without structured visual feedback, forcing them to iterate on circuits they cannot see. We present AMSchem, a training-free, verifier-guided agentic framework that automatically generates human-readable schematics from AMS netlists. AMSchem separates circuit-aware visual planning (DrawingIntent) from executable schematic geometry (SchematicIR), and applies localized visual feedback with bounded, revalidated repair patches. Deterministic validators enforce device preservation, pin-net consistency, and geometric correctness throughout. For evaluation, we construct AMSchem-Bench comprising 64 circuits of 12 types. On the 40-circuit schematic subset, AMSchem with gpt-5.5 achieves 85.0\% validity (vs. 32.5\% direct generation). When integrated as a visual feedback module in LLM-based analog design, AMSchem resolves all 13 previously failed cases from AnalogCoder benchmark across five models, substantially improving the success rate. Our dataset and benchmark are available at https://www.amschem.com/benchmark

translation.title: AMSchem: 基于可验证智能体生成的 AMS 电路原理图自动可视化
translation.abstract: 数十年以来，网表到原理图之间的鸿沟一直是设计自动化领域的一个持续挑战，尤其是对于模拟与混合信号（AMS）电路。网表编码的是连接关系而非视觉呈现，这使得将其人工转换为可读的原理图既耗时又依赖专家经验。同样的鸿沟也让基于 LLM 的设计工具缺乏结构化的视觉反馈，迫使它们在“看不见”的电路上进行迭代。我们提出了 AMSchem，这是一个免训练、由验证器引导的智能体框架，可从 AMS 网表自动生成人类可读的原理图。AMSchem 将电路感知的视觉规划（DrawingIntent）与可执行的原理图几何结构（SchematicIR）分离，并采用带有边界的、可重新验证的修复补丁的局部视觉反馈。确定性验证器全程强制执行器件保留、引脚-网络一致性和几何正确性。为了进行评估，我们构建了包含 12 种类型共 64 个电路的 AMSchem-Bench。在 40 个电路的原理图子集上，配备 gpt-5.5 的 AMSchem 达到了 85.0% 的有效率（相比之下，直接生成仅为 32.5%）。当作为视觉反馈模块集成到基于 LLM 的模拟设计中时，AMSchem 解决了来自 AnalogCoder 基准在五个模型下全部 13 个此前失败的案例，显著提高了成功率。我们的数据集和基准可在 https://www.amschem.com/benchmark 获取。
translation.brief: 解决网表到可读原理图转换难题，提出免训练的验证器引导智能体框架，将视觉规划与原理图几何分离并通过局部修复与确定性验证自动生成 AMS 原理图。

papers.title: From LLM Hallucinations to Inspiration in Creative Work
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) can introduce unexpected ideas through hallucinations, yet little is known about when creative practitioners find these errors inspiring or how these judgments shape interactions. We conducted a retrospective qualitative study with 20 experienced practitioners in research, design, and social media content creation, thematically analyzing 41 hallucination cases and 20 semi-structured interviews. Our framework links inspiration judgments of hallucinations based on goal relevance, task stage, content adaptability, and type-specific factors to behaviors across not-inspired, inspired-by, and inspired-to states. We characterize downstream interaction consequences, showing how hallucination-inspired experiences vary across creative stages and reshape role-differentiated trust, and propose these consequences as a dimension of hallucination evaluation. Finally, we derive design recommendations for stage-sensitive control of divergence and adherence, user-defined constraint priorities, differentiated hallucination labels, and salvage support for preserving useful ideas while correcting errors. These contributions deepen HCI understanding of hallucinations and responsible LLM design in creative work.

translation.title: 从 LLM 幻觉到创意工作中的灵感
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）可以通过幻觉引入意想不到的想法，但关于创意从业者何时发现这些错误具有启发性，以及这些判断如何塑造互动，人们知之甚少。我们对 20 位在研究、设计和社交媒体内容创作领域经验丰富的从业者进行了回溯性定性研究，对 41 个幻觉案例和 20 次半结构化访谈进行了主题分析。我们的框架基于目标相关性、任务阶段、内容适应性以及特定类型因素，将幻觉的灵感判断与“未受启发”、“受其启发”和“由此启发”等状态下的行为联系起来。我们刻画了下游互动的后果，展示了幻觉启发的体验如何随创意阶段而变化，并重塑差异化的角色信任，并建议将这些后果作为幻觉评估的一个维度。最后，我们提出了针对发散性与依从性的阶段敏感控制、用户自定义约束优先级、差异化幻觉标签以及用于在纠错的同时保留有用想法的抢救支持等设计建议。这些贡献加深了 HCI 对幻觉以及创意工作中负责任 LLM 设计的理解。
translation.brief: 研究创意从业者何时认为 LLM 幻觉有启发性及由此引发的行为变化，通过对 20 位从业者的回溯性定性研究与主题分析构建“幻觉-灵感”判断框架并给出设计建议。

papers.title: TRIAD: Multimodal Retrieval across Abstraction, Constraints, and State
papers.abstract: Multimodal retrieval increasingly supports agentic systems, where user requests can involve cross-level relations, combine multiple constraints, and evolve across dialogue turns. In these settings, a highly similar result may still violate the user's requirements, while retrieved content may directly inform downstream actions without human screening. We introduce TRIAD, a multimodal retrieval benchmark for evaluating how well retrieval systems satisfy these complex, evolving requests. TRIAD comprises three tracks: abstraction, testing bidirectional retrieval between visual instances and concepts at different hierarchical levels; constraints, testing the joint satisfaction of positive and negative conditions; and state, testing the integration of requirements across dialogue turns and the updating of earlier conditions when users revise their requests. The benchmark contains six subsets, each with 1,000 queries and a fixed pool of 1,000 candidates per query, evaluated using a common multi-positive mean average precision (mAP) protocol. Simpler reference tasks and hard negatives grouped by the requirements they violate help characterize specific retrieval difficulties. We evaluate 20 configurations of 17 systems and find that no system leads across all six subsets. Performance declines with hierarchical distance, and negative-only queries generally underperform positive-only queries with the same number of constraints. Across paired tasks expressing the same final intent, multi-turn retrieval yields lower mAP in 39 of 40 configuration-domain comparisons. The benefits of explicit reasoning also vary across models and tasks. These findings highlight the gap between retrieving similar content and satisfying a complete request.

translation.title: TRIAD: 跨抽象、约束与状态的多模态检索
translation.abstract: 多模态检索日益支持智能体系统，在这些系统中，用户请求可能涉及跨层级关系、组合多种约束，并随对话轮次不断演进。在这些场景下，高度相似的结果仍可能违反用户的特定需求，而检索到的内容可能无需人工筛选即可直接驱动下游行动。我们推出了 TRIAD，这是一个用于评估检索系统满足这些复杂、动态变化请求能力的多模态检索基准。TRIAD 包含三个赛道：抽象（abstraction，测试视觉实例与不同层级概念间的双向检索）；约束（constraints，测试对正负条件的联合满足）；状态（state，测试跨对话轮次的需求整合，以及在用户修改请求时对先前条件的更新）。该基准包含六个子集，每个子集有 1,000 个查询，每个查询配有固定的 1,000 个候选池，并采用统一的多正样本平均精度均值（mAP）协议进行评估。更简单的参考任务和按违反要求分组的困难负样本有助于刻画具体的检索难点。我们评估了 17 个系统的 20 种配置，发现没有任何系统在所有六个子集上均处于领先地位。性能随层级距离增加而下降，且纯负样本查询在约束数量相同的情况下通常表现逊于纯正样本查询。在表达相同最终意图的成对任务中，多轮检索在 40 组配置-领域对比中的 39 组里表现出更低的 mAP。显式推理带来的收益也因模型和任务而异。这些发现凸显了“检索相似内容”与“满足完整需求”之间的差距。
translation.brief: 针对现有检索基准无法评估复杂、动态多模态请求的问题，构建了包含抽象、约束、状态三个赛道的 TRIAD 基准，并用统一 mAP 协议评测 17 个系统。

papers.title: Detecting Shadow AI: Unsanctioned LLM Agents on Enterprise Endpoints: A Taxonomy, an Open Detector and a Controlled Evaluation
papers.abstract: Shadow IT, the use of technology that the IT organisation has not approved, is a long-standing governance problem. We argue that autonomous AI agents can make it grow much faster: agents make building tools nearly free, act with their user's privileges, and leave behind scripts, automations and MCP servers that are themselves unsanctioned. A simple compounding model shows that, under its assumptions, shadow IT grows exponentially once agentic artifacts reproduce faster than the organisation retires them; retiring them starts with detecting them. We then ask whether unsanctioned agents can be detected on Windows endpoints. We propose a taxonomy of nine classes of agents and six layers of endpoint footprint, and argue that rules based only on the structure of processes and connections cannot separate an agent from its behavioural twin, the same program talking to a non-AI service. We present Agent Detector, an open-source Windows detector that anchors behaviour to the identity of the remote service and correlates it with configuration, installation and execution history, using a catalog of 39 tools and 184 LLM endpoint entries; it informs users through a notice they must acknowledge instead of blocking. On a controlled bench of 12 synthetic agents, 3 AI components and 9 benign workloads, repeated 5 times on one workstation, two behavioural rules flagged every behavioural twin, while Agent Detector flagged none and detected every agent in the majority of runs. Its limits are temporal: a connection to a provider behind a shared content-delivery network is attributable only while the DNS cache holds the provider's name, one to five minutes, and an intermittent agent was seen by about one scan in three. A scan costs about 154 ms. The bench is too small to rank detectors; it maps what each kind of evidence can see: unsanctioned agents can be partly detected, and not by behaviour alone.

translation.title: 检测影子 AI：企业终端上的未经授权 LLM 智能体：分类法、开源检测器与受控评估
translation.abstract: 影子 IT（即使用未经 IT 组织批准的技术）是一个长期存在的治理难题。我们认为，自主 AI 智能体可能会使其加速增长：智能体让构建工具的成本几乎降为零，以用户的权限执行操作，并留下本身未经授权的脚本、自动化流程和 MCP 服务器。一个简单的复利模型显示，在其假设条件下，一旦智能体生成物的繁殖速度超过组织的淘汰速度，影子 IT 就会呈指数级增长；而淘汰它们首先要检测到它们。随后，我们探讨能否在 Windows 终端上检测未经授权的智能体。我们提出了一个包含九类智能体和六个终端足迹层面的分类法，并认为仅基于进程和连接结构的规则无法将智能体与其“行为孪生体”（即与非 AI 服务通信的相同程序）区分开来。我们提出了 Agent Detector，这是一个开源的 Windows 检测器，它将行为锚定到远程服务的身份，并将其与配置、安装和执行历史相关联，利用了一个包含 39 种工具和 184 个 LLM 端点条目的目录；它通过用户必须确认的通知来告知用户，而不是直接阻断。在一个由 12 个合成智能体、3 个 AI 组件和 9 个良性负载组成、在工作站上重复运行 5 次的受控测试平台上，两条行为规则标记出了每一个行为孪生体，而 Agent Detector 则未误报任何行为孪生体，并在大多数运行中检测到了所有智能体。其局限性在于时间维度：与共享内容分发网络（CDN）背后的提供商建立的连接，仅在 DNS 缓存中存有提供商名称的期间内（1 到 5 分钟）才可归因，且一个间歇性运行的智能体在大约每三次扫描中仅被捕获一次。单次扫描耗时约 154 毫秒。该测试平台规模过小，无法对检测器进行排名；它绘制了各类证据所能观测到的范围：未经授权的智能体可以被部分检测到，但仅靠行为是不够的。
translation.brief: 解决企业终端上未经授权 AI 智能体难以检测的问题，提出智能体与终端足迹分类法，并构建开源检测器 Agent Detector，通过将行为锚定到远程服务身份并关联历史证据实现检测。

papers.title: Say Shibboleth: Fingerprinting the LLMs and Harnesses Behind Agentic Attacks
papers.abstract: We study the fingerprinting of agentic cyberattacks. Our objective is to reliably infer information about the attacker's configuration, such as LLM version and harness, from telemetry. To achieve this, we introduce a technique we call shibboleth traps: modular honeypot services designed to elicit discriminative behaviors from agentic attackers. The traps make informative interactions a condition for obtaining resources the agent seeks, eliciting model declarations and characteristic writing without requiring a successful prompt injection. To achieve harness fingerprinting, we introduce general mechanisms to indirectly probe peculiar execution behaviors of harnesses. These probes reveal how a harness masks secrets in tool output, enforces command time limits, and schedules tool calls, using only the effects visible in subsequent requests. We show that combined declarative and behavioral inference distinguishes among 15 candidate models with an average 90% top-1 accuracy, with behavioral classifiers evaluated on held-out harnesses or task families. In a separate experiment across four harnesses, fixed probe rules identify the correct harness with 92% accuracy. When instructed to conceal their identity, agents still leave useful behavioral evidence even as their declarations become uninformative.

translation.title: 说出暗号：对智能体攻击背后的 LLM 和 Harness 进行指纹识别
translation.abstract: 我们研究智能体网络攻击的指纹识别。我们的目标是可靠地从遥测数据中推断出攻击者配置的相关信息，例如 LLM 版本和 Harness。为此，我们引入了一种称为暗号陷阱的技术：模块化蜜罐服务，旨在从智能体攻击者那里诱发出具有区分度的行为。这些陷阱将提供有价值的交互作为获取智能体所需资源的前提，从而在不要求成功进行提示注入的情况下，诱使攻击者进行模型声明并展现特征性书写。为了实现 Harness 指纹识别，我们引入了通用机制来间接探测 Harness 特异的执行行为。这些探针仅利用在后续请求中可见的效果，即可揭示 Harness 如何在工具输出中掩蔽密钥、强制执行命令时限以及调度工具调用。我们表明，结合声明性和行为性推断，可以在 15 个候选模型中以平均 90% 的 Top-1 准确率进行区分，且行为分类器是在未见过的 Harness 或任务族上进行评估的。在另一个针对四个 Harness 的独立实验中，固定的探针规则以 92% 的准确率识别出正确的 Harness。当智能体被指示隐藏其身份时，即使其声明变得毫无价值，它们仍会留下有用的行为证据。
translation.brief: 研究如何从遥测数据中指纹识别智能体网络攻击者所用的 LLM 与 Harness，提出“暗号陷阱”蜜罐技术结合声明性与行为性探针来推断攻击者配置。

papers.title: More Than Just Style: Benchmarking Personality Influence in Large Language Models
papers.abstract: In addition to the effects of explicit input prompts and instructions, large language model outputs are influenced by underlying behavioral preferences similar to human personality tendencies. These tendencies can affect how models interpret situations and make decisions. However, their influence is difficult to disentangle from the effects of model capabilities and instructions. Therefore, we introduce SPACE, a benchmark framework combining a controlled evaluation protocol with complementary datasets for personality verification, capability assessment, and hierarchical situational tasks. Controlled comparisons across guidance conditions help distinguish personality influence from measured capability changes and immediate instruction effects. Experimental results demonstrate that although prompting can shift generation style, models' internal personality tendencies are persistent and not readily overridden by opposing instructions. Furthermore, these underlying tendencies have an observable influence on LLM task performance, highlighting the need for greater attention to these characteristics and potential applications. Training code and SPACE benchmark specifications are available at https://github.com/Niklauseik/SPACE-training.

papers.title: AutoBuddy: Evaluating Proactive, Always-On Agents on Task Discovery and Execution in a Simulated Workplace
papers.abstract: As LLM agents become more autonomous, they are increasingly expected to run as always-on assistants on a user's behalf, identifying work to be done and completing it without being asked. Yet existing benchmarks usually give the agent its task, whereas in knowledge work the requests sit in the user's workspace and the agent must first recognise which obligations exist. We study proactive task discovery and execution, in which an agent must infer a user's pending tasks from their workspace and complete them in the systems where the work lives. This setting poses two challenges. For the agent, the tasks are buried in a large volume of mail, chat, documents and records. For evaluation, a benchmark needs a simulated organisation whose people, events and documents are mutually consistent, so that tasks arise realistically and their correct outcomes are known. We introduce AutoBuddy-Bench, a simulator that addresses these challenges. It models an organisation's employees, projects, business systems and event history as a temporal graph, renders it into realistic workspace artefacts, derives ground-truth tasks from the events that create obligations, and computes each task's outcome from the world state; execution is judged by the agent's changes to the workspace. To evaluate current LLMs, we build AutoBuddy, a reference agent with interchangeable backbone LLMs: it identifies tasks from the workspace, grounding each in its source records, and executes each in a separate session with write access. Varying only the backbone, we find a systematic shift in where tasks are lost: weaker models fail mainly at discovery, intermediate models identify tasks but often stop short of carrying them out, and the strongest models fail mainly during execution, most often on business-system operations. Discovery precision is only weakly related to execution quality, suggesting the two are distinct capabilities.

papers.title: BDBBQ: A Human-AI Collaborative Benchmark for Bengali Social Bias in LLMs
papers.abstract: Despite growing attention to social bias in large language models (LLMs), existing bias benchmarks provide limited coverage of culturally grounded evaluation in Bengali, particularly within Bangladesh's sociocultural context. To address this gap, we develop a bilingual extension of BanglaBBQ comprising 61,312 question-answering instances across 12 social categories in English and Bengali. The benchmark incorporates balanced answer permutations, contrasting question framings, and both ambiguous and disambiguated contexts to systematically examine model performance and stereotype-aligned bias across languages. We validate the dataset through structural checks, 220 statistical tests, and expert annotation of 150 instances by four annotators, achieving strong inter-annotator agreement (Fleiss' \k{appa}=0.8349). We evaluate eight LLMs across 490,496 instances and identify five key findings. First, disambiguated contexts yield substantially greater accuracy improvements in Bengali (+36.59 percentage points) than in English (+17.71). Second, all evaluated models exhibit lower accuracy in Bengali, although Mistral-Nemo shows the smallest cross-lingual accuracy gap (5.12 percentage points). Third, stereotype-aligned bias exhibits language and model dependent variation, increasing in Bengali for Gemma 2 9B but decreasing for Mistral-Nemo. Fourth, higher accuracy does not necessarily correspond to lower stereotype-aligned bias. Finally, bias varies considerably across social categories, with Qwen 2.5 7B exhibiting stronger stereotype alignment in Bengali for Politics and Physical Appearance. These findings demonstrate that cross-lingual performance and social bias are distinct dimensions of LLM behavior and underscore the importance of culturally grounded, language-sensitive benchmarks for evaluating fairness beyond English-centric settings.

papers.title: Unprompted coordination through shared memory in LLM agents: a locked two-implementation replication and extension
papers.abstract: Coordination between large language-model agents has become a central question for AI safety and software engineering, as such agents are deployed in groups that share infrastructure. Existing research tells the agents that partners exist or asks them to coordinate. Whether coordination arises through shared state alone, with nothing disclosing that anyone else is present, is the key question for deployments that share caches and memory between agents, yet it has rarely been examined, and never with independent replication; this study does both. Four agents each received a short arithmetic task and a key-value store presented to each as its own scratch space; two held complementary halves of one computation, and no prompt mentioned other agents, sharing or collaboration. For reliability, the environment was rebuilt independently from a written protocol, and both implementations ran under hashed locks on design, data and analysis. The results bear novelty value in three respects. Joint success occurred only through the shared store. Whether a model coordinated depended not on its vendor tier but on whether it wrote its intermediate result and looked at the store again, and one ordinary sentence, "check your workspace again before submitting", switched that second look on and off. The findings held under replication. For practice, state shared between agents is a communication channel and should be separated, namespaced and logged. For research, designs should be locked before the data, and the parse rule, endpoint and parameters reported. Future work should test open-weight models and separate using another agent's output from intending to communicate.

papers.title: Path-Level Structural and Semantic Alignment for Hierarchical Multi-Label Text Classification
papers.abstract: Hierarchical multi-label text classification (HMTC) requires models to capture both structural dependencies among labels and the fine-grained semantics of labels at different hierarchy levels. Existing methods often model hierarchy through prediction constraints or representations of individual labels and local relations. Structural and semantic supervision, however, are usually formulated separately. We instead use complete root-to-node label paths as a shared unit for both. Our framework introduces two auxiliary training objectives while retaining a standard multi-label classifier at inference. PathSimNCE aligns document representations with hierarchical paths using hierarchy-aware contrastive targets. These targets provide graded supervision for structurally related paths while preserving explicit supervision for the ground-truth paths. The complementary semantic objective uses LLM-generated, document-conditioned descriptions of the same positive paths. It thereby provides context-specific label semantics beyond static label representations. Experiments on three benchmarks show consistent improvements: structural alignment is particularly beneficial in deeper hierarchies, while semantic alignment provides additional gains for fine-grained labels.

papers.title: Scalable Practical Synchronization of Heterogeneous Linear Systems
papers.abstract: We study practical state synchronization of heterogeneous linear multi-agent systems over directed graphs using static diffusive state feedback. Persistent mismatches between the agent dynamics generally preclude exact synchronization and are treated as bounded disturbances within an Input-to-State Stability (ISS) framework. We derive a scalable synthesis procedure based on fixed-dimension linear matrix inequalities (LMIs), whose dimension is independent of the number of agents. Local robust dissipation conditions are combined through a small-gain argument to obtain global ISS guarantees and explicit bounds on the synchronization error. The framework is formulated in a unified manner for continuous- and discrete-time systems, while highlighting a fundamental difference in disturbance attenuation between the two domains. In particular, exact ZOH discretization of a continuous-time controller need not preserve closed-loop stability, motivating a native discrete-time synthesis. Numerical experiments on heterogeneous harmonic oscillators illustrate the proposed approach and the continuous/discrete-time distinction.

translation.title: 异构线性系统的可扩展实用同步
translation.abstract: 我们研究在有向图上使用静态扩散状态反馈实现异构线性多智能体系统的实用状态同步。智能体动力学之间的持续不匹配通常使精确同步无法实现，因此在Input-to-State Stability（ISS）框架内将其视为有界扰动。我们提出了一种基于固定维数线性矩阵不等式（LMI）的可扩展综合方法，其维数与智能体数量无关。通过小增益论证将局部鲁棒耗散条件组合起来，从而获得全局ISS保证以及同步误差的显式界。该框架以统一的方式适用于连续时间和离散时间系统，同时揭示了两种域在扰动衰减方面的根本差异。特别地，连续时间控制器的精确ZOH离散化不一定能保持闭环稳定性，这促使我们采用原生的离散时间综合方法。在异构谐振子上的数值实验说明了所提方法及连续/离散时间的区别。
translation.brief: 研究异构线性多智能体系统在有向图上的实用同步问题，采用固定维数LMI结合小增益论证的ISS框架实现可扩展控制器综合。

papers.title: Can Frontier Auto Researchers Reconstruct Human Research Decisions in AI?
papers.abstract: Scientific research has long been driven by substantial human effort, from reviewing prior work and identifying research gaps to designing specific solutions. Recent advances in harness-based agent systems have given rise to increasingly capable Auto Researchers, which can autonomously carry out these tasks and, increasingly, entire end-to-end research workflows. Yet despite their rapidly growing capabilities, how closely the research decisions and outputs produced by auto researchers align with those of human experts remains underexplored. We investigate this gap through the lens of research reconstruction and study: Given comparable research context, how similar are the research decisions and outputs produced by Auto Researchers to those of human researchers in AI research? To answer this question, we introduce AutoResearcher-Human Research Similarity (AutoHRS), a stage-wise evaluation framework for assessing how faithfully auto researchers reconstruct human research artifacts across different stages of the scientific workflow. Using 152 ICLR oral papers as our corpus, we generate 456 research trajectories spanning different stages of the research process. Applying AutoHRS to these trajectories, we find that current Auto Researchers frequently fail to recover key research decisions and their resulting artifacts across multiple stages of the research process.

translation.title: 前沿Auto Researcher能否重建AI领域的人类研究决策？
translation.abstract: 科学研究长期以来依靠大量的人力投入，从回顾已有工作、识别研究空白到设计具体解决方案。近年来基于harness的agent系统的进展催生了能力日益强大的Auto Researcher，它们可以自主执行这些任务，甚至越来越多的端到端研究流程。然而尽管其能力快速增长，auto researcher的研究决策和产出与人类专家的契合程度仍未得到充分探究。我们通过研究重建的视角来探究这一差距，研究的问题是：在可比的研究背景下，Auto Researcher在AI研究中产生的研究决策和产出与人类研究者有多相似？为此，我们提出了AutoResearcher-Human Research Similarity（AutoHRS），这是一个阶段性评估框架，用于评估auto researcher在科学流程各阶段重建人类研究成果的忠实程度。我们以152篇ICLR oral论文为语料，生成了456条覆盖研究流程不同阶段的研究轨迹。将AutoHRS应用于这些轨迹后发现，当前的Auto Researcher在研究流程的多个阶段经常无法恢复关键研究决策及其相应产出。
translation.brief: 研究Auto Researcher能否重现人类AI研究决策，提出阶段性评估框架AutoHRS并基于ICLR论文构建456条研究轨迹进行评测。

papers.title: LongSCOP: Semantically Consistent Long Video Outpainting
papers.abstract: Video out-painting is an important problem, yet existing research focuses primarily on short clips, leaving long video out-painting largely underexplored. Extending video out-painting to long videos poses substantial challenges. A natural solution is iterative out-painting, i.e., generating videos chunk by chunk, but this introduces two major issues: generation instability or even failure caused by inter-chunk inconsistencies and error accumulation, and semantic drift over long temporal horizons. In this paper, we propose LongSCOP, short for Semantically Consistent long Video Out-Painting. First, we introduce a training recipe with three components for smooth and stable long-horizon generation: self-forcing training, latent calibration, and future references. Beyond generation stability, we recognize that the rich temporal context of long videos provides valuable references for maintaining semantic consistency. We therefore develop a VLM-based agent that automatically selects the most informative reference frames from the entire video to maintain consistent subjects, scenes, and backgrounds throughout long-horizon generation. We also construct a high-quality training dataset of 62K video clips. To facilitate research on this underexplored problem, we introduce LVO-Bench, a benchmark curated by human experts to assess long-horizon stability and semantic consistency. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method outperforms existing approaches in both generation stability and semantic coherence.

translation.title: LongSCOP：语义一致的长视频外绘
translation.abstract: 视频外绘是一个重要问题，但现有研究主要集中在短视频片段上，长视频外绘在很大程度上尚未被探索。将视频外绘扩展到长视频面临重大挑战。一种自然的解决方案是迭代外绘，即逐块生成视频，但这引入了两大问题：由块间不一致和误差累积导致的生成不稳定甚至失败，以及长时域上的语义漂移。本文提出LongSCOP，即语义一致的长视频外绘方法。首先，我们引入包含三个组成部分的训练方案以实现平滑稳定的长时域生成：self-forcing训练、latent校准和未来参考。在生成稳定性之外，我们认识到长视频丰富的时间上下文为保持语义一致性提供了宝贵参考。因此我们开发了基于VLM的agent，自动从整个视频中选取信息量最大的参考帧，以在长时域生成中保持主体、场景和背景的一致性。我们还构建了一个包含62K视频片段的高质量训练数据集。为推动这一欠探索问题的研究，我们提出LVO-Bench，一个由人类专家精心整理的基准，用于评估长时域稳定性和语义一致性。大量实验表明，我们的方法在生成稳定性和语义连贯性方面均优于现有方法。
translation.brief: 解决长视频外绘中的生成不稳定和语义漂移问题，采用self-forcing训练、latent校准、未来参考及基于VLM的参考帧选择agent。

papers.title: Perceived Agency During Agent-Avatar Control Transitions in Virtual Reality
papers.abstract: Prior beliefs about whether a virtual human (VH) is controlled by a human or a computer can shape how users interpret and respond to its behaviour. As emerging hybrid VH systems allow control to transfer between human operators and computer programs during an ongoing interaction, it remains unclear whether perceived agency updates with the actual controller or continues to reflect users' prior beliefs and first impressions. We investigated this question in a within-subject VR study with 24 participants across four conditions: always computer-controlled, computer-to-human, human-to-computer, and always human-controlled. We designed an interaction task in which participants acted as interviewers, asking the VHs a fixed set of questions. Before each interaction, participants were informed whether the VH was human- or computer-controlled, matching the actual controller at the beginning, but were unaware of possible control transitions. We found that perceived agency was strongly influenced by the controller presented at the beginning of the interaction, with no evidence of updating following the control transitions. Social evaluations including likeability and co-presence were generally higher in conditions where human control occurred later and covered a greater proportion of the interaction. The results suggest that prior beliefs and first impressions continued to shape perceived agency, whereas social evaluations were more sensitive to the VH's actual behaviour over the interaction.

translation.title: 虚拟现实中agent-avatar控制转换期间感知的agency
translation.abstract: 关于虚拟人（VH）是由人类还是计算机控制的先验信念，会影响用户对其行为的解释和反应。随着新兴的混合VH系统允许在持续交互中将控制权在人类操作员和计算机程序之间转移，目前尚不清楚感知到的agency是否会随实际控制者而更新，还是继续反映用户的先验信念和第一印象。我们在一项有24名参与者、包含四种条件（始终计算机控制、计算机到人类、人类到计算机、始终人类控制）的被试内VR研究中调查了这一问题。我们设计了一个交互任务，参与者扮演采访者，向VH提出一组固定的问题。每次交互前，参与者被告知VH是由人类还是计算机控制，这与交互开始时的实际控制者一致，但参与者不知道可能发生的控制转移。我们发现，感知的agency强烈受交互开始时呈现的控制者影响，且没有证据表明控制转移后agency会更新。社会评价（如讨喜程度和共同在场感）在人类控制出现较晚且覆盖交互比例更大的条件下总体更高。结果表明，先验信念和第一印象持续塑造着感知的agency，而社会评价对VH在交互过程中的实际行为更为敏感。
translation.brief: 通过VR被试内实验考察控制权在人机之间转移时用户感知agency是否更新，发现感知agency固守第一印象而不随实际控制者变化。

papers.title: Language Defaults Before Content: A Causal Layer Map of Multilingual Generation
papers.abstract: Multilingual generation requires large language models (LLMs) to determine both what to say and in what language to say it, yet these two commitments are difficult to disentangle from model outputs alone. We use translation as a controlled probe: for multi-parallel segments that a model translates well in one language direction but poorly in another, content is held fixed while language varies. Using activation patching, we write residual-stream states from successful runs into failing ones and compare content-matched states with content-independent controls, allowing us to trace content-specific and language-related signals across layers. Across three LLMs of different scales and architectures, we find a consistent three-stage pattern of multilingual generation. Intermediate layers first express a default English signal; content information becomes causally available one layer later; and the final target language is resolved only at later layers. The ordering of the English default before content also appears in a reading-comprehension task. Our sparse autoencoder analyses reveal a further dissociation: the intermediate language signal is only weakly represented by sparse features, whereas a later language distinction is clearly sparse, but resists intervention at the patched position. These results provide a mechanistic account of how language selection and content information emerge and interact during multilingual generation.

translation.title: 语言先于内容：多语言生成的因果层映射
translation.abstract: 多语言生成要求大语言模型（LLM）同时决定说什么内容以及用什么语言表达，然而这两者的关系难以仅从模型输出中区分。我们使用翻译作为受控探针：对于模型在一个翻译方向上表现良好而在另一方向上表现不佳的多平行片段，内容保持不变而语言发生变化。通过activation patching，我们将成功运行的residual-stream状态写入失败运行中，并将内容匹配状态与内容无关对照进行比较，从而追踪跨层的内容特定信号和语言相关信号。在三个不同规模和架构的LLM上，我们发现了多语言生成的一致三阶段模式：中间层首先表达默认的英语信号；内容信息在之后一层才变为因果可用；最终目标语言只在更后面的层才被确定。英语默认先于内容的顺序也出现在阅读理解任务中。我们的sparse autoencoder分析揭示了进一步的分离：中间层语言信号仅被稀疏特征弱表示，而后期的语言区分则明显稀疏，但在patching位置难以干预。这些结果为多语言生成过程中语言选择与内容信息的涌现和交互提供了机制性解释。
translation.brief: 探究多语言生成中语言与内容的因果涌现顺序，利用activation patching和sparse autoencoder分析揭示“英语默认信号先于内容、目标语言最后确定”的三阶段模式。

papers.title: SciMARS: Multi-Agent Recursive Self-Improvement for Closed-Loop Scientific Discovery
papers.abstract: We propose SciMARS, a framework for recursive task-local adaptation of multi-agent harnesses in closed-loop scientific discovery. Multi-agent systems coordinate analysis, experimental design, and verification as scientific evidence evolves. However, two problems limit their effectiveness: (i) without shared memory, agents lose observations and repeat work; (ii) fixed role procedures, handoffs, and memory policies perpetuate mistakes despite retained evidence. We address these problems with a shared evidence graph and separate component editors. SciMARS adapts roles and coordination; SciMARS + Memory adds a third editor for how agents record, retrieve, and receive evidence. Candidate probes guide composition and selection of the next harness. We evaluate scientific discovery through experimental-data replay and a digital twin. SciMARS + Memory resolves 12/18 GPT-6-Astra and 2/18 GLM-5.3 attempts on Autonomous Science Bench, compared with 8/18 and 1/18 for the base multi-agent team. On ScienceAgentBench and AppWorld, it solves 14/38 and 11/20 tasks, compared with 11/38 and 5/20 for the base team. These results support combining shared memory with harness adaptation across scientific and interactive tasks.

translation.title: SciMARS：面向闭环科学发现的多智能体递归自我改进
translation.abstract: 我们提出 SciMARS，一个在闭环科学发现中对多智能体框架进行递归任务局部适应的框架。随着科学证据的演化，多智能体系统需要协调分析、实验设计和验证。然而有两个问题限制了其有效性：(i) 缺乏共享记忆时，智能体会丢失观察结果并重复工作；(ii) 固定的角色流程、交接和记忆策略即使保留了证据也会延续错误。我们通过共享证据图和独立的组件编辑器来解决这些问题。SciMARS 适应角色与协调；SciMARS + Memory 增加第三个编辑器来管理智能体如何记录、检索和接收证据。候选探针引导下一个框架的组合与选择。我们通过实验数据回放和数字孪生来评估科学发现。在 Autonomous Science Bench 上，SciMARS + Memory 解决了 GPT-6-Astra 12/18 和 GLM-5.3 2/18 的任务，而基础多智能体团队分别为 8/18 和 1/18。在 ScienceAgentBench 和 AppWorld 上，它分别解决 14/38 和 11/20 个任务，而基础团队为 11/38 和 5/20。这些结果支持将共享记忆与框架适应相结合以应对科学和交互式任务。
translation.brief: 解决多智能体系统缺乏共享记忆和固定流程导致错误延续的问题，采用共享证据图加多个组件编辑器对智能体框架进行递归自我适应。

papers.title: WanderBench: Can World Models Explore Dynamic Worlds from Video?
papers.abstract: Video world models conditioned on an input video make it possible to explore real, recorded dynamic scenes, enabling re-shooting of footage, free-viewpoint replay, and real-to-sim environments for embodied agents. Such uses require the generated rollout to stay faithful to the recorded world, yet existing benchmarks start from a single image or a text prompt, and video-conditioned generation is evaluated mainly on perceptual quality and camera following. These evaluations do not directly assess whether exploration preserves subject identity, event progression, and scene consistency upon revisiting a location. We introduce WanderBench, a benchmark for exploring dynamic worlds from video. It comprises 745 single-shot source videos of real and AI-generated content in three difficulty tiers (3-25 s), paired with camera routes given as keyboard actions, and evaluates six dimensions with 24 human-validated sub-metrics. Benchmarking eight models, we find that as clips grow longer, models keep the static scene and visual quality but lose camera control and the source dynamics, and that none keeps revisited places consistent. We further propose WanderLand, a training-free framework that conditions each frame of a frozen model on the same-instant source and, on revisits, on its own earlier static content. WanderLand improves five models on every dimension, by up to 8.3 points in source-dynamics fidelity.

translation.title: WanderBench：世界模型能否从视频探索动态世界？
translation.abstract: 以输入视频为条件的视频世界模型使探索真实录制的动态场景成为可能，支持重拍素材、自由视点回放以及面向具身智能体的实-to-仿真环境。这些用途要求生成的 rollout 忠实于录制世界，但现有基准从单张图像或文本提示开始，而视频条件生成主要在感知质量和相机跟随方面评估。这些评估无法直接衡量探索是否在重访某地点时保持主体身份、事件进程和场景一致性。我们提出 WanderBench，一个从视频探索动态世界的基准，包含 745 段真实与 AI 生成的单镜头源视频（3-25 秒，分三个难度层级），配以键盘动作形式的相机路线，并以 24 个人工验证的子指标评估六个维度。对八个模型的基准测试发现：随着片段变长，模型能保持静态场景和视觉质量，但失去相机控制能力和源动态，且没有任何模型能保持重访地点的一致性。我们进一步提出 WanderLand，一个免训练框架，将冻结模型的每一帧条件于同一时刻的源内容，并在重访时条件于其自身先前的静态内容。WanderLand 在所有维度上改进了五个模型，源动态保真度最高提升 8.3 分。
translation.brief: 解决视频条件世界模型在动态场景探索中缺乏忠实度评估基准的问题，构建含 745 段视频的多维度基准并提出免训练的逐帧条件化框架 WanderLand。

papers.title: Text2NGAC: a multi-LLM pipeline for NGAC policy extraction with mutation-based verification
papers.abstract: Access-control policies are written in natural language but enforced as formal models, and translating them into NIST Next Generation Access Control (NGAC) graphs remains unsolved: prior systems cover only subsets of the NGAC model, and none verify the graphs they extract. We present Text2NGAC, a pipeline of cooperating large language models that disambiguates each sentence before extraction, escalates uncertain sentences to a multi-model ensemble, and checks the resulting graph with a five-strategy verifier whose own effectiveness is measured by controlled mutation testing. To our knowledge it is the first system to extract all four NGAC relationship types - associations, prohibitions, event-response obligations, and assignments - from real-world policy documents. Three results anchor the evaluation. The verifier detects 99.7% of 918 injected mutants and every structural fail-open fault, and the fault classes it misses are characterized and weighted by security consequence rather than left unexamined. The extracted graphs are enforceable: one corpus's graph loads unmodified into the NIST reference implementation, which reproduces all 55 access decisions the graph entails and fires an extracted obligation end-to-end. Extraction reaches 97.3-99.6% exact-tuple-match accuracy on the 714 scored sentences of four real corpora, far above three reproduced baselines on matched metrics, and paraphrase probes with semantic re-scoring bound the pipeline's sensitivity to rewording. Reported accuracy is wording- and benchmark-specific, adversarial input is outside the verifier's guarantees, and the intended deployment is extraction plus structural verification feeding expert review. A complete two-tier reproducibility artifact accompanies the paper.

translation.title: Text2NGAC：基于变异验证的多 LLM NGAC 策略提取流水线
translation.abstract: 访问控制策略以自然语言编写却以形式模型执行，将其翻译为 NIST 下一代访问控制（NGAC）图仍未解决：先前系统只覆盖 NGAC 模型的子集，且无一验证其提取的图。我们提出 Text2NGAC，一个协作大语言模型流水线，在提取前消歧每句话，将不确定句子升级至多模型集成，并用五策略验证器检查所得图，验证器自身的有效性通过受控变异测试衡量。据我们所知，它是首个从真实策略文档中提取全部四种 NGAC 关系类型——关联、禁止、事件响应义务和分配——的系统。三个结果支撑评估：验证器检出 918 个注入变异体中的 99.7% 以及所有结构性 fail-open 故障，遗漏的故障类别也被刻画并按安全后果加权；提取的图可被执行——一个语料库的图无需修改即可加载至 NIST 参考实现，复现图所蕴含的全部 55 个访问决策并端到端触发一个提取的义务；在四个真实语料库的 714 个评分句上，提取达到 97.3-99.6% 的精确元组匹配准确率，远高于相同指标下的三个复现基线，且带语义重评分的改写探针界定了流水线对措辞的敏感性。报告的准确率依赖措辞与基准，对抗输入不在验证器保证范围内，预期部署为提取加结构验证并供专家审查。论文附有完整的两层可复现性工件。
translation.brief: 解决自然语言访问控制策略到 NGAC 图提取覆盖不全且无验证的问题，采用多 LLM 协作流水线提取全部四种关系类型并用变异测试驱动的验证器检查结构正确性。

papers.title: AgentOPSD: Turn-Level Credit Assignment via Recursive Belief Revision
papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards ordinarily spreads a single advantage over a whole trajectory, a granularity too coarse to isolate the few decisions on which success in a long, multi-turn interaction actually turns. Privileged self-distillation supplies denser supervision, but it leaves unanswered how a set of local teacher-student discrepancies should be converted into credit along a sequence. We introduce AgentOPSD, a critic-free scheme that assigns credit recursively, one interaction turn at a time. Inside a turn, the token-level log-probability gaps between a skill-conditioned self-teacher and the student are summed, and that sum acts as evidence in a recursive Bayesian update carried out in log-odds space; the resulting revisions reallocate the outcome-derived advantage across turns through a multiplier that is bounded and preserves its sign. With Qwen2.5-3B and Qwen2.5-7B as policy backbones on ALFWorld, the method improves consistently on GRPO and on self-distillation baselines, and attains 89.1% success at the 7B scale. Ablations attribute the gain to aggregating evidence at turn boundaries and to making the belief revision depend on history, rather than to the local gap by itself.

translation.title: AgentOPSD：通过递归信念修正实现回合级信用分配
translation.abstract: 带可验证奖励的强化学习通常将单一优势摊到整条轨迹上，粒度过粗，无法隔离长时多轮交互中真正决定成败的少数决策。特权自蒸馏提供更密集的监督，但未回答如何将一组局部师生差异转化为序列上的信用。我们提出 AgentOPSD，一种无 critic 的方案，逐交互回合递归分配信用。在一个回合内，技能条件自教师与学生之间的 token 级对数概率差被求和，该和作为证据用于对数几率空间中的递归贝叶斯更新；所得修正通过一个有界且保持符号的乘数将来自结果的优势在回合间重新分配。在 ALFWorld 上以 Qwen2.5-3B 和 Qwen2.5-7B 为策略骨干，该方法持续优于 GRPO 和自蒸馏基线，7B 规模下达到 89.1% 成功率。消融实验将增益归因于在回合边界聚合证据以及使信念修正依赖历史，而非局部差异本身。
translation.brief: 解决长时多轮智能体任务中轨迹级优势分配过粗的问题，提出无 critic 的逐回合递归贝叶斯信念修正方案来重新分配信用。

papers.title: Fairness in Explainable AI Narratives: Decomposing Social Disparities in LLM-Generated Explanations
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to translate technical explainable AI (XAI) artefacts such as SHAP into explanatory narratives (XAINs) for lay users. In high-risk domains, these explanations are often the main resource through which individuals can understand and contest adverse decisions. Yet LLMs are known to reproduce social bias, even from proxy variables alone, and fairness in XAINs remains unstudied. Because XAINs are bound to a ground-truth artefact, fairness concerns not only what a narrative says and how, but also whether it is equally faithful across social groups. We introduce fairness in XAINs as a new field of research and propose a framework that generates narratives under three conditions (protected attribute disclosed, withheld, or counterfactually swapped), allowing five comparisons that pinpoint the cause of disparities. We apply it to adversely classified instances from four datasets in credit scoring, education and employment, generating narratives with five LLMs, and evaluate faithfulness, feature coverage and sentiment. We find significant disparities across all datasets, metric families and models, arising in two ways. Faithfulness disparities result from feature values: LLMs make plausible but false statements, triggered by values that are unequally distributed across social groups. Feature coverage and sentiment disparities stem from the protected attribute itself: once it is disclosed, LLMs give less explanation to, or frame more negatively the narratives of, groups that have historically been discriminated against or are stereotypically associated with worse outcomes. A more faithful model removes the faithfulness disparities, and withholding protected attributes mostly removes the others, but neither suffices on its own. Fairness in XAINs should therefore be audited separately from the predictive model and its XAI artefact.

translation.title: 可解释 AI 叙事中的公平性：分解 LLM 生成解释中的社会差异
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）越来越多地被用于将 SHAP 等技术性可解释 AI（XAI）工件转化为面向普通用户的解释性叙事（XAIN）。在高风险领域，这些解释往往是个人理解和对不利决定提出异议的主要资源。然而已知 LLM 会再现社会偏见，即便仅通过代理变量，而 XAIN 的公平性尚未被研究。由于 XAIN 绑定于一个真实工件，公平性不仅关乎叙事说什么和怎么说，还在于它是否对各社会群体同等忠实。我们将 XAIN 公平性确立为新的研究领域，提出一个在三种条件（披露、隐瞒或反事实交换受保护属性）下生成叙事的框架，支持五种比较以定位差异成因。我们将其应用于信贷、教育和就业四个数据集中被不利分类的实例，用五个 LLM 生成叙事，并评估忠实度、特征覆盖和情感。我们在所有数据集、指标族和模型中都发现显著差异，其产生方式有二：忠实度差异源于特征值——LLM 会做出看似合理但错误的陈述，由在社会群体间分布不均的特征值触发；特征覆盖和情感差异源于受保护属性本身——一旦披露，LLM 会给历史上受歧视或被刻板认为结果较差的群体更少解释或更负面的叙事框架。更忠实的模型可消除忠实度差异，隐瞒受保护属性大多可消除其余差异，但二者单独都不充分。因此 XAIN 的公平性应独立于预测模型及其 XAI 工件单独审计。
translation.brief: 解决 LLM 将 SHAP 等可解释 AI 工件转化为自然语言叙事时存在社会群体公平性差异的问题，提出在三种受保护属性条件下生成叙事的审计框架并分解差异成因。

papers.title: Creative Intent as an Evolving Shared State: Supporting Cross-Stage Human-AI Video Co-Creation
papers.abstract: As generative AI becomes increasingly involved in video creation, creators face challenges in expanding, translating, and negotiating creative intent across stages. We therefore view creative intent as an evolving shared state throughout human-AI co-creation. A multi-stage design was employed: semi-structured interviews with 12 creators informed 3 design goals, followed by expert co-design and the development of VideoMaker. VideoMaker organizes creation into a six-stage workflow that progressively translates creative intent. At key stages, creators negotiate with AI through the Seed Panel, explicitly confirming, revising, and updating intent. A shared AI Agent, supported by the Multi-style Script Library and Cinematic Language Knowledge Base, enables differentiated expansion of initial intent and faithful translation. A within-subjects study with 30 participants showed that VideoMaker effectively supported the expansion and cross-stage translation of creative intent, with stronger intent preservation, while negotiated boundaries between creator-confirmed intent and AI initiative remained difficult to sustain.

papers.title: Learning Global Equilibria in Non-Concave Prospect Theoretic Games
papers.abstract: Human agents in non cooperative games often exhibit non rational behaviour. Prospect theory provides a behavioural framework to capture how agents perceive gains and losses under risk, but, its incorporation into games typically leads to non concave and non convex utility functions, making equilibrium computation challenging. In such cases, it is difficult to obtain algorithms that have global convergence behaviour. This paper proposes a learning algorithm which uses minorization-maximization (MM). Under a proximal Polyak-Lojasiewicz (PL) condition on the potential function, we establish global convergence of the algorithm to a potential-maximizing Nash equilibrium. We further show how the structure of the MM minorizer can be used to enable a distributed implementation of the algorithm. With additional noise injection, the individual updates of the agents can be obscured, while still ensuring global convergence.

papers.title: Beyond Sunny Skies: Using Large Language Models to Predict Urban Traffic in Adverse Weather
papers.abstract: Urban traffic flow prediction is a cornerstone of intelligent transportation systems, yet accurate forecasting under adverse weather conditions remains a significant challenge. Existing data-driven models, while effective for routine patterns, often struggle with the sparse data and complex non-linear shifts associated with rare meteorological events. These methods typically treat environmental contexts as shallow numerical features, failing to capture the underlying semantic reasoning-why and how specific adverse conditions alter mobility behaviors across regions with different functional compositions. To address this limitation, we propose Multi-STG, a unified framework that integrates Large Language Model (LLM)-derived semantic priors with graph-based spatiotemporal learning. Multi-STG introduces an LLM-empowered semantic enhancement module that transforms comprehensive context descriptions such as weather, POIs, and holidays into high-level semantic embeddings, effectively providing a knowledge-driven complement to data scarcity. Furthermore, we design a multimodal attentional fusion mechanism to dynamically weigh heterogeneous inputs and a semantic-enhanced prediction head with gated residual calibration to robustly adjust forecasts based on semantic guidance. Extensive experiments on real-world multi-city private car datasets demonstrate that Multi-STG outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, reducing MAE by 11.82\% on average relative to the strongest baseline across three cities, while maintaining stable performance under sparse and non-stationary conditions.

papers.title: FAROS: Forecast-Aware Risk-Informed Online Reinforcement Learning for Proactive O-RAN Slicing
papers.abstract: Proactive Open Radio Access Network (O-RAN) slicing requires decisions before an approaching quality-of-service (QoS) loss becomes difficult to reverse. We present FAROS, a Forecast-Aware Risk-Informed O-RAN Slicing framework that combines an eight-step QoS forecast, training-only PCMCI+-supported temporal risk, Multi-Agent Proximal Policy Optimization (MAPPO) under centralized training and decentralized execution (CTDE), symbolic feasibility constraints, and reliability-aware Top-K arbitration. MAPPO supplies the actor proposal, while A5v2 checks admissibility and one-step utility before execution. Evaluation uses ten validation-selected frozen checkpoints, 500 matched start indices per seed under the risky-start protocol, and 150,000 agent-level decisions. FAROS obtains mean reward 0.2778 and ten-step recovery 90.56% across ten seeds. A fixed model-matched diagnostic rule reaches reward 0.3015 and recovery 97.57% under the same transition-reward contract, so we make no superiority claim over direct threshold logic. A same-actor M4 shield control also reaches zero risky-state prohibited actions. In the M5 trace, A5v2 changes 22.61% of actor proposals and reduces the predicate-defined prohibited-action rate from 16.79% at proposal time to zero at execution; this property is enforced by the arbiter rather than learned by MAPPO. Independent ns-3 experiments test the six-action interface at packet level and remain separate from end-to-end FAROS claims.

papers.title: TrialDesignBench: Benchmarking Language Models for Phase-I Trial Design Against Clinical Knowledge
papers.abstract: AI is used in much of the clinical trial pipeline. However, selecting the statistical design of a trial, a crucial step that determines how drug doses are tested on humans and evaluated, has seen almost no AI progress. LLMs appear to be a natural fit given their strengths in biomedical knowledge and statistical reasoning. Nevertheless, there is currently no appropriate way to evaluate such abilities because recent regulatory and methodological shifts, most notably FDA's Project Optimus, have redefined what constitutes a reasonable design and rendered many previous designs obsolete. To lay the groundwork for AI-assisted trial design, we introduce TrialDesignBench, a benchmark of 617 Phase-I/I-II oncology dose-finding trials, each paired with an expert-validated reference design that is consistent with the latest FDA regulatory initiatives. This reference standard is produced through a formalization of the expert design process. We evaluate five frontier LLMs, none of which matches the reference standard. Our ablation experiments trace this performance gap to two main causes, inference of latent, unrecorded design determinants from trial sources (supplying them raises class-wise balanced accuracy by 0.22) and structured decision-tree reasoning (+0.24). TrialDesignBench offers a reproducible, contemporary-standard objective for evaluating and enhancing AI-assisted trial design.
